title: Two-year Postdoctoral Position on Spintronics for Advanced Computing: Spintronic Device Fabrication, Characterization and Advanced Computing
description:
The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year position as a postdoctoral researcher within spintronic computing. The position offers an exciting opportunity to advance spintronics through device physics, simulation, fabrication, experimental characterization, and integration of spintronic devices for advanced computing applications.

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to investigate, design, fabricate, and characterize spintronic devices, with particular emphasis on Anisotropic Magnetoresistance (AMR), Giant Magnetoresistance (GMR), and Tunneling Magneto Resistance (TMR) devices. The work will combine magnetic and spintronic device physics, materials and multilayer structures, device fabrication, electrical measurement, modelling, and data analysis, with the aim of developing reliable spintronic technologies for advanced computing and emerging semiconductor applications.

The research will focus on understanding, controlling, and exploiting thermal fluctuations and stochastic switching in MTJs for physical entropy generation and energy-efficient computing, with particular emphasis on True Random Number Generators (TRNGs) and Stochastic Neural Accelerators (SNAs).

The successful candidate will work on the physics-based design, modelling, simulation, fabrication, and experimental characterization of spintronic devices and their integration into advanced computing systems. The position also includes a role in the Danish Chips Competence Center, where the candidate will contribute to connecting the Danish semiconductor and spintronics ecosystem with relevant EU pilot lines, facilitating collaboration, technology development, prototyping, and access to European semiconductor fabrication capabilities. The candidate will also contribute to preparing and writing research proposals and funding applications related to spintronics, semiconductor technologies, and advanced computing.

As a spintronic postdoc, you are expected to: 

  • Perform atomistic and micromagnetic simulations of s-MTJ structures and magnetization dynamics to investigate switching mechanisms, thermal activation, stochasticity, variability, and operating conditions relevant to TRNG and SNA applications.

  • Contribute to the electrical, magnetic, and transport characterization of fabricated AMR, GMR, and TMR devices, including resistance states, magnetoresistance, switching behaviour, current/voltage dependence, temperature dependence, and device-to-device variability, and correlate experimental results with modelling and simulation.

 

What we offer 

  • A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing section integrating expertise in analog/digital IC design, spintronics, advanced computing, semiconductor technologies, and energy-efficient system architectures. 

  • Access to advanced facilities and infrastructure for spintronic device design, fabrication, electrical and magnetic characterization, and system prototyping, together with opportunities to collaborate with relevant Danish and European pilot-line and semiconductor facilities. 

  • Excellent opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with national and international academic and industrial partners in microelectronics, semiconductor technology, photonics, spintronics, and advanced computing, including activities connecting the Danish ecosystem with EU pilot lines.

  • An open and collaborative research culture within SDU’s Faculty of Engineering (TEK), The Mads Clausen Institute (MCI), promoting interdisciplinary innovation across electronics, materials science, semiconductor processing, spintronics, and artificial intelligence.

 

What we expect 

Applicants should hold a PhD in Electronic and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a closely related field (the degree should have been completed within the last 6 years at most): 

  • Expertise in spintronics, magnetism, magnetic device physics, or related areas, with demonstrated experience in physics-based modelling and/or simulation of magnetic or spintronic devices. Experience with s-MTJ devices, stochastic magnetization dynamics, or thermal switching is highly desirable and electrical modeling of sMTJs using Verilog to be used in Cadense

  • Experience with experimental characterization of AMR, GMR, MTJ, or related spintronic devices, including electrical and magnetic measurements, resistance and magnetoresistance characterization, switching behaviour, and data analysis. Experience with pilot-line activities, technology transfer, or collaboration with semiconductor foundries is an advantage.

  • A strong research track record demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications and the ability to work effectively in collaborative research environments. Experience in writing research proposals, funding applications, or project plans is highly desirable.

  • Team player with strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners across Denmark and Europe. 

All candidates must demonstrate excellent verbal and written English skills, along with very good communication abilities and the ability to communicate technical results to multidisciplinary and international partners. 

 

Workplace description 

The successful candidate will join SDU Microelectronics, a dynamic and expanding section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, semiconductor technologies, spintronics, photonics, and advanced computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation. Within the DKCCC project, the candidate will contribute to strengthening connections between the Danish ecosystem and EU pilot lines and to translating spintronic device research into fabrication, prototyping, and technology-development activities.

 

Further information 

For further information about the position, please contact Professor Farshad Moradi (moradi@sdu.dk / email), Head of the SDU Microelectronics section and Associate Professor Hooman Farkhani (farkhani@sdu.dk / email), Deputy Head of SDU Microelectronics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).

title: Two-year Postdoc position on Spintronic Quantum-inspired Computing
description:
Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year Postdoctoral Researcher position within the newly funded QUANTRONIC – Spintronic Pseudo-Qubits for Room-Temperature Quantum Computing project, supported by the Villum Experiment programme of Villum Fonden.

We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to investigate a new class of spintronic pseudo-qubits (p-qubits) based on spin-orbit torque magnetic tunnel junctions (SOT-MTJs). The project explores whether engineered stochastic spintronic devices can reproduce key computational mechanisms associated with quantum systems - including superposition-like states, probability-amplitude-based interference, and entanglement-like correlations—without relying on fragile quantum coherence or cryogenic operation.

QUANTRONIC is a high-risk, high-gain research project positioned at the intersection of spintronics, probabilistic computing, quantum-inspired computing, nanoelectronics, and integrated circuit design. The central concept is a novel SOT-MTJ architecture designed to represent and manipulate probability amplitudes and to enable synchronization between multiple pseudo-qubits. The project will combine physics-based modelling, device design and fabrication, experimental characterization, and system-level demonstrations.

The successful candidate will work within SDU Microelectronics and collaborate closely with international partners, particularly INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory, on the design and fabrication of spintronic devices.

The position is expected to start in February 2027, with the specific starting date to be agreed with the successful candidate.

 

As a Postdoctoral Researcher in QUANTRONIC, your key responsibilities will include:

  • Develop and refine physics-based compact models of SOT-MTJ-based pseudo-qubits, including stochastic switching and inter-device coupling.

  • Develop Verilog-A models and integrate them into circuit-level simulation environments such as Cadence.

  • Investigate the physical requirements for controlling probabilistic states and representing probability amplitudes in spintronic devices.

  • Collaborate with project partners on the design and fabrication of SOT-MTJ devices and arrays.

  • Experimentally characterize standalone devices and coupled arrays, including stochastic switching, synchronization, and entanglement-like correlations.

  • Investigate quantum-inspired gate operations and system-level demonstrations using networks of pseudo-qubits.

  • Contribute to proof-of-concept demonstrations, including integer factorization and other quantum-inspired computational problems.

  • Publish research results in high-quality international journals and conferences and contribute to the dissemination of project results.

  • Collaborate with researchers in spintronics, probabilistic computing, microelectronics, materials science, and quantum information.

 

What we offer

  • A unique opportunity to work on a high-risk, high-gain research concept exploring a new computational regime between classical probabilistic and quantum computing.

  • A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing research section with expertise in spintronics, probabilistic computing, neuromorphic computing, analog/digital IC design, and emerging computing architectures.

  • Access to advanced facilities for electronic design, device characterization, measurement, and system prototyping.

  • Close collaboration with INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory on spintronic device technology and fabrication.

  • Opportunities to collaborate with national and international researchers in spintronics, quantum-inspired computing, quantum technologies, and nanoelectronics.

  • An open, international, and collaborative research environment within SDU's Faculty of Engineering, supporting interdisciplinary research across electronics, physics, materials science, and computing.

  • Strong opportunities for developing an independent research profile in an emerging area of probabilistic and quantum-inspired hardware.

 

What we expect

Applicants should hold a PhD in electronic engineering, electrical engineering, applied physics, nanotechnology, spintronics, or a closely related field.

The ideal candidate should have experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Spintronics and magnetic devices, particularly MTJs, STT-MTJs, SOT-MTJs, or related technologies.

  • Physics-based modelling of nanoscale or magnetic devices.

  • Verilog-A, SPICE, and Cadence or comparable circuit/device simulation environments.

  • Experimental characterization of electronic, magnetic, or spintronic devices.

  • Stochastic or probabilistic computing systems.

Experience in micromagnetic simulation, magnetotransport measurements, nanofabrication, probabilistic computing, or quantum/quantum-inspired computing will be considered a strong advantage.

We are particularly interested in candidates who are enthusiastic about working across traditional disciplinary boundaries and are comfortable combining device physics, modelling, experimentation, and computing concepts.

The successful candidate should be able to work independently while contributing actively to an interdisciplinary and international research team. Excellent written and spoken English and strong communication skills are required.

 

Workplace description 

The successful candidate will join SDU Microelectronics, a dynamic and expanding section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, spintronics, photonics, and neuromorphic computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 10, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is February 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

title: Tenure Track Assistant Professor in Infectious Animal Disease Modelling for Sustainable One Health Actions
description:
Tenure Track Assistant Professor in Infectious Animal Disease Modelling for Sustainable One Health Actions Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences
Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
University of Copenhagen

The University seeks to appoint a tenure track assistant professor to commence 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Information on the department can be found at: http://www.sund.ku.dk/.

Subject area: Infectious disease epidemiology, modelling, animal health, One Health, and sustainable health systems

The Tenure-Track Assistant Professor will lead research on the dynamics of infectious disease spread in health systems, with particular emphasis on how changes in environmental conditions, animal populations, production systems, and management practices influence disease emergence, transmission, and control. The position will combine infectious disease epidemiology, mathematical and statistical modelling, data science, and economic analysis to generate evidence supporting disease preparedness, prevention, and control.

The successful candidate will:

  • Lead independent research on the dynamics of infectious disease spread in health systems, including the influence of environmental and production system changes.
  • Develop and apply simulation, epidemiological, and statistical models to assess disease and spillover risks, evaluate mitigation and control strategies, and quantify their economic implications.
  • Demonstrate strong programming skills in R and other relevant programming languages, including experience in managing, processing, and analysing large and complex datasets.
  • Have experience in developing and applying epidemiological disease-spread models, including model calibration, validation, parameter estimation, and calculation of epidemiological indicators such as the basic reproduction number (R₀) across different animal species and production systems.
  • Design and implement epidemiological modelling frameworks.
  • Validate and calibrate models using large-scale national datasets, ensuring scientific robustness, methodological validity, and relevance for policy and decision-making.
  • Translate research findings into evidence supporting risk-based disease prevention, preparedness, and control.
  • Establish and maintain collaborations with key stakeholders, including the Danish Veterinary and Food Administration, industry partners such as SEGES and Landbrug & Fødevarer (L&F), and international organisations such as the FAO.
  • Lead and secure independent research funding through competitive national and international funding calls. The position requires demonstrated experience in securing external funding, as well as the ambition to develop research ideas into externally funded projects and provide scientific leadership for such projects within the TIPTON Research Group.
  • Contribute to the development and delivery of One Health and sustainability teaching, with a particular focus on infectious diseases, disease preparedness, and the interactions between animal, human, and environmental health.
  • Contribute to teaching in data science, including data management, dataset preparation and handling, statistical analysis, programming, and the analysis of large-scale and complex datasets.
  • Supervise students and contribute to research capacity building within infectious disease epidemiology, disease modelling, data science, and One Health.
  • Contribute to the delivery of government services undertaken by the Department, including research-based advice, preparedness activities, risk assessments, and other activities relevant to infectious disease modelling and control.
The position is expected to combine methodological excellence in infectious disease modelling and data science with applied epidemiological research, generating evidence that is directly relevant to disease preparedness, private and public bodies, sustainable production systems, animal health and resilient health systems.

The tenure track assistant professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of:

  • research, including publication/academic dissemination
  • research-based teaching
  • sharing knowledge with society
  • participation in formal pedagogical training programme for assistant professors
The tenure track assistant professor’s performance will be evaluated through annual evaluations. Furthermore, the tenure track assistant professor will be evaluated in a mid-track appraisal.

After no more than six years of employment and on condition of a positive final appraisal, the tenure track assistant professor will be employed as associate professor. Find more information about tenure track at the University of Copenhagen.

Required qualifications
To be qualified for an assistant professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution and leadership. Find information about each criterion.

Furthermore, each applicant must be able to document:

  • a PhD degree or similar qualifications within the subject area
  • research experience within the field of the position
The tenure track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

The assistant professor is also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.

Salary and employment conditions
The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

The position is permanent.

Employment is as Tenure Track Assistant Professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant professional organisations.

There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector at www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025.

Questions
For further information, please contact Research Group Leader: Professor Beate Conrady, bcon@sund.ku.dk

Foreign applicants may find the university’s International Staff Mobility useful.

Application
The application must be submitted in English, and must include the following documents:

  • Application (Including motivation for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages))
  • Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding)
  • Diplomas (Master’s, PhD and other relevant diplomas)
  • A complete list of publications
  • Research plan (2-4 pages)
  • Teaching plan
  • Uploads of maximum 5 publications to be considered in the assessment
  • Teaching portfolio, if applicable (Guidelines)
Please note: It is mandatory to upload a teaching plan in the online application form. Should you not be able to produce a teaching plan, please upload a blank document in this box instead.

Application procedure
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The Dean then appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee and each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at the university's Job Portal.

Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.

The application will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

The University of Copenhagen encourages all interested in this post to apply.

Please submit the application with the required attachments. Only online applications will be accepted. The closing date for applications is 23.59 p.m. CET, 18 November 2026.

Interviews for this position are likely to be held on 7 April 2027.

title: Chef - Zoku Copenhagen
description:
Are you a passionate chef with great cooking skills who loves to work in an open kitchen? Then keep reading.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

Life doesn’t become more social than through sharing food. That’s our founding food philosophy and it can be yours too. The food that comes out of our Living Kitchen is fresh, simple, honest, healthy and local. With short-end preparation times, simple ingredients and limited preparation steps, our assortment is incredibly intelligent and facilitates fast service.

As our new chef you'll be responsible for any food that comes out of our Living Kitchen. You'll plate beautiful dishes and at times make creative buffets that not only look good, but also taste amazing.

You’ll work closely together with our team of chefs, to develop menu offerings and forecast supply needs. You like to take on responsibility, thrive with independence in your work and function as a substitute for our chefs. 


WHAT MAKES OUR KITCHEN UNIQUE?

  • You won’t hide in the background. You'll get to work in an open kitchen environment with plenty of space and natural daylight.

  • You'll get the ultimate flexibility. You can come up with your own dishes and let your creativity run wild.

  • You can have good conversations with visitors. You’re the face of the kitchen and you'll get to directly chat with guests.

  • You get to be independent in your work. You like doing your own thing and can cook solo when you need to.

  • You can get to know the entire team. You'll be in close contact with our front of house and the entire Zoku team.

  • You can work in a unique kitchen setup. We’re not like your average kitchen (feel free to stop by our rooftop to see for yourself!).

  • You are encouraged to work with fresh and seasonal ingredients. We put a strong emphasis on incorporating vegetables into our dishes.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • A market conform salary package including pension and health insurance.

  • Cool benefits like an after-work drink, access to all community events, various discounts like 40% discount on F&B for you and 4 friends, plus Employee and Friends & Family rates in all Zoku Locations.  

  • A free night stay for you and your +1 in your first 3 months at your Zoku (dinner & breakfast) and a free night at any Zoku location for your birthday, including welcome drink & breakfast to experience Zoku as a true guest. 

  • No boring canteen!! Staff meals enjoyed from our Living Kitchen.

  • A personal budget unlocked after 1 year at Zoku to spend on extra days off, learning & development, extra cash or discounted vouchers. 

  • A fun, young, and international team to grow with. Plus, exciting training and events to celebrate every step of the journey!

  • A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO...

  • Show their creativity through their passion for food and never settle for less.

  • Can juggle many tasks at the same time while remaining cool headed and warm hearted.

  • Enjoy variety in their day and are happy to switch things up, whether that means breakfast, brunch, lunch buffets, a la carte dinners or cheffing up something special for our Meetings & Events.

  • Have experience in working independently and don't believe in traditional kitchen hierarchies.

  • Enjoy working in an open kitchen and love to chat up a storm with our residents.

  • Have experience in healthy homestyle cooking – vegetarian cooking skills are a plus.

  • Have provable knowledge of various cooking techniques.

A FEW MUST HAVES

  • You have a minimum of 1 year working experience in a kitchen or restaurant environment. 

  • You have experience with implementing the local HACCP guidelines (Hygiejnebevis).

  • You are fluent in English – Danish and other languages are a plus.

  • You are an EU resident or have a working and living permit valid for Denmark including a CPR.

  • You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days / hours, including availability on some weekends. Shifts include AM, Mid-shifts, and PM.

  • You love to work as we'll need you Full Time (37 hours- 5 shifts weekly)

  • Available to start As Soon As Possible.

WHAT WE ARE PROUD OF 

Our fresh take on hospitality has been recognized around the world with plenty of press attention and design awards.

We’re also proudly B Corp certified at all four of our locations (Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Paris and Vienna), which means we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to social and environmental impact, transparency and accountability.

WHAT IS ZOKU

Zoku is a new type of hotel that offers a place to live, co-work and socialize in Europe's most livable cities: Amsterdam, Vienna, Copenhagen & Paris. 

Designed for the new generation of travellers, Zoku is so much more than a long stay hotel. It is a place you can call your second home, even on your first visit. Zoku is a hive of private Lofts and rooftop Social Spaces, so travellers can stay connected and well rested as they live and work throughout Europe. Throw yourself into your work and play, and effortlessly discover one of our home cities.

title: Terminal worker wanted for Bring in Greve
description:

title: PhD position at the Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA)
description:
The Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA) at The Mads Clausen Institute, University of Southern Denmark, is seeking a talented and highly motivated PhD student to work on the development of new theoretical frameworks for describing light–matter interactions in advanced van der Walls heterostructures probed by polaritons generated through inelastic tunneling. The position is funded by a Villum Young Investigator grant awarded to Assistant Professor P. André D. Gonçalves, who will supervise the PhD research.

The position is available starting 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The successful candidate will develop new theoretical frameworks and computational methods to investigate the fundamental limits of polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling in tunnel junctions based on van der Waals heterostructures composed of atomically thin materials. The project will employ a broad range of analytical, semi-analytical, and numerical techniques to explore electrically driven polaritonic phenomena. A major focus will be on harnessing polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling as a tool to probe and manipulate light–matter interactions at the nanoscale, as well as to characterize the optoelectronic response of complex quantum materials.

We welcome candidates with a strong background in condensed-matter physics and/or quantum nanophotonics who are highly motivated and eager to pursue world-class research in theoretical quantum nano-optoelectronics. Experience with scientific programming is expected, while familiarity with numerical techniques is advantageous but not required. The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about contributing to cutting-edge research in a dynamic and ambitious young research group, supported by the POLIMA Center and its extensive network of international collaborators.

POLIMA is a Center of Excellence funded by the Danish National Research Foundation (DNRF) for an initial period of 6 years (2023–2028), with the possibility of a 4-year extension. The center is led by Professor N. Asger Mortensen and currently consists of two Professors, three Assistant Professors, a Lab Manager, a Center Administrator, and approximately 10–15 PhD students, postdocs, and visiting scientists. Several POLIMA researchers have attracted prestigious personal grants, e.g., Villum Investigator, Villum Young Investigator, DFF Sapere Aude, Novo Nordisk’s Foundation RECRUIT and Data Science Investigator – Emerging, and Maria Skłodowska-Curie Fellowships. Read more on POLIMA’s website.

We offer a competitive and highly collaborative research environment with close interaction between experimental and theoretical activities. You will join a thriving community of researchers and benefit from a strong network of international collaborators. Our work environment is supportive, dynamic, and designed to foster creativity and the development of innovative projects.

 

We offer:

• A PhD student position in an ambitious and supportive, international research environment.

• A dedicated supervisor research team to support the academic development of the PhD student.

• Access to state-of-the-art equipment, facilities, and infrastructure.

• A competitive salary and social benefits (e.g., health coverage, parental leave, social security, etc.) (https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/international-staff/getting-settled)

POLIMA is located at the University of Southern Denmark in Odense – 1h15min by train from Copenhagen Airport. The University of Southern Denmark offers dedicated assistance and support with various practical, social, and legal aspects (housing, visa, administration, tax, etc.), especially for international candidates through our international staff office (ISO) and the administrative staff at POLIMA.

 

For further information and details about the position, application, and the research center, please contact Assistant Professor Paulo André Dias Gonçalves (padgo@mci.sdu.dk).

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (copy of original and an official English translation).  

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is 31 December, 2026, at 11:59 PM / 23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process. 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The preferred start date is 1 March 2026 (may be adjusted by mutual agreement) or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

title: FAÇADE DECORATOR / STUCCO WORKER / SPECIALIST MASON
description:
Are you an experienced craftsman with a passion for traditional craftsmanship and decorative work?

We are a Danish construction company specialising in high-end properties, historic and listed buildings, and projects that require a high level of craftsmanship and attention to detail.

We are looking for an experienced façade decorator, stucco worker or specialist mason with proven experience in decorative façade work and traditional building techniques.

The ideal candidate will have several years of experience working with cornices, mouldings, ornaments, decorative façades, stucco and detailed plasterwork, and will know how to recreate and restore decorative features with the precision and quality required when working on historic and architecturally significant buildings.

We are not necessarily looking for a traditional bricklayer. What is most important to us is that you are highly skilled in your craft and have genuine experience with decorative and ornamental work carried out using traditional methods.

We are looking for someone who:

● Has solid and documented experience in façade decoration, stucco work or specialist masonry

● Has experience working on historic, older or listed buildings

● Is experienced in traditional techniques and materials

● Has a strong eye for detail, proportions and high-quality finishes

● Is able to work independently and take responsibility for the quality of their work

● Understands and respects the original architecture of historic buildings

● Can provide professional references and preferably photographs of previous projects

What we offer

You will become part of a professional team working on exclusive and unique properties and projects where traditional craftsmanship and attention to detail are highly valued.

You will have the opportunity to work on challenging and interesting projects where your experience and specialist skills are genuinely appreciated.

Salary will be negotiated according to qualifications and experience.

If you have the experience, craftsmanship and passion for the details that make a difference, we would be very interested in hearing from you.

Please send us a short application, CV and, if possible, photographs and references from previous work.

We look forward to hearing from you and discussing the possibility of you joining our team.

Contact us for an informal conversation about the position.

Best regards, Ali

title: Experienced Massage Therapist – AIRE Ancient Baths Copenhagen
description:
The role:

As a Massage Therapist in our Copenhagen team, your role is to ensure clients' well-being by performing relaxing and cosmetic treatments following our established protocols. You'll also maintain our relaxation spaces in top condition with all the necessary materials for a perfect AIRE experience.

Key responsibilities:
Customer Experience:

  • Deliver relaxing treatments, including body and facial treatments and exfoliations, following AIRE's protocols and techniques for each.

  • Clearly communicate treatment details and product information to clients, following our provided manual and protocols.

  • Keep an ample supply of necessary products for customer experiences, promptly reporting any shortages or low stock.

  • Maintain consistency in couples' treatments and coordinate effectively with partner therapists for a seamless experience.

Workplace:

  • Keep work areas clean and ready for customer experiences per company protocols.

  • Supervise facility sanitation, product maintenance, and cleaning between treatments.

  • Ensure environmental conditions meet protocol standards for noise, temperature, and humidity.

You'll receive thorough training to explore our diverse range of treatments and truly grasp the essence of AIRE's unique approach.

We're excited to welcome you to our team in Copenhagen and invite you to immerse yourself in the AIRE experience!

Who we are looking for:

  • You have at least one year of experience in a similar role.

  • You hold a valid Massage Therapist course or certification

  • Fluent in English, and if you know Danish, that's a fantastic bonus!

  • You're genuinely customer-focused and excel at connecting with people

  • Your schedule is flexible, allowing you to work evenings, holidays, and weekends when necessary

Why you should join us:

  • Salary: Your hourly salary will be 182DKK

  • Permanent Contract and Working Hours: You will have a permanent contract with 20 hours per week

  • Working days: Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

  • Supplement Pay: You will earn a supplement pay on weekends and holidays

  • Additional Pay Opportunities: You can earn extra pay through tips.

  • Career Progression: Explore career progression opportunities within our Therapists team: Senior Therapist, Supervisor, Manager

  • Pension Contribution: AIRE will contribute to your pension scheme

  • Referral Program: Get rewarded for referring potential colleagues

  • Birthday Gift: Enjoy an AIRE experience on your birthday!

  • Discounts: Benefit from 30% off on all our AIRE experiences

  • Canteen Perks: Access to coffee at our canteen, and fruits on the weekends!

  • Inclusive Work Environment: At AIRE, team spirit is our greatest asset! We are proud to have a welcoming and inclusive work environment where everyone's opinions and backgrounds are heard and respected.

Copenhagen location
You will be delighted with our place in Copenhagen, located in the Carlsberg Byen district, where the former Carlsberg factory has been given a new lease of life and now is part of the magical AIRE atmosphere.

About AIRE:

AIRE Ancient Baths offer a timeless relaxation experience, inspired by ancient Roman, Greek, and Ottoman traditions, set in restored historical buildings in major global cities.

At AIRE, we're delighted to have a global presence with eight established centers in cities such as NYC, Chicago, London, Copenhagen, Barcelona, Sevilla, Almeria, and Vallromanes. Looking ahead, we're excited about our upcoming Upper East Side and Toronto facilities in 2024.

Varasem kogemus autoremondi vallas vähemalt aasta.

Tööülesanded: Meil on töökojas tõstukid, tööriistad, õli, rooste, katkised autod ja aeg-ajalt ka klient, kes vannub, et “enne teie juurde tulekut oli kõik korras”.
Kui sa ei minesta rooste peale, ei hakka nutma kinnise poldi pärast ja tead, et “kliendi sõber juba vaatas” tähendab tavaliselt uut õudusfilmi kapoti all — siis räägime. Puudu on veel üks **autoremondi lukksepp**, kes ei hakka nutma, kui polt on kinni, käsi on must või kapoti alt vaatab vastu järjekordne “kodune remont”.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meie poolt:
🔥 normaalne palk — kui oskad, siis saad ka raha; 🔥 päris töö, mitte niisama kapoti silitamine; 🔥 seltskond, kus nalja saab ja lumehelbekesed sulavad kiiresti; 🔥 tööriided, lisasoodustused; 🔥 autod, mille kallal saad oma viha seaduslikult välja elada.

Muud nõuded: Ootame sind, kui:
✅ tead, et haamer ei ole alati vägivald — vahel on see diagnostikavahend; ✅ saad aru, et “klõbin ees vasakul” võib tähendada kõike alates kondist kuni täieliku katastroofini; ✅ ei arva, et piduritoru paikamine teibiga on loominguline lahendus; ✅ oskad autot remontida nii, et see pärast ka päriselt töötab; ✅ sul on töötahe suurem kui soov reede pärastlõunal kella vaadata.

title: Mehaanik-hooldustehnik
description:
Otsime kuldsete käte ja tehnilise taibuga probleemilahendajat

Tööülesanded: Eesti Puu OÜ otsib oma meeskonda inimest, kellele masinad ja tehnika ei ole lihtsalt töövahendid, vaid kes tahab ka aru saada, kuidas need töötavad ja miks need vahel ei tööta.
Otsime praktilise mõtlemisega tehnikut, kes tunneb mehaanikat, elektrit ja hüdraulikat, saab hakkama keevitamisega ning ei karda ette võtta ka sellist tehnilist probleemi, millele esmapilgul valmis lahendust ei ole. Sinu peamised tööülesanded - tootmisseadmete, masinate ja muu tehnika hooldus ning remont; - mehaaniliste rikete tuvastamine ja kõrvaldamine; - elektriliste rikete otsimine ja võimalusel kõrvaldamine; - hüdraulika- ja pneumosüsteemide hooldus ning remont; - keevitus- ja metallitööd; - laagrite, kettide, rihmade, mootorite, reduktorite, pumpade, silindrite jm komponentide vahetamine ja remont; - seadmete ennetav hooldus, et vältida ootamatuid seisakuid; - tehniliste probleemide põhjuste väljaselgitamine ja praktiliste lahenduste leidmine; - olemasolevate seadmete täiustamine, ümberehitamine ja parendamine; - tööriistade ja tehniliste seadmete korrashoid; - vajadusel suhtlemine varuosade ja remonditeenuste pakkujatega; - muud ettevõtte tehnika ja seadmete toimimisega seotud tööd.

Omalt poolt pakume: - konkurentsivõimelist töötasu vastavalt Sinu oskustele ja kogemusele;
- stabiilset ja pikaajalist töösuhet; - väga mitmekesist tööd – päevad ja tehnilised probleemid ei ole kunagi ühesugused; - võimalust oma teadmisi ja oskusi päriselt rakendada; - võimalust ise tehnilisi lahendusi välja pakkuda ja ellu viia; - tööks vajalikke tööriistu ja vahendeid; - toetavat meeskonda

Muud nõuded: Ootame Sinult:
- head eesti ja vene keele oskust - vähemalt B-kategooria juhilubasid (C-kategooria tuleb kasuks) - head arusaamist mehaanikast; - teadmisi elektrist ja elektriseadmetest; - hüdraulika tundmist; - keevitusoskust; - oskust kasutada tavapäraseid metalli- ja remonditööriistu; - võimet iseseisvalt rikke põhjust otsida ja lahenduseni jõuda; - oskust lugeda või mõista tehnilisi skeeme ja jooniseid; - praktilist mõtlemist ja leidlikkust; - kohusetundlikkust ja vastutustunnet; - heaperemehelikku suhtumist ettevõtte masinatesse ja töövahenditesse; - valmisolekut tegeleda väga erinevate tehniliste ülesannetega. - Sind iseloomustab eelkõige tehniline taip ja soov asjad tööle saada Sa ei pea olema kõigis valdkondades diplomeeritud spetsialist. Kui Sul on tugev praktiline kogemus, kuldsed käed ja tehniline mõtlemine ning Sa oskad vajadusel ka ise lahenduse välja nuputada, tahame Sinuga kindlasti rääkida. Kasuks tuleb varasem töökogemus tootmises, masinaehituses, põllumajandus- või metsatehnikaga, autode või rasketehnikaga, tööstusseadmete hoolduses või mõnes muus tehnilises valdkonnas.

title: Breakfast Cook
description:
Work tasks: Kolm Õde boutique hotel (Pikk 71, Tallinn Old Town) is looking for a breakfast chef to join our team. Our breakfast is a buffet focused on Estonian produce and bread and pastries baked on site, and it is open to guests of the hotel and our apartments as well as to outside visitors.
Your main duties: - preparing hot and cold breakfast dishes (egg dishes, porridges, hot sides, salads, cold cuts, smoked fish, etc.); - baking bread, buns and morning pastries on site; - setting up the buffet before opening and keeping it replenished during breakfast; - taking care of the taste, freshness and attractive presentation of the food; - preparing for the next day (doughs, prep work, etc.); - monitoring stock, preparing orders and receiving deliveries; - following food hygiene and self-monitoring (HACCP) requirements, checking temperatures and shelf life; - keeping the kitchen, equipment and tools clean and in order; - working closely with the breakfast server and reception, and helping develop the menu. You are responsible for making sure every morning starts with a tasty, fresh and beautifully presented breakfast for our guests.

We offer: - Work in a unique setting: Kolm Õde boutique hotel is housed in three medieval merchant houses in the heart of Tallinn Old Town.
- The opportunity to bring your own ideas to the menu. - Morning working hours – your evenings stay free. - Work uniform. - A small, friendly team and international guests. - A central location that is easy to reach by public transport.

Other requirements: - Previous experience as a cook (experience with breakfast service, hotel kitchens or baking is a big plus).
- Valid health certificate (tervisetõend). - Willingness to work early mornings, as well as on Saturdays and Sundays. - Cleanliness, accuracy, independence and good time management. - A desire to cook tasty, beautifully presented food and to help develop our new breakfast concept.

Option to work from home: No

Work tasks: - Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages.
- Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Open and close the restaurant in accordance with approved Company procedures and checklists, ensuring that all required opening and closing tasks are properly and fully completed. - Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. - Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. - Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. - Guide, supervise, train, and support servers and other assigned employees; Office responsibilities: • Provide general administrative support to the CEO and wider management team. • Manage the CEO’s diary, appointments, meetings and reminders. • Organise meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes and follow up on agreed actions. • Maintain accurate customer, distributor and supplier information in the company CRM. • Prepare and issue customer invoices, credit notes and supporting documentation. • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate payment follow-ups. • Conduct research for the CEO, including suppliers, customers, distributors, competitors, logistics providers and new markets. • Prepare reports, presentations, spreadsheets and business correspondence. • Manage office documents, digital filing and confidential company information. • Coordinate travel arrangements, visits and external meetings when required. • Assist with purchasing, quotations and communication with service providers. • Support recruitment administration and employee-document management. • Monitor deadlines and ensure important actions are completed on time. Food-safety responsibilities • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Dal’s Kitchen food-safety and quality-management system. • Help maintain BRCGS, HACCP, food-safety, quality and operational records. • Plan, conduct and document scheduled internal food-safety and BRCGS audits. • Support external BRCGS and customer audits by preparing documentation, evidence and follow-up information. • Maintain the internal audit schedule and monitor completion against deadlines. • Record non-conformities and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with responsible team members. • Follow up corrective actions and verify that they have been completed effectively. • Assist with document control, including procedures, work instructions, forms and records. • Review production, cleaning, temperature, traceability, allergen and hygiene records for completeness. • Support traceability exercises, product-recall tests and other compliance checks. • Assist with supplier approval, specifications, certificates and food-safety documentation. • Monitor staff training records and help organise refresher training. • Report food-safety concerns, overdue actions and compliance risks to the CEO. • Help ensure the site remains prepared for announced and unannounced audits. BRCGS Food Safety Issue 9 provides a framework covering product safety, integrity, legality, quality and operational controls within food manufacturing; official certification is completed by an independent certification body, while this position would conduct internal audits and support certification audits.

We offer: What we offer
• A varied position with direct involvement in business operations and food safety. • The opportunity to work closely with the CEO and gain experience across multiple business functions. • Practical exposure to BRCGS, HACCP and food-manufacturing compliance. • Training and development relevant to the position. • The opportunity to grow with Dal’s Kitchen as the company develops. • Salary based on experience and qualifications.

Other requirements: • Väga hea eesti- ning inglise keele oskus, vene keel on eelis, kuid mitte kohustuslik. • Kehtiv B-kategooria juhiluba ja valmisolek regulaarseks reisimiseks Eestis ja välismaal. • Suurepärane suhtlemis-, läbirääkimis- ja esinemisoskus. • Tugev ärisuhete loomise võime ning praktiline, tulemustele orienteeritud tööstiil. • Hea MS Office’i kasutusoskus (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) ning kogemus CRM-i või müügiaruandluse tööriistadega. description:
Work tasks: - Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages.
- Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Open and close the restaurant in accordance with approved Company procedures and checklists, ensuring that all required opening and closing tasks are properly and fully completed. - Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. - Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. - Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. - Guide, supervise, train, and support servers and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. - Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth restaurant operations. - Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. - Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. - Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. - Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. - Manage and participate in continuous improvement of operations. We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: • Previous experience in restaurant operations and staff supervision, including coordinating, guiding, and monitoring servers, cleaners, or other operational employees.
• Strong ability to organize daily operations, prioritize tasks, distribute work, monitor employee performance, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed. • Experience with staff scheduling, task allocation, production planning, inventory and stock control, ordering, receiving deliveries, stocktaking, write-offs, and waste control. • Strong customer-service and communication skills, including experience handling customer requests, complaints, order problems, and other service-related issues. • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with employees, management, suppliers, contractors, technicians, and other service providers. • Good computer skills, including experience with POS and inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, scheduling, reporting, and basic business documentation. • Strong leadership, organizational, planning, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously. • Trustworthy, responsible, reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to remain professional and solution-oriented during busy or challenging situations.

description:
**Kiinnostaako monipuolinen työ sähkön, koneiden ja kunnossapidon parissa? Haluatko kehittää osaamistasi käytännön työssä ja oppia uutta?**

Toimintamme laajentuessa etsimme huoltoasentajaa Turun toimipisteeseemme. Etsimme tehtävään sähköalan osaajaa tai alasta kiinnostunutta, oppimishaluista tekijää. Aiempi kokemus vastaavista tehtävistä on eduksi, mutta ei välttämätöntä.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat:

- Asiakkaidemme tuotantolaitteiden ja nosturien huollot ja korjaukset

- Sähköasennukset ja sähkökorjaukset

- Sähkömoottorien, hitsauskoneiden, painepesurien ja muiden pienkoneiden huollot toimipisteessämme

- Monipuoliset mekaaniset ja sähköiset korjaustyöt


Työskentelet sekä asiakkaidemme tiloissa että omassa toimipisteessämme Turussa. Työkohteet sijaitsevat pääasiassa Varsinais-Suomen ja Satakunnan alueella, noin 50 kilometrin säteellä Turusta. Käytössäsi on työnantajan huoltoauto työtehtävien hoitamiseen.

Toivomme sinulta:

- Sähköalan tai muun tehtävään soveltuvan alan koulutusta tai muuten hankittua osaamista

- Kiinnostusta sähkö- ja konetekniikkaan sekä halua oppia uutta

- Oma-aloitteista, joustavaa ja luotettavaa työotetta

- Reipasta asennetta ja valmiutta tarttua monipuolisiin työtehtäviin


Aiempi alan työkokemus ei ole välttämätöntä. Voimme myös kouluttaa tehtävään motivoituneen ja oppimishaluisen tekijän.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Monipuolisen ja vaihtelevan työn sähkö- ja konehuollon parissa

- Vakaan työpaikan osaavassa ja kehittyvässä yrityksessä

- Mahdollisuuden kouluttautua ja kehittää ammattitaitoasi

- Osaamisesi mukaisen kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen

- Liikuntaedun

title: Service Instructor
description:
**Join us as a Service Instructor in hotel cleaning services in Turku!**

Are you an experienced cleaning services professional interested in a guiding role where you can support the team in their daily work and help ensure high-quality service? With us, work is carried out responsibly as part of a reliable team.

You will work as a Service Instructor under the supervision of your manager and have a key role in ensuring the smooth operation and quality of cleaning services at the customer site. You work responsibly and ensure that all tasks are carried out safely and in accordance with our shared quality standards and operating procedures. You act as a key link between employees, management and the customer, supporting your manager, but the role does not include actual managerial responsibility.

Customer service plays a central role in this position, and succeeding in the role requires a customer-oriented mindset and good interpersonal skills. In your role, you have a direct impact on the customer experience and the smooth running of the customer relationship. Active cooperation, clear communication and a solution-oriented approach are therefore essential.

**Your duties include, among other things:**

- ensuring the smooth running and quality of daily cleaning work, planning the division of tasks and using resources in a cost-conscious manner

- continuously developing operations together with your manager and actively contributing ideas for improvement

- guiding and onboarding employees and ensuring safe working practices

- customer cooperation

- regularly participating in practical cleaning work


**We expect you to have:**

- experience in cleaning work

- the ability to guide and support the team in everyday situations, promote an equal and respectful working environment, and provide clear feedback

- good organisational skills and a proactive approach

- a customer-friendly approach and a positive attitude

- the ability to work under pressure and solve problems

- the ability to communicate both verbally and in writing in Finnish or English. Language skills play an important role in this guiding position, as they are essential for understanding work instructions, ensuring safe working practices and managing employment-related matters. We value a diverse workplace where different language and cultural backgrounds are considered a strength

- a valid work permit if you are not a Finnish citizen


**We offer you:**

- a permanent, part-time employment contract of 30 hours per week

- shifts on weekdays and weekends, including morning, daytime and evening shifts

- a starting date to be agreed together

title: Perheohjaaja, Lastensuojelun laitospalvelut, Turku
description:

Asiakasperheiden elämäntilanteet ovat usein kriisiytyneitä, ja he tarvitsevat tehostettua lastensuojelullista tukea. Työtäsi ohjaavat suhdeperustainen työote, systeeminen ajattelu sekä muutokseen tähtäävä tavoitteellisuus. Hyödynnät työssäsi mentalisaatio- ja kiintymyssuhdeperusteista arviointia ja kuntoutusta.

Työpaikan osoite on Kunnallissairaalantie 36, 20810 Turku.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen työn lastensuojelun perhekuntoutuksessa, jossa pääset työskentelemään tiiviisti perheiden arjen ja muutoksen tukena.

Saat työsi tueksi säännöllisen työnohjauksen sekä perheterapeutin konsultaation. Työskentelet moniammatillisessa tiimissä, jossa osaamista jaetaan ja kehitetään yhdessä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Arvostamme hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, itseohjautuvuutta sekä kykyä kuunnella ja kohdata empaattisesti. Tärkeää on myös valmius ottaa asioita puheeksi rakentavalla tavalla.

Toivomme sinulta kiintymyssuhdeymmärrystä sekä traumasensitiivistä työotetta. Aikaisempi kokemus lastensuojelutyöstä luetaan eduksi.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on soveltuva sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon korkeakoulututkinto tai aikaisempi opistotasoinen tutkinto. Tehtävässä edellytetään hyvää suomen kielen taitoa.

Odotamme hakemustasi - tule mukaan tekemään vaikuttavaa työtä perheiden kanssa!

title: Diakon
description:
Karis-Pojo svenska församling lediganslår en diakontjänst. Diakoniarbetarna i församlingen utför klient- och påverkansarbete, uppsökande arbete samt organiserar frivilligverksamheten och den samlande verksamheten inom diakonin. Församlingen utvecklar sitt diakonala arbete bland familjer, barn och ungdomar. Till arbetsuppgifterna hör också själavård, att hålla andakter samt att medverka i gudstjänstliv och i församlingens övriga verksamhet enligt behov.

Vi söker dig som har god samarbetsförmåga och förmåga till självständigt arbete.

Du har intresse och förmåga att arbeta med ungdomar, barn och familjer, att utveckla det diakonala arbetet bland dem samt erfarenhet av och förmåga till självständigt och mångsidigt klientarbete.
Uppgifterna kräver ofta förflyttning mellan församlingens olika områden, tillgång till bil är därför önskvärt. Församlingens arbetsspråk är svenska, men i samarbetet med andra aktörer behövs kunskaper i finska. I klientarbetet behövs också andra språk.

Behörighetskrav är fastställda i kyrkans författningssamling nr 162. Språkkrav enligt kap. 8 §4 i kyrkoordningen. Övriga kunskaper än svenska och finska ses som merit.
Lön utbetalas enligt kravgrupp 503 i KyrkTAK.
Den som utses till tjänsten förväntas vara konfirmerad medlem av den evangelisk-lutherska kyrkan (KL 6 §1).
Till ansökan bifogas meritförteckning samt arbetsintyg.
På tjänsten tillämpas sex månaders prövotid.
Den som väljs till tjänsten skall uppvisa i straffregisterlagens 6 § avsedda registerutdrag samt förete intyg över sitt hälsotillstånd.
Arbetet inleds 4.1.2027 eller enligt överenskommelse.
Ansökan inlämnas senast 3.11.2026.
Sökande ombeds reservera torsdag 5.11.2026 för eventuell intervju.

title: Verkkoinsinööri / Power System Engineer
description:

Power Engineering -tiimin tehtävä on auttaa asiakkaitamme heidän projekteissaan tuottamalla heille arvokasta informaatio sähköteknisen laskennan, analyysien ja suunnittelun avulla heidän hankkeissaan.

Tässä tehtävässä roolisi mukautuu osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan – voit keskittyä esimerkiksi verkostolaskentaan, tekniseen suunnitteluun tai asiantuntijatukeen projekteissa. Olemme edelläkävijöitä uusiutuvan energian suunnittelussa ja meillä voit rakentaa juuri sinulle sopivan asiantuntijaroolin, jossa voit hyödyntää ja kehittää osaamistasi. Desprolla työnteko ei ole sidoksissa paikkaan, vaan työtä voi tehdä joustavasti etänä tai toimistoiltamme useilla eri paikkakunnilta.



Tehtäväkenttäsi voi painottua eri tavoin – tässä esimerkkejä mahdollisista vastuualueista:

- Sähköverkon laskentojen tekeminen varmistaen verkon tehokkuuden ja luotettavuuden (kuormanjako-, loistehokapasiteetti-, vikavirta-, komponenttien kuormitus- ja mitoituslaskelmat sekä selektiivisyystarkastelut)


- Maadoituslaskelmat, -tarkastelut ja vaarajänniteselvitykset


- Verkkotietomallien ylläpito, kehittäminen sekä laskenta/analysointi


- Laskentatulosten analysointi ja raportointi suunnittelun tueksi


- Yhteistyö eri sidosryhmien välillä


- Dokumentaation laatiminen


- Osallistuminen sähköverkkosuunnittelun kehitysprojekteihin




Eduksi hakijalle lasketaan:

- Kokemus keski- ja suurjänniteverkkojen laskennasta ja suunnittelusta


- Tuntemus sähköverkon rakenteista ja toimintaperiaatteista


- Uusiutuvan energian järjestelmä- ja laitetuntemus


- Laskentaohjelmistojen (esim. PowerFactory, openDSS, PSCAD, PSS/E, Safegrid, Cableizer) hallinta


- Hyvät ongelmanratkaisu- ja analysointitaidot


- Tarkka, järjestelmällinen ja oma-aloitteinen työote


- Sujuva suomen ja/tai englannin kielen taito




Katsomme eduksi myös oppimishalukkuuden ja sinut perehdytetään työhösi, eli voit hakea työpaikkaa myös, vaikka et vielä osaisi kaikkea edellä mainittua.



Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

- Meillä tehdään merkityksellistä asiantuntijatyötä alan huipulla ja voidaan hyvin. Otamme henkilöstömme hyvinvoinnin ja osallistamisen tosissaan. Toimintaamme ohjaavat luottamus, rohkeus, arvostus ja vastuunotto. Onnistumme yhdessä joukkueena, toisiamme tukien.


- Rakennamme konkreettisin teoin hyvinvoivaa ja innostavaa työyhteisöä, jossa jokainen pääsee loistamaan omilla vahvuuksillaan. Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan niin omaan työhösi kuin asiakkaiden ja koko yhteiskunnan energiatehokkaaseen tulevaisuuteen. Tarjoamme mielenkiintoisia projekteja, erinomaiset henkilökuntaetuudet sekä kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen. Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme viimeisimmät laitteet ja ohjelmistot, jotta työnteko on mahdollisimman sujuvaa. Monipuolisen tehtävänkuvan lisäksi pääset kehittymään huippuasiantuntijoiden joukkueessa, alan edelläkävijäyrityksessä.

title: Financial Manager
description:
Me EMU Growth Partnersilla yhdistämme modernilla tavalla tuotetut taloushallinnon ja palkanlaskennan palvelut monipuoliseen valikoimaan neuvonta-, HR-, laki- ja järjestelmäpalveluita. Haluamme luoda alan parhaan asiakaskokemuksen olemalla yrityksille inhimillinen huolenpitäjä ja luotettava suunnannäyttäjä. Ihmiskeskeiset arvot ovat tekemisemme ytimessä ja se näkyy sekä kuuluu jokaisessa päivässä.

EMU jatkaa kasvuaan ja etsimme uusia työkavereita rempseään joukkoomme! EMU on erilaisista taustoista tulevien ihmisten tiivis yhteisö, toimintamme keskiössä ovat EMUlaiset ja asiakkaat. Meitä EMUlaisia on jo reilu 100 kolmessa eri maassa ja haluamme, että meillä on taloushallintoalan paras yrityskulttuuri.

Haemme nyt joukkoomme uutta Financial Manageria!

Onko konsernitilinpäätös sinulle palapeli, jonka ratkaiseminen palkitsee? Kaipaatko työtä, jossa et jumiudu yhden yrityksen kuukausirutiiniin? Silloin tämä rooli voi olla sinulle.

EMUlla työskentelet useammalle erikokoiselle asiakkaalle, kasvuyrityksistä kansainvälisiin konserneihin. Yhtenä päivänä täsmäytät konsernin eliminointeja, seuraavana rakennat kasvuyritykselle ensimmäistä kunnon ennustemallia. Työsi ytimessä on asiakkaidemme konserniraportointi, ja sen rinnalla laajennat business controlling -tehtäviin asiakkaiden tarpeiden ja oman kiinnostuksesi mukaan. Näet talousjohtamista monesta kulmasta ja kehityt samalla.

Työssäsi:

- Vastaat konserniraportoinnista: Laadit kuukausi- ja kvartaaliraportit sekä koordinoit konsernitilinpäätökset ajallaan maaliin.

- Hoidat konsolidoinnin: Huolehdit sisäisistä eristä ja eliminoinneista, valuuttamuunnoksista, vähemmistöosuuksista sekä konsernirakenteen muutoksista.

- Hallitset työkalut ja rakenteet: Rakennat ja ylläpidät konsolidointityökalujen mappauksia sekä raportointirakenteita.

- Koordinoit ja ohjaat: Toimit yhteyshenkilönä konserniyhtiöiden kirjanpitäjille, ja varmistat aikataulujen, sisäisten saldojen täsmäytysten sekä kuukauden sulkemisen sujuvuuden.

- Ennustat ja raportoit johdolle: Teet konsernitason budjetointia ja ennustamista sekä laadit raportteja johdon ja hallituksen päätöksenteon tueksi.

- Kehität ja sparraat: Toimit yhteyshenkilönä tilintarkastajien suuntaan sekä kehität aktiivisesti asiakkaidemme talousprosesseja ja kontrolleja. Automatisoit toistuvan työn ja otat uusia työkaluja, myös tekoälyä, rohkeasti käyttöön.

Odotamme sinulta:

- Vahva tausta konsernilaskennasta: Vähintään 5 vuoden kokemus konserniraportoinnista ja konsernitilinpäätösten laatimisesta sekä vahva osaaminen erityisesti kirjanpitolain (FAS) mukaisesta konsernitilinpäätöksestä.

- Käytännön kirjanpito- ja järjestelmäosaaminen: Vahva kirjanpidon ja tilinpäätöksen käytännön osaaminen sekä kokemus vähintään yhdestä konsolidointityökalusta.

- Koordinointi- ja johtamistaidot: Hyvät koordinointitaidot ja kyky johtaa tekemistä – saat selkeillä ohjeilla, aikatauluilla ja seurannalla useamman yhtiön ja ihmisen toimittamaan oman osuutensa ajallaan.

- Järjestelmällinen ja tarkka työskentelyote: Pidät kokonaisuuden hallussa myös kiireessä. Huomaat, kun luvut eivät täsmää, ja selvität syyn.

- Selkeät viestintätaidot: Viestit sujuvasti ja selkeästi suomeksi ja englanniksi – niin asiakkaan johdolle kuin konserniyhtiöiden tekijöille. Ruotsin kielitaito on plussaa, mutta ei välttämätöntä.

Eduksi katsomme:

- BrightAnalytics-osaaminen

- IFRS-osaaminen

- Tilintarkastus- tai konsulttitausta

- Kokemusta kasvuyhtiöistä

- Vastuullisuusraportoinnin (ESG) tuntemus

Mitä tarjoamme:

- Nykyaikaiset työvälineet ja erinomaiset edut, mm. lounas-, työmatka-, terveys-, hieronta-, liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun sekä kattavan työterveyshuollon.

- Etätyömahdollisuuden ja joustavuuden oman osaamisen kehittämiseen.

- Jäykästä hierarkiasta vapaan työyhteisön.

- Persoonalliset, motivoituneet ja innostuneet kollegat.

title: Project Engineer – HVAC Systems, Shipbuilding
description:
We are looking for an experienced Project Engineer to take technical responsibility for HVAC systems in demanding shipbuilding projects. In this role, you will manage system design and development from the basic design phase through procurement, approvals, testing, commissioning and production support.

You will act as the technical owner and primary specialist for your assigned systems, ensuring that solutions meet project requirements and comply with shipyard, shipowner, authority and classification society standards. The position combines hands-on engineering with multidisciplinary coordination, supplier cooperation and technical decision-making related to quality, functionality and cost. The work will be carried out at our customers premises in Helsinki or Turku area. Depending on the project, you may also work remotely.



Systems within your scope may include

· heating, cooling and air conditioning

· fire Extinguishing systems

· water treatment systems



Key responsibilities

· take technical ownership of the assigned HVAC system throughout the project and ensure compliance with client, shipyard, authority and classification society requirements.

· prepare, maintain, and submit comprehensive technical documentation—including system and piping diagrams, component lists, material information, system descriptions, calculations, and arrangements—for approval by the client, classification society, and relevant authorities.

· define equipment, components and materials, prepare technical procurement specifications, evaluate supplier proposals and provide technical support for purchasing.

· manage system-related changes and assess their impact on interfaces with other systems.

· coordinate with other designers, shipbuilding, production, project personnel and suppliers to ensure functional system interfaces.

· prepare test programmes, participate in FAT inspections and technical reviews, and support commissioning.

· provide technical support to production and resolve design- and installation-related issues.



What we expect from you

· a degree in mechanical engineering, HVAC engineering or another relevant technical field.

· at least five years of relevant experience in the design or development of one or more of the listed HVAC-related systems.

· experience in shipbuilding and an understanding of marine project practices.

· knowledge of equipment sizing, system calculations, material and component selection, and technical documentation.

· experience working with classification society, authority or client requirements.

· proficiency in AutoCAD or MagiCAD; experience with relevant project, document or material management systems is an advantage.

· strong coordination, problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills.

· good command of English, Finnish language skills are considered an advantage.



The salary range for this position is approximately €4,500–5,500 per month.



What we offer

We offer you a diverse and interesting role and the opportunity to influence your own job description. With us, you will take part in varied projects and be surrounded by an excellent and inspiring network of colleagues.

According to our personnel survey, Comatecs strengths are meaningful work tasks, skilled colleagues and a healthy work-life balance.

At Comatec, you can contribute to the solutions of tomorrow. We look forward to receiving your application.

You can learn more about Comatec and what it's like to work with us here [https://www.comatec.fi/en/]



Interested?

Please submit your application and CV, including your salary request as soon as possible, but no later than 1st November 2026 via our recruitment system. We review applications already during the application period.

For security reasons, we only accept applications through our recruitment system. We do not process applications sent by email.

Please note that we require applicants to have a valid work or residence permit to work in Finland or the EU-area.

For more information about the position, please contact Engineering Manager, Marine Industry Mrs. Paula Rivasto


050 575 0716 (available on Tuesdays, 20th and 27th October, from 13:30 to 15:00)
paula.rivasto@comatec.fi



Comatec Group

Comatec is a group of 550 professionals with twenty locations in Finland, Sweden, Poland, Estonia, and Romania. As a leading engineering company, we solve technological challenges for companies that deliver the best solutions to their own customers – regardless of industry.

Comatec professionals are particularly strong in projects related to working machines, commercial vehicles, industrial automation, the marine industry, and machine modernizations, as well as material handling, production systems, power plants, and boilers. Our focus is firmly on growth and internationalization. Therefore, we are continuously looking for new experts, especially in the fields of mechanical, electrical, and automation design, as well as project management. Join us!
