title: Join Landspítali as a Consultant in Respiratory Medicine in Iceland
description:
We are seeking a Consultant in Respiratory Medicine to join Landspítali University Hospital, with a start date of 1 November 2026 or as otherwise agreed.
The position is full-time; however, a lower employment ratio may be considered by mutual agreement.

Our Department of Pulmonary Medicine consists of a strong and ambitious team of physicians managing a broad range of clinical responsibilities in close collaboration with other healthcare professionals. We are looking for a dedicated and motivated specialist who wishes to contribute to highly specialised care and follow-up of patients with respiratory diseases.

Why Join Landspítali?

At Landspítali, we offer:
•    A stimulating and rewarding consultant-level position at Iceland's national university hospital, with diverse and interesting clinical responsibilities.
•    A 36-hour work week that supports a healthy work-life balance.
•    Close collaboration with experienced multidisciplinary teams and specialists across a range of clinical disciplines.
•    An academic environment where clinical practice, research, teaching, and innovation go hand in hand.
•    A supportive workplace that values staff wellbeing, professional development, and continuous learning.
•    Opportunities to learn Icelandic, including language courses offered partly during working hours during the first two years of employment.
•    The opportunity to live and work in Iceland and enjoy a high quality of life in a safe and well-functioning society.
•    Easy access to spectacular nature, clean air, and year-round outdoor activities, including hiking, skiing, geothermal bathing, and unique natural experiences.

Duties and Responsibilities
•    Care of patients on hospital wards and in the intensive care unit.
•    Outpatient clinics and day-ward services involving a broad range of pulmonary conditions, including but not limited to:
   o    Interstitial lung diseases
   o    Severe asthma
   o    Lung cancer diagnostics and follow up
   o    Advanced COPD and other late-stage obstructive lung diseases
   o    Acute and chronic respiratory failure
   o    Home mechanical ventilation and other ventilatory support therapies
•    Performance of interventional procedures, including:
   o    Bronchoscopy
   o    Pleural procedures/thoracentesis
   o    Exercise testing (cardiopulmonary excercise testing)
•    Participation in the pulmonary medicine on-call service.
•    Participation in acute internal medicine services, including on-call duties, as agreed with the Head of Pulmonary Medicine.
•    Teaching and supervision of medical students, intern/foundation doctors, and specialty trainees.
•    Participation in research activities.
•    Other duties as agreed with the Head of Department.

Qualifications
•    Specialist certification in Pulmonology/Respiratory Medicine.
•    Icelandic medical licence and specialist recognition in Pulmonology, or eligibility to obtain these credentials.
•    Broad knowledge and experience in Internal Medicine and Pulmonology.
•    Proven ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
•    Positive attitude, flexibility, and strong collaborative skills.
•    Experience in teaching and research is considered an advantage.

Additional Information
A full-time position is exclusively affiliated with the hospital in accordance with Article 3.3 of the current collective agreement between physicians and the Icelandic State.

The position is available from 1 November 2026 or by mutual agreement. The application deadline is 23 October 2026.

For further information, please contact:
Sif Hansdóttir, Consultant Physician
E-mail: sifhan@landspitali.is

Application Requirements
Applications should include information on:
•    Previous employment, education, and professional qualifications
•    Positions of trust and references

Mandatory Attachments
•    Certified copies of degree certificates and specialist qualifications/licences
•    Curriculum Vitae (CV), including teaching, research, and leadership experience
•    List of scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals. Applicants should either provide a link to their Google Scholar profile or submit publication documentation from PubMed.
•    Cover letter describing the applicant's qualifications and interest in the position

All attachments must be submitted in PDF format.

Selected candidates will be invited for interviews. Appointment decisions will be based on interviews and submitted documentation. Recruitment is conducted in accordance with Landspítali's Equal Opportunities Policy. All applicants will be informed of the outcome of the recruitment process.

Information regarding residence and work permits is available on our website.
To apply for the position, click the dark blue button "Sækja um starf" (Apply for Position). You may then switch the website language to English and log in to the Icelandic Government's recruitment system.

About Landspítali
Landspítali is a dynamic and diverse workplace where approximately 7,000 employees work in multidisciplinary teams and in close collaboration across professional groups. The hospital's vision is to provide healthcare of the highest quality, based on science, professionalism, and compassion, delivered by skilled staff and supported by modern facilities and a positive working environment.
Landspítali is certified according to the Icelandic Equal Pay Standard ÍST 85:2012. The certification has been awarded following an audit conducted by Versa Vottun ehf.

Applications may remain valid for up to six months from the publication date of the advertisement, in accordance with Icelandic Government Regulation No. 1000/2019 on the advertisement of vacant public positions, as amended.

title: Driller
description:
Iceland Drilling Company (IDC) is an international leader in geothermal drilling, committed to providing safe and efficient drilling solutions with a focus on sustainability. We take pride in operating advanced, automatic drilling rigs that create a safe and positive working environment for our highly motivated crew members. Currently, we are seeking skilled assistant driller to join our team for a long-term geothermal drilling projects.

Position Overview:
As a driller, you will be responsible for operating and supervising the drilling operations on the rig. You will ensure that all drilling activities are conducted safely, efficiently, and in compliance with company standards and regulations. Your expertise will be critical to maintaining the smooth operation of the drilling process and ensuring that all objectives are met.

Key Responsibilities:
• Operate drilling equipment and supervise the drilling crew to ensure efficient and safe operations.
• Ensure the maintenance and proper functioning of drilling equipment and tools.
• Monitor drilling parameters and adjust operations to optimize drilling performance.
• Ensure adherence to safety protocols, maintaining a focus on the well-being of the crew and compliance with industry standards.
• Provide training, guidance, and leadership to junior crew members.
• Communicate effectively with the Tool Pusher, engineers, and other staff to assess drilling progress and resolve any issues.
• Maintain detailed records of drilling operations and report progress to management.
• Manage equipment and materials to ensure smooth operations and prevent delays.

Qualifications and Requirements:
• Minimum of 5 years’ drilling experience as a Driller in geothermal drilling.
• Experience with Drillmec rigs and/or Bentec Euro Rig 350 is highly preferred.
• Current IWCF Well Control Certificate Level 3 or higher is required.
• Strong communication skills and fluency in English.
• Forklift license for 10 tons +
• Excellent organizational, planning, and leadership abilities.
• Ability to work under pressure and in challenging environments.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make quick decisions.
• Safety-conscious with a commitment to maintaining high safety standards.

Employer can assist with housing

Full time job – shift work; work arrangements vary depending on the project.
Wages according to collective agreements with Framsýn workers union.

title: Assistant Archivist
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Role Profile The successful candidate will report to the Librarian & Archivist, to process and catalogue incoming collections of archives and promote the content of the Library’s extensive holdings. The candidate will be part of the Library team and contribute to its ongoing work and outreach. Background The Library of the Representative Church Body provides a repository for the Church of Ireland’s archives, manuscripts and related objects which tell the story of the Church’s community. These include records from parishes throughout Ireland, the archives of the Church’s dioceses, cathedrals, architectural drawings, the administrative records of the Representative Church Body and its multiple committees, and thousands of manuscripts relating to the Church’s people, buildings and activities, spanning from medieval times to the present. Some have relevance for a worldwide research audience, and public engagement with that audience is an important Library function. Specific Responsibilities • Assisting in the processing and cataloguing of incoming collections; • Updating and uploading finding aids to the Library’s web pages; • Contributing to the Library’s ongoing digitization projects including managing projects on a book scanner and digital slide scanner; • Assisting visitors and answering public enquires; • Initiating and managing exhibition projects and contributing to raising the profile of the Library and its varied collections; • Oher projects and tasks as may be assigned by the Librarian and Archivist. Person Specification Education / Training Essential • A primary degree in history or other relevant discipline • A recognised postgraduate qualification in archive or library studies Desirable • Professional member of the ARA (Archives and Records Management Association) Experience Essential • A minimum of three years’ experience working in an archive, including at least one year’s experience in a religious archive. • Experience digitising archival materials across multiple formats (including paper records, photographic material, and slides) • Proven experience of completing archival projects in a systematic and timely fashion • Experience of collaboration, teamwork and building relationships Desirable • Knowledge of latest digitisation systems (eg. Book2Net Lizard, Tocosa, Silverfast9). Knowledge / Skills Essential • Excellent communication skills including making presentations and engaging with relevant stakeholders • Experience curating small displays for exhibition • Proficient in Microsoft Access (including database management and reporting) • Experience in developing and managing websites and organisational social media accounts, including updating content and maintaining an online presence. • Excellent organisational and inter-personal skills with proven ability to work to deadlines and prioritise workloads Desirable • Experience researching and writing content for publications including online and print content

title: Care Support Worker
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
We are currently seeking compassionate and dedicated care support worker to join us in Leixlip Oaks and Maynooth Oaks residential settings. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in enhancing the quality of life for those we serve - residential care activities for the elderly and disable. Key role in supporting Brindley Healthcare Services Team with providing exceptional quality care to clients of any stage of their life who wish to remain independent. The services support people with a range of needs, which may include autism, acquired brain injuries, behaviours of concern, intellectual disabilities alongside Alzheimer’s disease or dementia, mental health rehabilitation and recovery and personality disorders. Support must always be tailored to the individual and delivered respectfully, safely, and in accordance with the person’s support plan. Key Responsibilities: * Support individuals to plan, organise, and participate in daily activities and routines in line with their choices, abilities, assessed needs, and support plans. * Promote autonomy, dignity, privacy, inclusion, choice, and decision-making, while supporting individuals to achieve their personal goals and outcomes. * Assist with developing and maintaining independent living skills, including cooking, cleaning, laundry, personal organisation, and other everyday tasks, as identified in the support plan. * Provide personal care and assistance with eating, dressing, hygiene, mobility, or other daily living activities where required, authorised, and included in the individual’s support plan. * Support individuals to access education, training, appointments, recreation, and community activities, helping them build skills and maintain meaningful family and social connections. * Offer companionship, reassurance, and emotional support while maintaining appropriate professional boundaries. * Use respectful, clear, and person-centred communication, taking account of individual communication preferences and support needs. * Support positive relationships and meaningful participation in the home and wider community, including access to outdoor spaces and activities where appropriate. * Follow individual support plans, risk assessments, safeguarding procedures, and agreed guidance from the relevant team and professionals. * Observe and promptly report changes in an individual’s presentation, wellbeing, behaviour, support needs, or circumstances to the PIC or designated manager. * Promote the safety, rights, and welfare of people who avail of the service; report safeguarding concerns, incidents, accidents, near misses, hazards, and risks without delay in line with policy. * Maintain accurate, timely, factual, and confidential records of support provided, activities, observations, and relevant incidents. Qualifications & Skills: QQI Level 5 Healthcare Support (or relevant modules) preferred. Previous experience in a healthcare or home care setting. Compassionate, flexible, and committed.

title: Assistant Restaurant Manager – The Stables Brasserie and Bar
description:

You must have extensive knowledge of food, wine and beverage and food, wine and beverage service and have previous hotel luxury restaurant experience. Attention to detail is paramount and this role will suit someone who is meticulous about his or her work with a great eye and attention to details. Guest and team satisfaction is of the utmost importance to the ideal candidate, and they will be able to relate with people at all levels and is an excellent communicator. We are looking for an assistant team leader, with an in-depth knowledge of food, wine, and beverage and a very strong focus on customer and staff service and staff training, development and retention to join and share the leadership of the team. description:

Role: Reinstatement Planner Location: Cillin Hill, Leggettsrath, Co. Kilkenny Hours of work: 39 hours per week Pay: €37,000 per year Due to exceptional company growth across Ireland Shareridge requires a Reinstatement Planner to join the team. The Reinstatement Planner is a highly technical role responsible for the end-to-end operational planning, scheduling, and strategic resource management of reinstatement works following civil water works. This position ensures all backfilling and permanent surface reinstatements comply mathematically and structurally with national specifications, local authority guidelines, and Uisce Éireann frameworks. This is not an administrative ticketing position; it requires rigorous technical planning, risk mitigation, and civil engineering logic to optimize regional site execution. You will work on the 21/050 Uisce Éireann (Irish Water) and Shareridge Framework that is providing water and wastewater network services and works throughout Ireland. Key Responsibilities & Duties: Technical Program Scheduling: Construct, optimize, and maintain complex multi-site master schedules for civil reinstatement crews and specialised subcontractors across the Southeast and Midlands Region. Resource Optimization: Analyse and allocate heavy plant machinery, civil materials (asphalt, concrete, aggregates), and specialized labour units to guarantee maximum resource yield and minimal project downtime. Civil Timeline & Dependency Management: calculate critical paths for reinstatement phases, and mitigate project delays caused by structural constraints, weather dependencies, or traffic management requirements. Stakeholder & Regulatory Compliance: Interface directly with local authorities, Uisce Éireann technical teams, and Shareridge management team and regional engineers to coordinate road opening licenses (MRL System), street works compliance, and handovers. Feasibility & Operational Analysis: Review physical site parameters, engineering survey data, and dimensional scope metrics to perform feasibility assessments and determine ideal material deployment. Performance Assurance: Monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), generating engineering-centric data models on output capacity, resource gaps, and structural reinstatement quality. Risk & H&S Alignment: Evaluate regional site risks and ensure planning schedules align with strict Shareridge Health & Safety guidelines, specific site restrictions, Quality and environmental protection protocols. Required Qualifications & Experience: Education: A Bachelor's degree or higher diploma in Construction Management, Project Management or a related technical field. Minimum of 1 year of proven operational planning or scheduling experience within utility sectors. Technical Competencies: Proficient with professional project management and planning software. Skills: Strong analytical capabilities to manipulate spatial and scheduling data along with excellent communication skills.

title: commerciante al dettaglio
description: Nova Coop: 68 punti vendita, 4.629 dipendenti, 583.000 Soci. Una realtà strutturata, dove la gestione di ogni punto vendita contribuisce concretamente ai risultati dell'intera organizzazione. Per la provincia di Torino cerchiamo: Responsabile di Negozio Esperienza, capacità di coordinare il team, presidiare l'operatività e tradurre gli obiettivi commerciali ed economici in risultati sono le principali caratteristiche della risorsa che cerchiamo. Nova Coop vanta una presenza consolidata sul territorio e una rete di punti vendita distribuita tra Piemonte e Lombardia. Una realtà che lavora ogni giorno per offrire prodotti e servizi competitivi, qualità e sostenibilità degli stessi e iniziative dedicata all'ambiente e alle comunità locali. Il ruolo Come Responsabile di Negozio, sarai il punto di riferimento del punto vendita, con la responsabilità di coordinare la squadra, garantire l'operatività e contribuire al raggiungimento degli obiettivi prefissati. In particolare ti occuperai di: - Coordinare e motivare il team, organizzando attività e orientando il lavoro verso i KPI assegnati; - Garantire l'operatività del punto vendita, presidiare i reparti e gestire correttamente le merci; - Assicurare la qualità del servizio al cliente, gestendo eventuali criticità e reclami; - Monitorare conto economico e KPI, individuando opportunità di miglioramento; - Formare e sviluppare le persone, favorendo collaborazione, autonomia e un clima di lavoro positivo. Il profilo che cerchiamo Cerchiamo una risorsa con esperienza, capace di gestire persone, numeri e priorità in un contesto dinamico. Per avere successo nel ruolo servono: - esperienza pregressa nella gestione dei reparti freschi; - capacità di organizzazione, leadership, coordinamento e gestione del team; - interesse per gli aspetti commerciali e amministrativi e buona conoscenza di Excel; - intraprendenza, autonomia e capacità di problem solving; - disponibilità a spostarsi sui diversi punti vendita della provincia di Torino. Cosa offriamo Un'opportunità di responsabilità all'interno di una realtà strutturata, con un percorso pensato in ottica di continuità. - Contratto a tempo determinato di 12 mesi, full-time 40 ore settimanali, finalizzato alla stabilizzazione a tempo indeterminato; - 1° livello CCNL per dipendenti da imprese della distribuzione cooperativa; - RAL €37.000 - €42.000; - MBO annuale fino al 21% della componente fissa, al raggiungimento dei target assegnati. title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Grafton Office* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per una solida e strutturata azienda manifatturiera operante nel settore della lavorazione della lamiera, partner di riferimento per importanti realtà industriali nazionali e internazionali, selezioniamo JUNIOR PRICING & QUOTATIONS ASSISTANT Di cosa ti occuperai? La risorsa inserita all'interno dell'Ufficio Commerciale, verrà affiancata dal proprio responsabile in un percorso di formazione e crescita volto ad acquisire competenze nella gestione delle offerte commerciali e delle attività di preventivazione. In collaborazione con le diverse funzioni aziendali, avrà l'opportunità di approfondire la lettura delle richieste dei clienti, comprendere disegni tecnici e specifiche di prodotto e supportare l'elaborazione di preventivi e quotazioni. Attraverso un graduale percorso di apprendimento, la persona svilupperà autonomia nell'analisi dei costi, nella valutazione delle lavorazioni e nella costruzione delle offerte economiche, utilizzando gli strumenti e i gestionali aziendali dedicati. Avrà inoltre modo di interfacciarsi con clienti, ufficio tecnico, produzione e area acquisti, acquisendo una visione completa del processo che porta dalla richiesta del cliente alla formulazione dell'offerta commerciale. La posizione rappresenta un'interessante opportunità per candidati interessati a costruire una professionalità in ambito tecnico-commerciale all'interno di una realtà strutturata, con il supporto costante del responsabile di funzione e di un team esperto. Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? - Hai maturato una precedente esperienza professionale e desideri intraprendere un percorso di crescita in ambito preventivazione tecnico-commerciale. - Ti piace lavorare con numeri, costi, marginalità e preventivi, trasformando dati e informazioni tecniche in offerte commerciali. - Possiedi forte attenzione al dettaglio, metodo e capacità organizzative. - Sai interfacciarti con interlocutori diversi mantenendo un approccio collaborativo e orientato al servizio. - Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese scritta e orale - B2 - Automunito/a Orario di lavoro: Full time dal lunedì al venerdì, dalle 08:00 alle 12:00 e dalle 13:30 alle 17:30 - Pausa pranzo di 1 ora e mezza. L'attività si svolgerà interamente in presenza presso la sede aziendale, non è presente il lavoro da remoto. Offerta Contrattuale: - Inserimento con contratto di somministrazione a tempo determinato iniziale di un mese con successive proroghe e finalità REALE di inserimento. - CCNL applicato: Metalmeccanica Industria - Livello di inquadramento: D1 - Retribuzione prevista: La retribuzione prevista è pari a 23000 lordi annui, definita in base all'inquadramento contrattuale e alle mansioni previste per la posizione. Luogo di lavoro: Castel Goffredo (MN) Se pensi di avere le competenze e l'attitudine per questo ruolo, inviaci la tua candidatura! *Grafton Office è una specializzazione di Gi Group Spa autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. title: direttore commerciale/direttrice commerciale
description: Per una PMI italiana in forte crescita nell'ambito dell' automazione industriale, ricerchiamo la figura di un Sales Manager- Automazione Industriale per guidare l'evoluzione dell'area commerciale da modello 'imprenditoriale' a struttura scalabile e data-driven. Chi è il nostro cliente Realtà che opera tra Automazione industriale e sicurezza di macchine/impianti, con un posizionamento da partner tecnico-consulenziale: integra componenti tecnologiche e un portafoglio di servizi specialistici. La sfida Inserimento con affiancamento iniziale alla Direzione Commerciale, pensato come transizione concreta e rapida verso la guida dell'Area Sales. Cerchiamo una figura già strutturata, capace di portare metodo, KPI, organizzazione e leadership positiva, incidendo direttamente su processi, rete vendita e crescita. E' una persona che non si staccherà dal business, al contrario contribuirà direttamente insieme al team alla crescita e allo sviluppo commerciale dell'azienda. Responsabilità Coordinare e affiancare team commerciale interno e rete di agenti/partner nello sviluppo di nuove opportunità. Definire (con la Direzione) obiettivi, priorità e piano commerciale; monitorare avanzamento e scostamenti. Gestire e sviluppare direttamente alcuni clienti strategici. Identificare nuovi segmenti, casi d'uso e soluzioni da introdurre (approccio 'business development'). Promuovere l'uso del CRM e la qualità della pipeline (forecast, next step, copertura). Collaborare con Customer Service, area tecnica/servizi e marketing per garantire continuità end-to-end. Partecipare a fiere, eventi e visite presso clienti e partner. Migliorare processi commerciali (pricing, marginalità, standard offerta, governance sconti). Requisiti = 5 anni in ruoli commerciali B2B, preferibilmente in contesti tecnici/industriali o vendita consulenziale. Utilizzo concreto del CRM per pipeline, attività e monitoraggio risultati. Capacità di contribuire a budget commerciale, lettura KPI e attivazione di azioni correttive. Buona padronanza di pricing, gestione offerte, scontistica e condizioni commerciali. Attenzione a marginalità e redditività, bilanciando crescita e tutela dei margini. Esperienza (anche su piccoli team) in coordinamento e leadership. Inglese buono (scritto e parlato). Disponibilità a trasferte nazionali. Plus: provenienza da automazione industriale, componentistica elettrica/elettronica, sicurezza industriale. Cosa offriamo Ruolo strategico con impatto diretto sulla crescita e sulla trasformazione organizzativa dell'area commerciale. Autonomia decisionale e confronto costante con la Direzione Generale. Inserimento nel board aziendale. Contesto giovane, collaborativo, orientato alla qualità e con cultura 'zero frizioni'. Team interno + rete agenti già attivi, da guidare e sviluppare. Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede: Milano Nord Est Modalità: presenza in sede + attività sul territorio Orario: full time Trasferte: frequenti su territorio nazionale RAL: 50.000 - 65.000 € (in base a esperienza e competenze, criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere) CCNL: Commercio Inquadramento: Quadro Variabile/benefit:MBO (premio variabile) Auto aziendale ad uso promiscuo Ticket Restaurant Welfare: 2,5 mensilità #LI-AM2 Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. Invitiamo chi si candida a leggere l'informativa privacy ai sensi degli artt. 13 e 14 del Reg.

title: 3D Production Manager (m/f/d) (3-D-Artist)
description:
We`re fast. We‘re colorful. We are loud and quiet. We love what we do and make an important contribution to our customers‘ success every day. We create quality and are one of the leading media and IT service providers in Europe. From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. SCHNELLMEDIA stands for know-how and future. Our passion is professional image editing, online and print production as well as real 3D/AI visualization.

We are SCHNELLMEDIA and have a lot of plans.

A strong team needs strong personalities, therefore we are looking for a

3D Production Manager (m/f/d)
Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm

- Leadership of a motivated 3D production team (Home & Living, Fashion, Retail Industry)
- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows
- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi
- Monitoring, ensuring, and optimizing processes
- Organizing and coordinating between the local branch and the German headquarters
- Actively contributing to the further development of our company
YOUR PROFILE:

- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows
- Experience in photorealistic 3D visualizations of products (focus on furniture) is a plus
- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner
- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability
- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style
- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness
- Fluent English (business level)
OUR TOP 3 REASONS:

- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design
- Responsibility right from the start
- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international company

After an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Apply now with your complete application documents, your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.
WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION.

-------------------

Wir sind schnell. Wir sind farbenfroh. Wir sind laut und leise. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und leisten täglich einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden. Wir schaffen Qualität und zählen zu den führenden Medien- und IT-Dienstleistern in Europa. Von Deutschland und unseren Standorten in Asien aus beraten und unterstützen wir internationale Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen – etwa Werbung, Fotografie, Handel und Industrie. SCHNELLMEDIA steht für Know-how und Zukunft. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der professionellen Bildbearbeitung, der Online- und Printproduktion sowie der echten 3D- und KI-Visualisierung.

Wir sind SCHNELLMEDIA und haben viel vor. Ein starkes Team braucht starke Persönlichkeiten – daher suchen wir einen

3D Production Manager (m/w/d)
Hanoi (Vietnam) sowie Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm

DEINE AUFGABEN:

Führung eines motivierten 3D-Produktionsteams (Bereiche: Home & Living, Fashion, Einzelhandel)
Steuerung der täglichen 3D-Asset-Produktion sowie Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe und effizienter Workflows
Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Motivation des Teams in Hanoi
Überwachung, Sicherstellung und Optimierung von Prozessen
Organisation und Koordination der Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Standort vor Ort und der deutschen Zentrale
Aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens

DEIN PROFIL:

Führungserfahrung
Erfahrung mit 3D-Software wie Blender und/oder 3ds Max sowie V-Ray für ein fundiertes Verständnis von 3D-Workflows
Erfahrung in der fotorealistischen 3D-Produktvisualisierung (Schwerpunkt Möbel) ist von Vorteil
Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und lösungsorientierter Kommunikation
Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität sowie Zuverlässigkeit
Strukturierte, eigenständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Durchsetzungsstärke
Fließende Englischkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher)

UNSERE TOP-3-GRÜNDE:

Eine von Zusammenarbeit und Mitgestaltung geprägte Unternehmenskultur
Verantwortung von Anfang an
Kurze Entscheidungswege in einem wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen
Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase unterstützen wir dich selbstverständlich bei deinem Umzug nach Hanoi und stehen dir bei Fragen jederzeit zur Seite. Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

WIR FREUEN UNS AUF DEINE BEWERBUNG.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Visualisierungs- und Animationssoftware Blender, Grafikprogramm 3D Studio Max/3ds Max, 3-D-Design, Grafik-Design (Gebrauchsgrafik)

title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e creare sinergie commerciali a mercato per l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture. Ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale Location: Milano, Italia Package: RAL 70-100K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio #LI-CP Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. title: supervisore di contact center
description: Per grande azienda industriale, ricerchiamo un Senior IT Service Desk che contribuirà alla continuità operativa degli uffici e degli stabilimenti produttivi, assicurando un supporto informatico tempestivo ed efficace agli utenti. La posizione prevede un ruolo operativo, con autonomia nella gestione delle richieste e capacità di definire le priorità in funzione dell'impatto sulle attività aziendali e sulla produzione. Le principali attività Fornire supporto IT di primo livello su PC, laptop, telefoni, periferiche, stampanti e dispositivi utilizzati negli stabilimenti, incluse le stampanti per etichette. Installare, configurare e sostituire hardware e software standard, supportando gli utenti nell'utilizzo delle applicazioni aziendali. Supportare onboarding e offboarding IT, predisponendo postazioni e accessi di base. Collaborare con i team IT locali e di gruppo, nel rispetto delle procedure aziendali e delle policy di sicurezza. Buona conoscenza di Windows client, Microsoft 365 e delle attività di troubleshooting hardware e software. Conoscenza di base di Active Directory, sistemi di stampa e connettività LAN e Wi-Fi. Familiarità con strumenti di ticketing, assistenza remota e principi di sicurezza informatica. Capacità di lavorare in autonomia, comunicare con utenti di diverse funzioni e gestire le priorità con un approccio pratico e orientato al servizio. Diploma tecnico o formazione equivalente in ambito informatico. Conoscenza della lingua inglese adeguata all'interazione con colleghi e team IT di gruppo. title: cuoco/cuoca
description: Gi Group, prima Agenzia per il Lavoro italiana con oltre 200 filiali sul territorio nazionale e più di 1.800 professionisti, ricerca per struttura di ospitalità contemporanea con sede a Venezia una figura di: HEAD CHEF _VENEZIA La risorsa guiderà la cucina della sede di Venezia, una location dal carattere giovane e internazionale, dove si dorme, si mangia e si vive la città. title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description:
.....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

title: Industrial Design Engineer (m/w/d) (Industrie-, Produktdesigner/in)
description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Industrial Design Engineer

Stellenbeschreibung:
Gelebte Werte haben für Sie eine Bedeutung?

Lebens-Qualität am Arbeitsplatz ist Ihnen wichtig?

HOPPE, europaweit Marktführer in der Entwicklung, Herstellung und Vermarktung von Beschlagsystemen für Türen und Fenster, ist mit rund 2.200 Mitarbeitern international tätig. In dem eigentümergeführten Familien-Unternehmen ist die wertebasierte und sinnorientierte Unternehmensführung die Basis unseres täglichen Arbeitens.

Wir machen Wohnkultur im Detail. Seit Jahrzehnten schaffen wir hochwertige Beschlaglösungen für Fenster und Türen, die weltweit eingesetzt werden.

Jetzt gehen wir den nächsten Schritt: Wir vergrößern unser Team in der Entwicklung / Konstruktion und suchen dafür zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen:

Industrial Design Engineer (m/w/d)

Bei uns gestalten Sie die Designsprache zukünftiger HOPPE-Produkte aktiv mit und begleiten neue Produktideen von der ersten Handskizze bis zur Serienreife.

Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören:

- Begleitung von Designprojekten als Grundlage für die nachfolgende Konstruktion
- Erarbeitung innovativer Designkonzepte mittels Handskizzen, digitaler Zeichnungen und 3D-Formstudien
- Weiterentwicklung einer konsistenten Designsprache über verschiedene Produktlinien hinweg
- Erstellung fotorealistischer Renderings und Visualisierungen für Produktpräsentationen, Marketingmaßnahmen und Kundenprojekte
- Aufbereitung von Designvarianten für interne Entscheidungsvorlagen sowie Kundenpräsentationen
- Begleitung von Designprojekten von der ersten Idee über die Konzeptentwicklung bis zur Markteinführung
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagement, Vermarktung, Werbung sowie Konstruktion und Vorentwicklung
- Frühzeitige Abstimmung zur technischen und fertigungstechnischen Umsetzbarkeit neuer Produktideen
- Mitwirkung bei Design-Reviews sowie Bewertung von Prototypen und Vorserienteilen hinsichtlich Designqualität und Anmutung
- Aktive Rolle im produktbezogenen Freigabeprozess für gestalterische Fragestellungen
- Branchenübergreifende Beobachtung von Designtrends und Adaptierung auf HOPPE
- Aktive Mitarbeit in Produktentwicklungs-Projekten

Wir freuen uns auf ein Gespräch mit Ihnen, wenn Sie – mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung und aufbauend auf einem Studium im Bereich Industrial Design oder Produktdesign – folgendes mitbringen:

Wissen

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Industrial Design, Produktdesign oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Kenntnisse moderner Design- und Visualisierungsmethoden
- Verständnis von Werkstoffen, Oberflächen und Fertigungsprozessen
- Grundlegendes technisches Verständnis für die Zusammenarbeit mit Produktentwicklung und Fertigungstechnologie

Wollen

- Ausgeprägtes gestalterisches Gespür gepaart mit technischem Verständnis
- Hohe Kommunikations- und Moderationsfähigkeit zur Vermittlung zwischen gestalterischen und technischen Anforderungen
- Leidenschaft für Gestaltung und Produktentwicklung
- Eigenständige, strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Bereitschaft zu standortübergreifender Zusammenarbeit und gelegentlichen Dienstreisen

Können

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Industrial Design, vorzugsweise im Bereich Beschläge
- Sicherer Umgang mit Design-, Rendering- und Visualisierungssoftware (z. B. SolidWorks, KeyShot, oder vergleichbare Anwendungen)
- Erfahrung in der 3D-Formgestaltung und Entwicklung von Designstudien
- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten
- Fähigkeit, gestalterische und technische Anforderungen erfolgreich miteinander zu verbinden
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und fließende Englischkenntnisse

Das erwartet Sie bei HOPPE:

- Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum
- Die Möglichkeit, die zukünftige Designsprache unserer Produkte aktiv mitzugestalten
- Mitarbeit an internationalen Entwicklungsprojekten
- Arbeiten in einem wirtschaftlich stabilen, werteorientierten Familienunternehmen mit echter Wertschätzung
- Offene Kommunikation und ein partnerschaftliches Miteinander
- Langfristige Perspektiven und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Die Stelle ist grundsätzlich an einem unserer Standorte in Deutschland (Stadtallendorf, Bromskirchen, Crottendorf) oder auch an unserem Standort in Italien (Schluderns) zu besetzen.

description: Per azienda leader nel settore fragranze di lusso, ricerchiamo una risorsa da inserire nel team Regulatory & Product Safety come: REGULATORY - Addetto/a agli Affari Regolatori Di cosa ti occuperai? All'interno del team Regolatorio, la risorsa fornirà supporto operativo e amministrativo per garantire la conformità di prodotti, processi e documentazione ai principali quadri normativi applicabili nei mercati di riferimento, contribuendo a mantenere elevati standard di sicurezza e un time-to-market efficiente. In particolare si occuperà di: Controllo e revisione dei testi delle certificazioni dei nuovi prodotti destinati al mercato worldwide. Supporto all'analisi e monitoraggio di leggi, regolamenti, linee guida e standard di settore. Collaborazione alla redazione e all'aggiornamento di fascicoli tecnici, specifiche di ingredienti/materiali, etichettatura e certificati di conformità. Gestione di database regolatori, archiviazione dei record di conformità e aggiornamento delle tempistiche di approvazione. Supporto nelle valutazioni del rischio regolatorio e nella documentazione/esecuzione di azioni correttive. Monitoraggio della conformità lungo l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto (dallo sviluppo alla post-market surveillance). Organizzazione e mantenimento di documentazione regolatoria, dossier e dichiarazioni di conformità. Interfaccia operativa, sotto supervisione, con laboratori esterni, consulenti regolatori ed enti certificatori. Collaborazione trasversale con team R&D, Qualità e Operations. Supporto nella preparazione e gestione di audit, ispezioni e richieste da parte delle autorità competenti. Supporto alla diffusione interna di linee guida e requisiti regolatori. Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Laurea in Chimica o laurea in ambito scientifico (valutabili anche discipline scientifiche/giuridiche affini). Preferibile esperienza fino a 2 anni in Regulatory Affairs, Compliance o Qualità in contesti strutturati (plus: luxury/cosmetica/moda/consumer goods). Conoscenza dei principali temi di product safety, standard di conformità e processi di approvazione. Precisione, attenzione al dettaglio e approccio metodico alla gestione di dati e documentazione. Buone capacità organizzative, relazionali e comunicative. Padronanza di MS Office e sistemi di gestione documentale elettronica. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese (necessaria per la comprensione e gestione di testi tecnici). Obiettivo della ricerca Inserire un profilo senior in grado di guidare lo sviluppo downstream e commerciale dell'iniziativa, con responsabilità primaria nella costruzione del mercato, delle partnership e dell'offerta per la vendita di connettività satellitare all'ingrosso e dei servizi collegati. Il ruolo è pensato per una figura con forte attitudine imprenditoriale, credibilità industriale e capacità di esecuzione in una fase iniziale di impresa. Responsabilità principali La persona selezionata avrà il compito di: definire e guidare la strategia downstream e wholesale per servizi di connettività satellitare, airtime e capacità integrata; costruire e gestire relazioni commerciali con operatori satellitari, service provider, distributori, teleporter, integratori, OEM e partner industriali; trasformare capacità satellitare e servizi di rete in offerte vendibili, incluse soluzioni airtime, connettività gestita, white-label, wholesale e applicazioni IoT abilitate dal satellite; identificare i segmenti di mercato prioritari e i casi d'uso in cui il satellite offra un vantaggio competitivo rispetto alle reti terrestri; collaborare con il responsabile Upstream & Space Systems per tradurre i bisogni del mercato in requisiti di capacità, copertura, terminali, gateway, SLA, API e supporto. Profilo ricercato Esperienza diretta e verificabile nel settore delle telecomunicazioni satellitari. Esperienza commerciale / business development nella vendita B2B di almeno uno tra: capacità satellitare, air-time, connettività satellitare gestita, servizi satellite IoT, terminali satellitari, backhaul satellitare, soluzioni satcom per clienti industriali. Conoscenza concreta della filiera satcom: operatori, capacità, segmenti di terra, terminali, gateway, provisioning, SLA, supporto e modelli di distribuzione. Esperienza nella negoziazione di accordi wholesale, distribuzione, white-label, rivendita o managed connectivity in ambito satellitare. Seniority coerente con responsabilità autonome su partner, mercato, pipeline commerciale o risultati economici. Disponibilità a contribuire alla costruzione della società come co-founder operativo. Titoli preferenziali Esperienza presso operatori satellitari, service provider satcom, distributori specializzati, aziende satellite IoT o integratori specializzati in connettività satellitare. Familiarità con modelli GEO/MEO/LEO, servizi MSS, satellite IoT, NTN, VSAT o connettività in aree remote. Esperienza in mercati: marittimo, logistica, energia, agritech, monitoraggio remoto, infrastrutture critiche, mobilità, connettività in aree non servite. title: 3D Production Manager (m/f/d) (3-D-Artist)
description:
We`re fast. We‘re colorful. We are loud and quiet. We love what we do and make an important contribution to our customers‘ success every day. We create quality and are one of the leading media and IT service providers in Europe. From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. SCHNELLMEDIA stands for know-how and future. Our passion is professional image editing, online and print production as well as real 3D/AI visualization.

We are SCHNELLMEDIA and have a lot of plans.

A strong team needs strong personalities, therefore we are looking for a

3D Production Manager (m/f/d)
Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm
YOUR TASKS:

- Leadership of a motivated 3D production team (Home & Living, Fashion, Retail Industry)
- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows
- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi
- Monitoring, ensuring, and optimizing processes
- Organizing and coordinating between the local branch and the German headquarters
- Actively contributing to the further development of our company
YOUR PROFILE:

- Experience in leadership
- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows
- Experience in photorealistic 3D visualizations of products (focus on furniture) is a plus
- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner
- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability
- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style
- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness
- Fluent English (business level)
OUR TOP 3 REASONS:

- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design
- Responsibility right from the start
- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international company

After an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Apply now with your complete application documents, your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.
WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION.

-------------------

Wir sind schnell. Wir sind farbenfroh. Wir sind laut und leise. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und leisten täglich einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden. Wir schaffen Qualität und zählen zu den führenden Medien- und IT-Dienstleistern in Europa. Von Deutschland und unseren Standorten in Asien aus beraten und unterstützen wir internationale Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen – etwa Werbung, Fotografie, Handel und Industrie. SCHNELLMEDIA steht für Know-how und Zukunft. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der professionellen Bildbearbeitung, der Online- und Printproduktion sowie der echten 3D- und KI-Visualisierung.

Wir sind SCHNELLMEDIA und haben viel vor. Ein starkes Team braucht starke Persönlichkeiten – daher suchen wir einen

3D Production Manager (m/w/d)
Hanoi (Vietnam) sowie Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm

DEINE AUFGABEN:

Führung eines motivierten 3D-Produktionsteams (Bereiche: Home & Living, Fashion, Einzelhandel)
Steuerung der täglichen 3D-Asset-Produktion sowie Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe und effizienter Workflows
Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Motivation des Teams in Hanoi
Überwachung, Sicherstellung und Optimierung von Prozessen
Organisation und Koordination der Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Standort vor Ort und der deutschen Zentrale
Aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens

DEIN PROFIL:

Führungserfahrung
Erfahrung mit 3D-Software wie Blender und/oder 3ds Max sowie V-Ray für ein fundiertes Verständnis von 3D-Workflows
Erfahrung in der fotorealistischen 3D-Produktvisualisierung (Schwerpunkt Möbel) ist von Vorteil
Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und lösungsorientierter Kommunikation
Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität sowie Zuverlässigkeit
Strukturierte, eigenständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Durchsetzungsstärke
Fließende Englischkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher)

UNSERE TOP-3-GRÜNDE:

Eine von Zusammenarbeit und Mitgestaltung geprägte Unternehmenskultur
Verantwortung von Anfang an
Kurze Entscheidungswege in einem wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen
Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase unterstützen wir dich selbstverständlich bei deinem Umzug nach Hanoi und stehen dir bei Fragen jederzeit zur Seite. Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

WIR FREUEN UNS AUF DEINE BEWERBUNG.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Visualisierungs- und Animationssoftware Blender, Grafikprogramm 3D Studio Max/3ds Max, 3-D-Design, Grafik-Design (Gebrauchsgrafik)

description: Per conto di una realtà tecnologica di grandi dimensioni, operante in un contesto internazionale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Cyber Security Engineer da inserire all'interno di un team Cyber Security strutturato. La risorsa entrerà a far parte di una funzione tecnica che opera trasversalmente a supporto delle diverse aree IT, Software e Business del Gruppo, contribuendo alla progettazione, evoluzione e miglioramento dei servizi e dei controlli di Cyber Security. Cerchiamo un professionista con una buona seniority tecnica e una visione trasversale della sicurezza, capace di andare oltre la gestione operativa degli incidenti e contribuire all'evoluzione dell'ecosistema Cyber aziendale. Principali responsabilità La persona sarà coinvolta in attività quali: supporto a nuovi progetti IT e Software secondo principi di Security by Design, attraverso security review e definizione dei requisiti di sicurezza; definizione ed evoluzione dei controlli di Cloud Security, principalmente in ambienti Microsoft Azure e AWS; presidio delle tematiche di Identity Security, con particolare riferimento a Microsoft Entra ID e Active Directory; valutazione e scouting di nuove tecnologie e servizi messi a disposizione dai principali cloud e security provider; evoluzione dei servizi di Cyber Security Monitoring, collaborando con il SOC esterno e contribuendo al tuning delle piattaforme SIEM e dei relativi controlli di detection; attività di Vulnerability Management su componenti infrastrutturali e applicative; evoluzione dei presidi di sicurezza relativi a Firewall, WAF, endpoint, infrastrutture e ambienti Cloud; supporto ad attività di Incident Response e miglioramento continuo dei relativi processi e controlli; partecipazione alla definizione di iniziative di Purple Teaming, finalizzate all'identificazione delle aree di miglioramento della postura difensiva; confronto con Software Architect, Service Manager, team IT e Business per integrare i requisiti Cyber all'interno di nuovi servizi e applicazioni; supporto, quando necessario, nel confronto con clienti enterprise sui presidi di sicurezza adottati nei servizi erogati. Profilo ricercato Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in ambito Cyber Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security o Security Architecture, maturata in contesti aziendali strutturati o all'interno di società di consulenza tecnologica. Non è necessario aver maturato esperienza approfondita in tutte le aree indicate. Sarà particolarmente interessante una solida competenza in una o più delle seguenti: Cloud Security in ambienti Azure e/o AWS; Identity & Access Security, Entra ID / Active Directory; Security Engineering e definizione di security controls; Cyber Security Monitoring e tecnologie SIEM/XDR; Vulnerability Management; Infrastructure & Network Security; Application Security / Security by Design. Saranno considerate un plus esperienze in ambito Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Security, Incident Response, Purple Teaming e attività di security assessment. È richiesta una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Offerta RAL indicativa: €50.000 - €60.000 + MBO, valutabile in funzione dell'esperienza; inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato; modalità di lavoro ibrida con 2 giorni alla settimana in presenza a Bologna; #LI-AM2

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

title: Kiemsargis
description:
1.    Palaikyti švarą ir tvarką mokyklos teritorijoje.
2.    Kasdien nušluoti takelius, šaligatvius, iškaupti žolę takeliuose ir žaidimų aikštelėse, surinkti šiukšles (1–2 val. prieš ateinant vaikams).
3.    Vasaros, rudens ir pavasario laikotarpiu prižiūrėti bei laistyti gėlynus, pjauti žolę.
4.    Prižiūrėti ir tinkamai eksploatuoti naudojamą techniką: žoliapjovę, žoliapjovės traktorių, trimerius (valyti, tikrinti techninę būklę, atlikti smulkų remontą, laiku informuoti apie gedimus).
5.    Užtikrinti tinkamą technikos saugojimą, laikymą ir priežiūrą ne darbo metu.
6.    Vykdyti kuro sunaudojimo apskaitą, racionaliai naudoti kurą ir kitas eksploatacines medžiagas.
7.    Žiemą nukasti sniegą nuo takelių, šaligatvių, žaidimų aikštelių, įėjimų į pastatą, barstyti takelius smėliu.
8.    Kasdien apžiūrėti inventorių; esant gedimams – remontuoti savo jėgomis arba informuoti pavaduotoją ūkio reikalams.
9.    Perdažyti lauko įrenginius, atlikti smulkų jų remontą.
Kiemsargio atsakomybė: už mokyklos teritorijos priežiūrą ir tvarką; už sanitarinių higieninių reikalavimų vykdymą; už saugos darbe ir priešgaisrinės saugos reikalavimų laikymąsi; Už patikėtos technikos, įrankių ir inventoriaus saugumą, tinkamą naudojimą bei priežiūrą; už kuro ir eksploatacinių medžiagų racionalų naudojimą; už aukščiau išvardintų pareigų vykdymą.
Kiemsargis privalo: vykdyti mokyklos direktoriaus, pavaduotojo ūkiui arba įgaliotų asmenų su darbu susijusius nurodymus. Mokėti saugiai dirbti ir netrukdyti saugiai dirbti kitiems. title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

perkame juodųjų ir spalvotųjų metalų laužą Lietuvoje, parduodame perdirbėjams ir eksportui per Klaipėdą. Ieškome vadybininko, kuris veda sandorį nuo tiekėjo iki pirkėjo ir atsako už jo maržą.
Uždarbis – bazinė dalis ir komisiniai nuo sandorio maržos.

Pirkimo pusė.

Tiekėjų paieška: metalo apdirbimo ir gamybos įmonės, statybos ir demontavimo objektai, laivų
remontas, transporto aikštelės, savivaldybių įmonės.
Objektų apžiūra vietoje: kiek medžiagos, kokios rūšies ir būklės, ar ją reikės pjaustyti, kaip bus
kraunama.
Kainos pasiūlymas pagal medžiagos rūšį ir tos dienos kainoraštį.
Susitarimas dėl konteinerio ar mašinos pastatymo, pakrovimo laiko ir svėrimo vietos.
Atskaitymų už priemaišas derinimas su tiekėju iki pakrovimo.
Pardavimo pusė
Pirkėjų paieška ir derybos Lietuvoje, Baltijos šalyse ir eksporto rinkose.
Partijos komplektavimas iš kelių tiekėjų iki vieno kokybės lygio.
Kainos derinimas pagal tarptautinius indeksus.
Pasiūlymų teikimas su aiškiu galiojimo terminu.
Sandorio vedimas
Eksporto ir atliekų vežimo dokumentai: Annex VII per DIWASS, GPAIS lydraščiai, sąskaitos,
svėrimo pažymos, CMR, eksporto deklaracijos.
Konteinerių užsakymas ir pakrovimo koordinavimas su aikštele bei ekspedicija.
Svorio ir kokybės pretenzijų po iškrovimo sprendimas.
Apmokėjimo sekimas iki pinigų gavimo.
Regionas
Pasiteisinus pirmiems rezultatams – naujo regiono atidarymas ir jo tiekėjų tinklo formavimas.

title: Contrôle de Gestion / Chargé(e) de Pilotage Commercial - AXA Luxembourg - CDI (m/f)
description:
Contrôle de Gestion / Chargé(e) de Pilotage Commercial - AXA Luxembourg – CDI

Notre environnement de travail

Fière d'appartenir au Groupe AXA, une marque d'assurance internationale et un leader mondial des services financiers, la société AXA Assurances Luxembourg est un acteur majeur du secteur des assurances au Grand-Duché.
Nous aidons nos clients à traverser les petites et grandes difficultés de la vie. Chaque jour, nous agissons ensemble pour inventer la meilleure manière de les protéger et voulons donner à chacun les moyens de vivre une vie meilleure.
Un challenge qui donne le sourire et envie de se lever le matin !

Chez AXA, nous sommes persuadés que pour bien prendre soin de nos clients, nous devons commencer par bien prendre soin de nos collaborateurs. C'est pour cette raison que nous menons une politique RH engagée qui favorise la diversité, qui préserve l'équilibre vie privée-vie professionnelle et accompagne le développement des compétences et des carrières.
Quelle que soit l'équipe que vous rejoignez au sein de notre organisation, certaines choses sont vraies pour nous tous : une culture forte fondée sur la confiance, le respect et où nous sommes bienveillants les uns avec les autres, parce que c'est la meilleure façon d'être les meilleures versions de nous-mêmes. Nous cherchons toujours à attirer des talents dans notre entreprise, tout en continuant à développer notre personnel existant.
  
Vos missions

Au sein du département Finance d'AXA Assurances Luxembourg S.A., la fonction est rattachée au service Contrôle de gestion et Pilotage Commercial. Votre rôle consiste à participer au suivi et au pilotage de l'activité commerciale.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez amené(e) à :

Responsabilités récurrentes :

• Définir les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires des points de vente, en cohérence avec le plan stratégique de la société.
• Assurer le suivi mensuel de la performance commerciale, au niveau total, par réseau de distribution, par point de vente et par ligne de business : chiffres d'affaires, nouvelles affaires, chutes, taux de rétention, prime moyenne.
• Analyser les variations par rapport aux objectifs et par rapport à l'année précédente, en coordination avec la Direction Commerciale, en comprendre la cause et définir des plans d'actions adéquats pour sécuriser la réalisation des objectifs.
• Définir les actions commerciales dites « challenges » en coordination avec la Direction Commerciale : définir les critères en cohérence avec les priorités du plan stratégique, en prenant en considération les aspects de disponibilité des informations, de communication fluide et transparente avec les réseaux et les contraintes de compliance.
• Assurer le suivi des actions commerciales, notamment mesurer la performance commerciale (taux de conversion, etc).
• Suivre la rentabilité des points de vente en coordination avec l'actuariat business et notamment, calcul de l'intéressement technique pour les points de vente concernés.

Responsabilités ad-hoc :

• Mener des analyses ciblées, à la demande et en conjonction avec la direction commerciale, par exemple sur le taux de multi-détention, l'impact d'une campagne marketing sur le chiffre d'affaires…etc
• Participer aux réflexions et mesures d'impact en cas de modification des conventions et des schémas de rémunération des intermédiaires, en étant vigilant et critique face aux contraintes règlementaires et à l'enjeu de rester attractif pour nos clients & intermédiaires.

Assurer un lien continu entre les Directions Finance et Commerciale :

• Favoriser une culture financière au sein de la Direction Commerciale en apportant un angle financier aux réunions de suivi commercial en fournissant aux ARMAs les outils et tableaux de bord nécessaires à l'animation du réseau. Le cas échéant, organiser des formations ciblées.
• Analyser la performance commerciale, à la lumière des informations remontées du terrain.

Assurer un lien avec la Direction IT / Equipe Data :

• Solliciter la Direction IT / Equipe Data pour la production des rapports et des extractions nécessaires à l'exécution des missions.
• Veiller à la qualité des données mises à disposition des équipes commerciales et des intermédiaires, notamment les données de rémunération des intermédiaires.
• Mise en place de contrôles et de réconciliations avec les reportings Finance.

Votre profil  

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un master à orientation économique, en mathématiques ou statistiques.
• Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience de 3 à 5 ans au sein d'une Direction Finance ou d'une Direction Commerciale. L'expérience dans le secteur financier ou assuranciel représente un atout.
• Vous maitrisez Excel et les outils de bases de données.
• Vous manifestez une forte appétence, à la fois commerciale et pour l'analyse et les chiffres. Vous manifestez une aisance pour manipuler, synthétiser et expliquer les chiffres.
• Vous avez une fibre commerciale et une excellente orientation client.
• Vous possédez d'excellentes capacités à travailler en équipe avec plusieurs Directions.
• Vous travaillez en autonomie et vous bénéficiez d'une excellente capacité d'organisation.
• Vous maîtrisez le français et l'anglais.

Vos avantages

Vous avez envie de mettre votre énergie et votre talent au service de nos clients et de la société dans son ensemble ? Faites partie de notre grande famille en rejoignant :

• Un cadre stimulant où la formation continue permet sans cesse d'enrichir ses compétences et développer son employabilité ;
• Une entreprise très attachée à la qualité de vie au travail de ses salariés et qui offre de nombreux avantages collaborateurs (télétravail, programme de Well-being et santé, activités sportives en dehors du temps de travail, 35,5 jours de congés, etc.) ;
• Une entreprise responsable menant une politique volontaire pour reconnaître et valoriser les différences individuelles dans un environnement de travail inclusif ;
• Une compagnie où sont organisés des événements culturels, sportifs et conviviaux tout au long de l'année (Staff Days, visites des musées gratuites, city trips etc) ;
• Un employeur citoyen qui agit en faveur de causes sociétales et environnementales en tant qu'assureur, investisseur et entreprise notamment au travers de l'association AXA Atout Cœur.

title: POST-DOC SOIL HEALTH AND REMEDIATION (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
SD-26155- POST-DOC SOIL HEALTH AND REMEDIATION

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defense technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

As part of LIST's SUSTAIN unit (Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity), the Environmental Policies (EPS) group provides science-based input to the definition and implementation of environmental policies at national and EU level, in particular policies around chemical safety, soil pollution, circular (bio-)economy (e.g. construction, textile, water), and climate - and feeds, at the interface of science, technologies and policies, the regulatory perspective into RDI projects around these topics.

As postdoc (R&T Scientist), you will further strengthen the activities around soil health and the management of contaminated sites via contributing to:
• The further development (implementation-phase) of an Urban Soil Living Lab in Luxembourg (Horizon Europe project URSOILL - Innovative Solutions for Sustainable Urban Soil Restoration Through Living Labs) and participation in a working group on soil remediation and stabilization with nature-based solutions, especially phytoremediation and phytomanagement. Main tasks: literature review; design of field experiments and monitoring protocols across multiple urban sites; support and supervision of fieldwork; data analysis and interpretation; stakeholder engagement in the Living Lab; and scientific publications and project deliverables.
• The establishment of a cross-border network of ‘Lighthouses' of phytomanagement for soil remediation, biodiversity and the regenerative economy in the Greater Region (Interreg project Light4Green),
• Scientific and regulatory support, e.g. via bibliography and the preparation of a review article, on nature-based remediation solutions for Persistent organic pollutants (POPs) contamination (Interreg project Naturem),
• The set-up of a laboratory for testing and evaluating soil remediation technologies (especially bioremediation and phytoremediation),
• Support the definition, submission and implementation of research and collaborative project proposals of the group, and participate to the network of LIST's different activities around soil protection.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
Education

• You hold a Master's degree and a PhD in soil or environmental sciences/engineering, or another relevant natural science or engineering domain.
• You have practical and solid experience in the design, testing, evaluation and application of nature-based soil remediation technologies, e.g. phytoremediation, bioremediation, mycoremediation.
• Interdisciplinary thinking, well-developed communication skills (oral and written) and team spirit to successfully integrate into the multicultural, multilingual and multidisciplinary work environment at LIST and effectively communicate with LIST's partners,
• Client orientation mindset and great sense of service are required. The candidate should be highly motivated, pro-active and open for new challenges and can work independently,
• Not mandatory but considered an asset:
o First experience in an RTO/academic environment, scientific/technical consulting, authorities, or industry on contaminated site management, pollution risk assessment or remediation
o Knowledge of Luxembourg and the Greater Region

Language skills

• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages, especially French, German, or Luxembourgish are a strong asset.

Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

Your application must include:

• A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
• A scientific CV with contact details
• List of publications (and patents, if applicable)
• Contact details of 2 references
Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions

We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on national origin, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.
Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.
This position offers a gross monthly salary between €6094 and €6678, paid over 13 months (€79.222–€86.814 annually) based on full time employment. The final salary offer within this range will be determined based on the candidate's overall profile, qualifications and professional experience.

For part time employment, the salary is adjusted pro rata.

title: Research Data Specialist (m/f)
description:

Your role

As a Research Data Specialist, you will support researchers in managing data across the research lifecycle. You will implement FAIR-compliant RDM strategies and collaborate with data and library specialists across faculties, working at the intersection of research and infrastructure in a diverse, forward-looking environment.


Key responsibilities:

• Contribute to the design and implementation of guidelines and procedures for adequate data lifecycle management, standards, documentation, and information security
• Assist with managing data submissions, e.g. sequencing, clinical assay and survey data, handling data access requests and support in downstream processes, while ensuring appropriate documentation and metadata standards
• Facilitate data preservation, archiving and sharing
• Contribute to specific project deliverables as required
• Contribute to the development of innovative discipline-specific services and tools relevant to research data
• Contribute to the development of training materials on relevant topics, including Data Management and Reproducibility
• Contribute to projects, project deliverables, scientific publications, and community work in the field of Data Stewardship
• Contribute to the development and improvement of procedures/practices, as well as novel IT solutions as required by advancements in the field
• Collaborate with IT, Library and Research Support teams to promote coordinated data management services


Your profile:

• Demonstrable experience of collaborative research, research data management and data quality control
• Demonstrable computer programming skills are essential, with good knowledge of CLI and Python/R
