title: Data and Process Manager for our International Non-Life team (m/f)
description:
Data and Process Manager for our International Non-Life team

Location  Leudelange
Experience Level  Experienced
Home Office  Yes, partially possible

Your Job in a Nutshell

• Within our International Non-Life department, we are building a new Pan-European business branch operating under the Freedom of Service (FoS) regime.
• Our ambition: bring innovative insurance solutions to B2B partners across Europe — from MGAs and brokers to corporate clients seeking fronting solutions for their captives.
• As Data and Process Manager, you will play a key role in structuring and supervising the entire data process exchange for our international operations.
• You will also be in charge of building processes and optimizing them to create the most efficient organization. You will ensure that data provided by third-party are handled efficiently, compliantly, and in line with Baloise's best practices — a cornerstone of our competitiveness.
• You will work within a multidisciplinary international team operating in start-up and agile mode, reporting directly to the Head of International Non-Life.
• You will be part of an international team shaping a new line of business within a stable and reputable insurance group, with the opportunity to make a tangible impact on our European growth story.

What you can expect

Your main missions will be to:

Financial Management and Data Quality:

• Manage operational financial flows and work closely with Finance teams to ensure the timely and accurate transmission of data.
• Ensure the consistency and reliability of technical and financial data, notably by overseeing proper data reconciliation with actuarial teams and collaborating with partners to enhance the integrity of incoming data flows.

Operational and Cross-Functional Support:

• Coordinate operations across internal teams and external partners.
• Support claims management, fraud investigations, and customer complaints handling, while assisting in the design and deployment of operational processes with partners.
• Collaborate with legal and technical stakeholders whenever required.
• Take ownership of cross-functional topics and urgent requests that have not yet been allocated within the team, stepping in where necessary to ensure business continuity and the successful delivery of activities across functions.
Process Management and Cross-Functional Coordination:
• Define, formalize, document, and continuously improve business processes, including underwriting, claims management, data flows, and reporting.
• Actively manage workflow automation and digitalization initiatives in close collaboration with IT and data teams.
• Ensure that processes comply with applicable regulatory requirements.
• Identify operational pain points and drive problem-solving and process optimization initiatives.
• Act as a central coordination point between operational teams, IT, Finance, and external partners.
• Foster collaboration and ensure seamless coordination across teams to address operational challenges.
• Ensure the timely implementation of IT solutions with our partners and proactively remove any delivery blockers.
• Contribute to the implementation or enhancement of tools and systems supporting operational management.
• Identify opportunities for operational improvement and lead process optimization projects.

What we expect

• Master's degree (or equivalent, Bac+5) in Management, Engineering, Finance, Insurance, or a related field
• At least 5 years of experience in a cross-functional role, with exposure to operational processes, technology, finance, data management, and business operations
• Proven experience in an international and/or multi-country environment is highly desirable
• Strong organizational, problem-solving and analytical skills, with a continuous improvement mindset
• Proven ability to thrive in complex, multicultural environments, ideally within agile or fast-growing organizations.
• Fluency in English (working language); additional European languages (French, German, Spanish) are an asset
• SQL language proficiency

About Baloise

We are more than a traditional insurance company: we are the personal partner for everyone who wants to feel simply safe. In addition to our traditional financial business, we are also broadening our range with ecosystems in the areas of mobility and home. We see the digital age as an opportunity to make our offering even more sustainable, innovative and customer-oriented in the future. Are you shaping it with us?

We give you the freedom to pursue your ideas. Get involved! Question us! Develop yourself and us even further! Our culture of learning and making mistakes as well as communication at eye level all make this possible. Because only together can we move forward.

title: Software Development Engineer (ML), EU International Technologies (m/f)
description:
Software Development Engineer (ML), EU International Technologies
Job ID: 10566721 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

As an engineer on our team, you will take on a key role in improving capabilities of the Amazon product search service, and ensure we offer top-quality recommendations for all our customers regardless of their location or language. We help customers find the products they are searching for, and discover new products they would be interested in, by developing ML models trained on terabytes of product and traffic data to improve query understanding, ranking of search results, and personalization. We are seeking a software engineer who will assist in deploying those ML models, integrating them into existing services, and optimizing their performance. You will do so by building robust pipelines to train, evaluate, and deploy our models.

This is a rewarding role where you will be able to draw a clear connection between your work and how it improves the experience of millions of Amazon customers across the globe every day. You can also expect to have excellent opportunities, and ample support, for career growth, development, and mentorship. The team is a mixed science/engineering group, with each team member able to contribute to both engineering excellence as well as scientific innovation.

Key job responsibilities

- Design and implement new features across the various software components powering our search system
- Participate in the design and deployment of robust and scalable pipelines for data processing, model training, and model inference
- Build and configure metrics, dashboards, and alerting mechanisms for our deployed services and models
- Work closely with ML experts on your team to identify improvement opportunities and tackle technical obstacles
- Coordinate with engineering counterparts in other teams and stakeholders we work with

A day in the life

You will collaborate with scientists who build ML models trained on terabytes of data, and integrate these models into the production search engine that serves customers, closing the loop through design, implementation, deployment, and monitoring. The chosen approaches for model architecture will balance business-defined performance metrics with the needs of millisecond response times.

About the team

EU International Technologies is an organization focused on accelerating the EU Stores business by delighting customers and selling partners. The team's mission is to innovate locally and scale worldwide, fostering a world-class community of builders that delivers with speed and agility. EU INTech operates across domains including consumer discovery, search, selection, partner growth, pricing, sustainability, and marketplace expansion. The culture emphasizes collaboration, inclusion, technical excellence, big bets on high-impact projects, transparency, and long-term ownership -- empowering engineers and scientists to solve complex problems at international scale.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related quantitative field
- 3+ years of professional software development experience
- 1+ year of experience in building large-scale pipelines for data processing and ML model training/inference
- Strong coding and problem-solving skills in at least one modern programming language such as Python, Java, C++, etc.
- A general understanding of essential machine learning concepts (with no expectation of in-depth ML knowledge)
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including code reviews, build processes, testing, and deployment

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in computer science or a related quantitative field
- Professional experience with AWS services (e.g. S3, EC2, Lambda, EMR, DynamoDB)
- Prior experience within a multidisciplinary team of scientists and engineers
- Experience with NLP applications or search/retrieval engines
- Fluency in one or more languages other than English

Description

Fluency in English is essential for all roles in Europe and local language skills are highly desirable for some positions, but are not essential for every role.

At Amazon, we are excited to offer MBA candidates the opportunity to launch into big careers with limitless possibilities. We know searching for a full-time role is as much about finding a company where you can picture yourself being successful as it is about finding the right role. We look forward to meeting you and your classmates this year. As we get to know you more, we invite you to get to know us better.
Visit www.amazon.com/about to learn more about...

• Amazonians - and follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn
• Our commitment to our communities, diversity and military veterans
• Our European offices, our headquarters in Seattle, as well as where we operate around the world

Important Notes

• You will have the opportunity to specify location and business preference when you create your candidate profile and submit your application within the Amazon portal.
• You need only to submit one Amazon job application for all roles listed below (please use your school e-mail).
• We are looking for candidates who want to own, build and impact the customer experience over being tied to a specific role or team. The role and team placement will be based on business needs and as Amazon continues to grow we cannot guarantee that you will be based in the location or business area of your choice, but we will do our best to take your preferences into account.
• Make sure to list your MBA program and expected conferral date (month and year) within the Education section of your online application and on your resume.

Key job responsibilities

Launch, Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe, recruits top MBA international talent and builds broad, adaptable Amazonians across corporate businesses in Europe. The program provides a platform for MBAs to make the successful transition from their pre-MBA experience to Amazon. We run a three-year program offering two job rotations supported through on-boarding activities, core training modules, networking opportunities, and mentorship. Launch MBAs start by diving deep to understand customers and how the business is meeting their needs, then apply the learning from their MBA and their own creativity to identify the opportunities where they can make the biggest difference. At the end of the three-year program, MBAs have integrated into Amazon's peculiar ways and have acquired a diverse set of experiences that enable them to take ownership of their next career move through Amazon's extensive internal job opportunities. Through the rotation process, MBAs are able to move to a new function, business, and/or European location.

Opportunities within different business areas vary each year, and can include: Advertising, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Prime Video, Consumer and Devices/Alexa.

• Sr. Product Manager: Support the definition and launch of new products, services, or features in partnership with technical teams. Evaluate the existing experience(s) for customers on and off Amazon, identify areas for improvement, develop business requirements, craft and implement marketing plans, and own measures of success.
• Sr. Program Manager: Find solutions to complex problems and innovate on leading edge solutions to manage programs broadly across businesses within Amazon. Given responsibility to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Drive efforts independently and as part of larger project teams, and have a significant impact on the customer experience and the business.

title: Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (h/f)
description:
Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F) – Région Liège-Luxembourg

Reference: LU879641
Luxembourg
Permanent
Legal and Professional Services

Notre client est un cabinet de conseil international fondé au début des années 2000 et aujourd'hui présent dans plusieurs pays européens.
Sa mission est d'accompagner les entreprises dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs en délivrant des résultats mesurables et concrets.
Son expertise couvre l'excellence opérationnelle, l'optimisation de la supply chain, la data, la conduite du changement, la transformation digitale et la transition durable.

Le cabinet intervient auprès d'organisations de premier plan dans des secteurs variés tels que l'industrie, les sciences de la vie, le secteur public, les services financiers, le retail et la construction.
Dans un contexte où les transformations numériques s'accélèrent et où les DSI, CIO et CTO jouent un rôle croissant dans la définition de la stratégie des entreprises, notre client souhaite aujourd'hui franchir une nouvelle étape avec la création et le développement d'une practice CIO Advisory.

Cette practice a vocation à devenir un axe majeur du développement du cabinet, en accompagnant les dirigeants IT et les directions générales dans leurs réflexions et transformations stratégiques, organisationnelles et technologiques.
Pour accompagner sa croissance et participer à des projets de transformation et d'excellence opérationnelle, notre client recherche actuellement un(e) Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F).

Votre rôle

En tant que Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory, vous aurez la responsabilité de piloter et délivrer des missions de transformation IT à fort impact, tout en contribuant au développement de la practice, de son portefeuille clients et de ses équipes.
Vous interviendrez directement auprès des CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, de la définition des orientations jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre, avec une forte exigence de résultats, de qualité de delivery et d'impact durable.

Pilotage et delivery des missions clients

Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conduite et la réussite des missions de la practice :

• Piloter des missions complexes de stratégie et transformation IT, de leur cadrage jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre.
• Accompagner les clients dans la définition de leur vision cible IT et sa déclinaison en feuilles de route concrètes et opérationnelles.
• Superviser les diagnostics, analyses, recommandations et plans de transformation réalisés par les équipes.
• Challenger les organisations, processus, architectures et modes de fonctionnement IT afin d'identifier les leviers de performance et de transformation.
• Assurer la qualité des livrables, le respect des engagements et l'atteinte des résultats attendus.
• Intervenir directement auprès des instances de direction et accompagner les clients dans leurs décisions stratégiques.
• Sécuriser l'exécution des transformations et accompagner les équipes clients jusqu'à l'obtention de résultats durables.
Développement et structuration de la practice

En vous appuyant sur les besoins rencontrés sur le terrain, vous contribuerez à faire évoluer et structurer l'offre CIO Advisory :

• Développer des méthodologies et approches permettant de transformer l'expertise acquise en mission en offres structurées et réplicables.
• Identifier les nouvelles problématiques rencontrées par les CIO et faire évoluer l'offre en conséquence.
• Développer des synergies avec les autres expertises du cabinet : cybersécurité, data, ERP, cloud, transformation et excellence opérationnelle.
• Contribuer au positionnement et au développement de la practice au sein de mon client.
Développement commercial et relation client
Le développement commercial s'inscrira dans la continuité de votre activité de conseil et de votre proximité avec les clients :
• Développer des relations de confiance durables avec les CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales.
• Identifier de nouvelles opportunités à partir des enjeux et besoins rencontrés chez les clients.
• Construire et développer un portefeuille de missions CIO Advisory.
• Piloter les avant-ventes, propositions commerciales, appels d'offres et soutenances.
• Développer le cross-selling avec les autres practices et contribuer à la croissance du cabinet.

Leadership et développement des équipes

En tant que Directeur, vous serez également responsable de la qualité et du développement des équipes intervenant sur vos missions :

• Encadrer les équipes et leur apporter le niveau de guidance nécessaire à la réussite des missions.
• Challenger les analyses, recommandations et livrables afin de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence.
• Accompagner les consultants dans leur montée en compétences et leur capacité à prendre progressivement davantage de responsabilités en delivery.
• Transmettre votre expertise à travers le coaching, le mentoring et le partage d'expérience.
• Contribuer au recrutement et au développement des expertises nécessaires à la croissance de la practice.
• Développer une culture fondée sur l'excellence du delivery, le pragmatisme, la collaboration et l'obtention de résultats concrets.

Profil recherché

Nous recherchons avant tout un leader entrepreneurial, capable de combiner expertise technique, excellence du delivery et développement commercial.

Vous disposez idéalement de :

• Une formation de niveau Master (Bac+5), idéalement issue d'une école d'ingénieurs, d'une université ou d'une grande école avec une spécialisation IT, digitale ou technologique.
• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans le conseil, la transformation IT ou des environnements technologiques complexes.
• De solides compétences techniques et une forte compréhension des enjeux IT, vous permettant de challenger des architectures, des organisations, des choix technologiques et des trajectoires de transformation.
• Une expertise sur plusieurs dimensions du CIO Advisory : stratégie IT, operating model, cloud, infrastructures, architecture, cybersécurité, data, modernisation ou rationalisation des systèmes d'information.
• Une expérience significative dans le pilotage et le delivery de missions complexes, depuis le cadrage stratégique jusqu'à la mise en œuvre.
• Une expérience solide auprès de CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, avec la capacité à intervenir comme interlocuteur de confiance sur des problématiques stratégiques et techniques.
• Une réelle capacité à développer du business : identification d'opportunités, développement de comptes, construction de propositions commerciales, soutenances et développement de nouvelles missions.
• Une forte capacité à développer et entretenir des relations de confiance avec des décideurs de haut niveau.
• Un fort esprit entrepreneurial, avec l'envie de construire, structurer et faire grandir une activité.
• Une excellente communication, une forte posture de conseil et une capacité à embarquer clients et équipes.

title: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems (m/f)
description:
Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems

Position: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg
Start Date: Immediate
Type: Full-time

Company Overview

We're LuxQuantum, a Luxembourg-based deep-tech startup developing the next generation of quantum-safe communication systems.

Our mission is to address one of the key challenges in modern cybersecurity: how to combine Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) into a unified, adaptive, and scalable security architecture.

At LuxQuantum, we believe security decisions should not be static. Different data, infrastructures, risks, trust assumptions, and operational conditions may require different protection strategies. That's why we are developing intelligent and adaptive approaches to model these complex environments and support dynamic security and orchestration decisions.

Our work brings together AI, systems modeling, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications, creating research challenges that span multiple scientific and engineering disciplines.

We are a small and ambitious team of researchers, engineers, and innovators who enjoy exploring difficult problems, learning across disciplines, and turning research ideas into real-world technology.

Role Overview

As a Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer, you will contribute to the research and development of the intelligence and decision-making capabilities behind LuxQuantum's adaptive quantum-safe security systems.

You will investigate how complex security and communication systems can adapt to changing risks, uncertainty, trust requirements, infrastructure conditions, and operational constraints. Your work may involve mathematical and computational modeling, optimization, probabilistic methods, AI, or other data-driven and decision-support approaches.

You will work closely with our research and engineering team to formulate research problems, explore and compare different approaches, develop models and algorithms, evaluate them through experiments and simulations, and translate promising results into working prototypes.

The research sits at the intersection of systems modeling, intelligent decision-making, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications.

What You'll Do

• Investigate challenging research problems in intelligent and adaptive security systems
• Formulate research questions, develop new approaches, and design experiments and simulations to evaluate them
• Develop mathematical, computational, and AI-based models for decision-making under uncertainty, risk, and changing operational conditions
• Explore adaptive approaches for the orchestration and optimization of hybrid quantum-safe systems
• Design and evaluate methods that help security systems dynamically respond to changing infrastructure, trust, and operational requirements
• Translate research ideas, models, and algorithms into working prototypes and validate them in realistic scenarios
• Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers across software, AI, cybersecurity, and quantum technologies
• Contribute to the technical direction, architecture, and documentation of LuxQuantum's research and development activities

What We're Looking For

• PhD in a quantitative, scientific, engineering, or computing-related field; or a Master's degree with strong relevant research or R&D experience
• Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capacity to investigate complex problems, develop new approaches, and evaluate them systematically
• Experience with quantitative, computational, modeling, optimization, AI/ML, or related research methods
• Good programming and computational skills in one or more languages such as Python, C++, Rust, or similar
• Ability to translate research ideas, mathematical models, or algorithms into working prototypes
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a small multidisciplinary team
• Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn and work across different technical domains
• Understanding of startup environments and research-driven innovation
• Fluent written and verbal communication in English

We welcome candidates from different scientific, engineering, and computational backgrounds, including PhD graduates, postdoctoral researchers, and researchers interested in transitioning from academia to industrial R&D. Prior experience in quantum technologies or quantum-safe cybersecurity is welcome but not required.

Nice to Have

Experience in any of the following is a plus, but not required:

• Cybersecurity, risk modeling, or security-related systems
• Quantum technologies, Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), or Quantum Key Distribution (QKD)
• Complex or distributed systems, simulation, or system orchestration
• Research software development and building experimental prototypes
• APIs, containerization, or ML/MLOps tools such as Docker, FastAPI, MLflow, or similar

Who You Are

• Curious and motivated by difficult problems where the answer is not always known in advance
• An independent thinker who enjoys exploring, testing, and improving new ideas
• Interested in turning research and theory into working systems with real-world impact
• Comfortable taking ownership while collaborating closely with a small multidisciplinary team
• Open to learning across disciplines and applying your expertise to new technical challenges
• Excited by the pace, responsibility, and opportunity to shape technology in an early-stage
deep-tech startup

Why Join LuxQuantum

Research with Real-World Impact

Work on challenging R&D problems and help turn research ideas, models, and algorithms into technologies for next-generation secure communication systems.

High Ownership

Take meaningful ownership of your work and have the opportunity to influence technical decisions and the direction of LuxQuantum's technology.

Work Across Disciplines

Collaborate at the intersection of systems modeling, AI, cybersecurity, software engineering, and quantum-safe communications, with the opportunity to expand your expertise into new areas.

Grow with a Deep-Tech Startup

Join LuxQuantum at an early stage, with the autonomy to explore ideas, take responsibility, and contribute to the development of both our technology and our research-driven engineering culture.

How to Apply

Please send:

• Your CV
• A short cover letter describing your background, relevant research or technical experience, and interest in the role
• Links to relevant projects, technical work, GitHub, or other examples of your work, if available (optional)

to:

contact@luxquantum.lu

Join us in building intelligent, adaptive security systems for the future of quantum-safe communications.

Type de contrat

Mitsubishi UFJ Investor Services and Banking (Luxembourg) S.A. (MIBL) is a Bank incorporated in Luxembourg and is fully owned by Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking Corporation, member of   the    Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, one of the largest financial groups worldwide.

MIBL provides a wide range of financial services to institutional investors including depositary, custody, fund administration, and other banking-related services.

MIBL now has an opening in its Compliance Department for a:

                                                                                                                                                                                            
Senior Financial Crime Compliance Officer (CDI)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   (Ref:MIBLSFCCO_092026)

About the Role

The role focuses on coordinating the collection, consolidation, and analysis of compliance information, performing oversight reviews, assessing compliance governance arrangements, and supporting the implementation and maintenance of effective compliance and reporting frameworks across the organization.

Responsibilities

• Coordinate the collection, consolidation and analysis of compliance information received from affiliated entities and internal stakeholders for governance, oversight, and reporting purposes.
• Perform oversight reviews to assess compliance with group policies, regulatory requirements, internal standards, and governance frameworks.
• Review periodic compliance reports, key risk indicators, incidents, breaches, complaints, regulatory developments, and remediation actions to identify trends, emerging risks and areas requiring escalation.
• Assess the adequacy and effectiveness of compliance governance arrangements, policies, procedures, and internal control frameworks.
• Conduct thematic reviews and targeted assessments covering governance, conduct, regulatory compliance, outsourcing oversight, conflicts of interest, regulatory reporting, and related compliance risk areas.
• Support the implementation and maintenance of an effective information collection, escalation, and reporting framework across the organization.
• Evaluate whether identified findings represent isolated issues, recurring deficiencies or broader governance and control weaknesses.
• Ensure timely escalation of material issues, overdue actions, and significant compliance matters.
• Review and challenge information submitted by stakeholders to ensure completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
• Support the implementation of regulatory change initiatives and assess the impact of new regulatory requirements on the compliance framework.
• Assist in maintaining governance documentation, compliance inventories, registers, frameworks, and oversight records.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at strengthening compliance oversight, transparency, reporting quality and regulatory readiness.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Required Skills

• Typically, 4–5+ years of relevant experience in Compliance Monitoring, Internal Audit, Risk, or a comparable control function within financial services, including demonstrable experience performing independent monitoring or control testing.
• Knowledge of Luxembourg and EU regulatory requirements and supervisory expectations including on CRD/CRR, Outsourcing, ICAAP/ILAAP, Financial Crime, PSR/PSD.
• Experience supporting multi-entity governance models, cross-border oversight, or consolidated compliance frameworks.
• Sound judgement when determining the materiality and severity of findings.
• Ability to challenge stakeholders constructively and independently.
• Strong report-writing and senior stakeholder communication skills.
• High standards of integrity, independence, and professional judgement.
• Fluency in English.

title: Contrôle de Gestion / Chargé(e) de Pilotage Commercial - AXA Luxembourg - CDI (m/f)
description:
Contrôle de Gestion / Chargé(e) de Pilotage Commercial - AXA Luxembourg – CDI

Notre environnement de travail

Fière d'appartenir au Groupe AXA, une marque d'assurance internationale et un leader mondial des services financiers, la société AXA Assurances Luxembourg est un acteur majeur du secteur des assurances au Grand-Duché.
Nous aidons nos clients à traverser les petites et grandes difficultés de la vie. Chaque jour, nous agissons ensemble pour inventer la meilleure manière de les protéger et voulons donner à chacun les moyens de vivre une vie meilleure.
Un challenge qui donne le sourire et envie de se lever le matin !

Chez AXA, nous sommes persuadés que pour bien prendre soin de nos clients, nous devons commencer par bien prendre soin de nos collaborateurs. C'est pour cette raison que nous menons une politique RH engagée qui favorise la diversité, qui préserve l'équilibre vie privée-vie professionnelle et accompagne le développement des compétences et des carrières.
Quelle que soit l'équipe que vous rejoignez au sein de notre organisation, certaines choses sont vraies pour nous tous : une culture forte fondée sur la confiance, le respect et où nous sommes bienveillants les uns avec les autres, parce que c'est la meilleure façon d'être les meilleures versions de nous-mêmes. Nous cherchons toujours à attirer des talents dans notre entreprise, tout en continuant à développer notre personnel existant.
  
Vos missions

Au sein du département Finance d'AXA Assurances Luxembourg S.A., la fonction est rattachée au service Contrôle de gestion et Pilotage Commercial. Votre rôle consiste à participer au suivi et au pilotage de l'activité commerciale.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez amené(e) à :

Responsabilités récurrentes :

• Définir les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires des points de vente, en cohérence avec le plan stratégique de la société.
• Assurer le suivi mensuel de la performance commerciale, au niveau total, par réseau de distribution, par point de vente et par ligne de business : chiffres d'affaires, nouvelles affaires, chutes, taux de rétention, prime moyenne.
• Analyser les variations par rapport aux objectifs et par rapport à l'année précédente, en coordination avec la Direction Commerciale, en comprendre la cause et définir des plans d'actions adéquats pour sécuriser la réalisation des objectifs.
• Définir les actions commerciales dites « challenges » en coordination avec la Direction Commerciale : définir les critères en cohérence avec les priorités du plan stratégique, en prenant en considération les aspects de disponibilité des informations, de communication fluide et transparente avec les réseaux et les contraintes de compliance.
• Assurer le suivi des actions commerciales, notamment mesurer la performance commerciale (taux de conversion, etc).
• Suivre la rentabilité des points de vente en coordination avec l'actuariat business et notamment, calcul de l'intéressement technique pour les points de vente concernés.

Responsabilités ad-hoc :

• Mener des analyses ciblées, à la demande et en conjonction avec la direction commerciale, par exemple sur le taux de multi-détention, l'impact d'une campagne marketing sur le chiffre d'affaires…etc
• Participer aux réflexions et mesures d'impact en cas de modification des conventions et des schémas de rémunération des intermédiaires, en étant vigilant et critique face aux contraintes règlementaires et à l'enjeu de rester attractif pour nos clients & intermédiaires.

Assurer un lien continu entre les Directions Finance et Commerciale :

• Favoriser une culture financière au sein de la Direction Commerciale en apportant un angle financier aux réunions de suivi commercial en fournissant aux ARMAs les outils et tableaux de bord nécessaires à l'animation du réseau. Le cas échéant, organiser des formations ciblées.
• Analyser la performance commerciale, à la lumière des informations remontées du terrain.

Assurer un lien avec la Direction IT / Equipe Data :

• Solliciter la Direction IT / Equipe Data pour la production des rapports et des extractions nécessaires à l'exécution des missions.
• Veiller à la qualité des données mises à disposition des équipes commerciales et des intermédiaires, notamment les données de rémunération des intermédiaires.
• Mise en place de contrôles et de réconciliations avec les reportings Finance.

Votre profil  

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un master à orientation économique, en mathématiques ou statistiques.
• Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience de 3 à 5 ans au sein d'une Direction Finance ou d'une Direction Commerciale. L'expérience dans le secteur financier ou assuranciel représente un atout.
• Vous maitrisez Excel et les outils de bases de données.
• Vous manifestez une forte appétence, à la fois commerciale et pour l'analyse et les chiffres. Vous manifestez une aisance pour manipuler, synthétiser et expliquer les chiffres.
• Vous avez une fibre commerciale et une excellente orientation client.
• Vous possédez d'excellentes capacités à travailler en équipe avec plusieurs Directions.
• Vous travaillez en autonomie et vous bénéficiez d'une excellente capacité d'organisation.
• Vous maîtrisez le français et l'anglais.

Vos avantages

Vous avez envie de mettre votre énergie et votre talent au service de nos clients et de la société dans son ensemble ? Faites partie de notre grande famille en rejoignant :

• Un cadre stimulant où la formation continue permet sans cesse d'enrichir ses compétences et développer son employabilité ;
• Une entreprise très attachée à la qualité de vie au travail de ses salariés et qui offre de nombreux avantages collaborateurs (télétravail, programme de Well-being et santé, activités sportives en dehors du temps de travail, 35,5 jours de congés, etc.) ;
• Une entreprise responsable menant une politique volontaire pour reconnaître et valoriser les différences individuelles dans un environnement de travail inclusif ;
• Une compagnie où sont organisés des événements culturels, sportifs et conviviaux tout au long de l'année (Staff Days, visites des musées gratuites, city trips etc) ;
• Un employeur citoyen qui agit en faveur de causes sociétales et environnementales en tant qu'assureur, investisseur et entreprise notamment au travers de l'association AXA Atout Cœur.

description:
Digital Risk Oversight Expert (m/f/d)

Job Description

Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg
We see a world of opportunity. From uncovering ways to digitalize, to enabling new sectors to take off, to building sustainability and resilience into economies, we know insights reveal new opportunities for all.

We are diverse and dedicated problem solvers, part of the worldwide network of high-quality audit, tax and advisory services.

We offer excellent career prospects that balance autonomy, flexibility, and responsibility. Our comprehensive benefits inspire our people do and feel their best.

Right now, we have more than 1800 employees from over 70 nationalities. Join our growing group of young and youthful innovators to uncover a world of opportunity together.

Job Description

We are seeking for a Digital Risk Oversight Expert.

The Digital Risk Oversight Expert will play a crucial role in ensuring that the organization's digital security risks are effectively identified, monitored, and managed. This position focuses on oversight and governance, ensuring that solutions, processes, and behaviors align with KPMG policies, standards, and security best practices. The expert will provide independent oversight and advisory support to the first line of defense, contributing to a robust digital risk management framework.
What you will be working on

Independent Reviews

• Conduct independent reviews of security controls and provide actionable recommendations for improvement.
• Assess and validate the adequacy of security measures implemented by the first line of defense.

Security Processes Implementation

• Elaborate, implement, and monitor security-related processes to ensure compliance with established standards.
• Lead investigations on security incidents, containing, mitigating, and reporting the impact effectively. Ensure root cause analysis and lessons learned are addressed effectively.

Reporting & Metrics

• Produce regular reports on the state of information security and key risks for senior management and stakeholders.
• Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) to evaluate security effectiveness.
• Identify, evaluate, and report on the criticality of identified vulnerabilities and prioritize remediation based on potential business impact.

Training & Development

• Elaborate and deliver training sessions to all stakeholders to strengthen the security culture within the organization.
• As an Expert, coach, motivate and review the work done by junior team members.

Collaboration & Liaison

• Work closely with the first line of defense to address security gaps and vulnerabilities.
• Liaise with third parties, auditors, and regulators on security matters, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.

What we look for

Technical Skills & Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, ideally with a specialty in Information Security.
• At least 8 years of experience with information security concepts and practices.
• Knowledge of IT security standards (ITIL, ISO27001, OWASP, etc.).
• Proficiency in IT security tools (Firewall, EDR, IPS N/H, WAF, SIEM, DLP, Compliance, etc.).
• Strong knowledge in network security and incident management.
• Strong Cloud security knowledge and IT Security certifications are an advantage e.g. CCSP, AZ- 500
• Strong Knowledge on development technologies and languages.

Experience & Knowledge

• Ability to lead security assessments and audits.

• Excellent communication and management skills.
• Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
• Motivated and organized, capable of taking ownership of projects from A to Z while respecting tight deadlines and being receptive to new ideas.
• Strong issue resolution skills with a focus on risk controls and client focus.

What will you get

We offer more than jobs. With our flexible work model, you can enjoy work and rest and recharge. Our competitive compensation packages, paid time away from work, recognition bonuses and dedicated programs for personal development and wellbeing help to keep everyone refreshed and motivated.

description:
Description:

HEAD OF INTERNATIONAL SALES (M/F)

Luxembourg | Permanent Position | International Industrial Environment | Executive Committee Member
Do you have at least 10 years of experience in international B2B sales within a technical industrial environment, including significant responsibility for managing strategic key accounts?
Do you have a proven track record in managing complex industrial sales cycles, building long-term relationships with international customers and identifying new growth opportunities?
Can you combine strategic thinking, leadership and a strong understanding of technical, industrial and financial challenges to help shape a company's future?
If these three areas reflect your experience and ambitions, this opportunity could be an exciting next step in your career.


OUR CLIENT:

Our client is an internationally active industrial company recognised for its technical expertise, product quality and long-standing relationships with leading industrial customers worldwide.
Operating in demanding and technically complex markets, the company has built its reputation on strong industrial know-how, a loyal international customer base and a lean organisation that encourages collaboration, responsiveness and efficient decision-making.
As its markets evolve and competition intensifies, the company is looking to bring fresh momentum to its international development.
We are therefore seeking a Head of International Sales who can build on established customer relationships while bringing fresh perspectives, new growth opportunities and a meaningful contribution to the company's strategic direction.
Reporting directly to the CEO and sitting on the Executive Committee, you will play a key role in shaping the company's future direction and performance.


YOUR ROLE:

Your responsibilities will extend well beyond managing international sales.
You will be entrusted with protecting and developing a portfolio of strategic industrial accounts while helping the company strengthen its positioning in a changing market.
You will act as a trusted partner to customers, a driver of business growth, a team leader and an active contributor to strategic decisions.
The role combines a strong focus on developing existing customer relationships (approximately 75% of the activity) with identifying and securing new business opportunities (approximately 25%).
You will remain personally involved with the company's most important international customers, working closely with technical, operational and financial teams.


YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Shape the Sales Strategy and Drive Transformation:

Define and implement the international sales strategy across markets, customers and product lines.
Monitor technological, competitive and economic developments to anticipate changes in the market.
Identify new applications, business opportunities and potential areas for diversification.
Help evolve the company's value proposition to strengthen its differentiation and competitiveness.
Translate market insights and customer needs into actionable priorities for senior management and industrial teams.


Develop and Protect Strategic Customer Relationships:

Take direct responsibility for managing the company's most important international industrial customers.
Strengthen existing partnerships while identifying opportunities to grow business within key accounts.
Develop and execute medium- and long-term strategic account plans.
Build relationships at multiple levels within customer organisations, including executive management, procurement, R&D, engineering and operations.
Lead strategic negotiations and secure sustainable, profitable customer relationships.


Identify and Convert New Business Opportunities:

Explore new markets, customers and applications with sustainable growth potential.
Focus on opportunities where the company's technical capabilities and industrial expertise provide a genuine competitive advantage.
Manage complex, long sales cycles, from initial opportunity identification through technical qualification, testing, negotiation and contract award.
Take a selective, value-driven approach to business development, prioritising long-term profitability over short-term volume.


Combine Technical Understanding with Financial Performance:

Understand customers' technical and industrial challenges and translate them into compelling value propositions.
Work closely with R&D, Production, Procurement and Quality teams to develop realistic, competitive solutions.
Ensure that customer commitments remain aligned with the company's industrial capabilities.
Prepare and manage sales budgets, forecasts, revenue targets and margin objectives.
Develop pricing strategies and continuously improve account and business profitability.


Lead the Team and Contribute to the Executive Committee:

Lead and develop an international sales team, promoting accountability, ownership and performance.
Provide the Executive Committee with clear insights into customer expectations, competitive dynamics and market developments.
Contribute to strategic discussions on investment priorities, innovation, industrial capabilities and future growth opportunities.
Constructively challenge existing approaches and bring forward new ideas to support the company's transformation.


Experience and Expertise:

You have at least 10 years of experience in international B2B sales within a technical industrial environment, including significant commercial leadership responsibilities.
You have a proven track record in managing and developing major international industrial accounts in demanding, competitive markets.
You are experienced in complex technical sales cycles, involving multiple stakeholders, qualification processes, testing and long-term negotiations.
You have a solid understanding of industrial environments, including manufacturing processes, value chains, production capacity, supply chain constraints and operational challenges.
You are comfortable working with complex technical products and engaging with technical experts, without necessarily being the technical specialist yourself.
You have a strong grasp of pricing, margins, forecasting and profitability management.
Experience in highly technical industrial sectors, particularly materials, components or manufacturing processes, would be a valuable asset.
Professional fluency in both French and English is essential. German would be an additional advantage.
You are willing and able to travel internationally on a regular basis, approximately 15 weeks per year.


Leadership and Personal Qualities:

Beyond your professional background, we are looking for a leader who can combine strategic vision with a hands-on approach.


You will stand out through:

Your ability to preserve and grow long-standing customer relationships while introducing new ways of working.
Your intellectual curiosity and ability to understand technological and economic changes.
Your willingness to challenge established thinking, bring fresh ideas and turn them into practical solutions.
Your interpersonal skills and ability to build credibility with both technical specialists and senior executives.
Your pragmatic, entrepreneurial mindset and strong focus on results.
Your ability to engage, empower and develop a team.
Your confidence in working within a lean, agile organisation where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have a visible impact.

description:
SD-26155- POST-DOC SOIL HEALTH AND REMEDIATION

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defense technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

As part of LIST's SUSTAIN unit (Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity), the Environmental Policies (EPS) group provides science-based input to the definition and implementation of environmental policies at national and EU level, in particular policies around chemical safety, soil pollution, circular (bio-)economy (e.g. construction, textile, water), and climate - and feeds, at the interface of science, technologies and policies, the regulatory perspective into RDI projects around these topics.

As postdoc (R&T Scientist), you will further strengthen the activities around soil health and the management of contaminated sites via contributing to:
• The further development (implementation-phase) of an Urban Soil Living Lab in Luxembourg (Horizon Europe project URSOILL - Innovative Solutions for Sustainable Urban Soil Restoration Through Living Labs) and participation in a working group on soil remediation and stabilization with nature-based solutions, especially phytoremediation and phytomanagement. Main tasks: literature review; design of field experiments and monitoring protocols across multiple urban sites; support and supervision of fieldwork; data analysis and interpretation; stakeholder engagement in the Living Lab; and scientific publications and project deliverables.
• The establishment of a cross-border network of ‘Lighthouses' of phytomanagement for soil remediation, biodiversity and the regenerative economy in the Greater Region (Interreg project Light4Green),
• Scientific and regulatory support, e.g. via bibliography and the preparation of a review article, on nature-based remediation solutions for Persistent organic pollutants (POPs) contamination (Interreg project Naturem),
• The set-up of a laboratory for testing and evaluating soil remediation technologies (especially bioremediation and phytoremediation),
• Support the definition, submission and implementation of research and collaborative project proposals of the group, and participate to the network of LIST's different activities around soil protection.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
Education

• You hold a Master's degree and a PhD in soil or environmental sciences/engineering, or another relevant natural science or engineering domain.
• You have practical and solid experience in the design, testing, evaluation and application of nature-based soil remediation technologies, e.g. phytoremediation, bioremediation, mycoremediation.
• Interdisciplinary thinking, well-developed communication skills (oral and written) and team spirit to successfully integrate into the multicultural, multilingual and multidisciplinary work environment at LIST and effectively communicate with LIST's partners,

Language skills

title: Financial Controller (M/F)
description:
Description:


Vous maîtrisez le Financial Controlling et le pilotage budgétaire dans un environnement international ou multi-entités ?
Vous savez aller au-delà du reporting pour analyser les écarts, challenger les hypothèses et transformer les chiffres en recommandations concrètes pour le management ?
Vous êtes à l'aise avec les enjeux financiers d'une holding et capable d'interagir en français comme en anglais avec des interlocuteurs Finance et opérationnels variés ?

Alors cette opportunité pourrait vous intéresser.


NOTRE CLIENT:

Notre client est un groupe industriel international reconnu, présent sur plusieurs marchés et disposant d'une organisation multi-entités.
Dans le cadre de l'évolution de son organisation financière au Luxembourg, notre client crée une fonction de Financial Controller afin de renforcer le pilotage financier d'une structure à taille humaine.
Un rôle qui ne se limite pas à produire ou consolider des chiffres : votre valeur ajoutée résidera dans votre capacité à les comprendre, les challenger et les transformer en véritables outils d'aide à la décision.


VOTRE RÔLE ET RESPONSABILITES:


Au cœur du pilotage financier de la holding, vous intervenez à la fois sur les dimensions Financial Controlling, FP&A et Finance Business Partnering.

À ce titre, vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

Élaborer et piloter les budgets, forecasts et reportings financiers de la holding ;
Analyser les écarts entre budget, forecast et réalisé afin d'en identifier les causes, les tendances et les éventuelles dérives ;
Piloter et challenger les coûts de la holding, avec une attention particulière portée aux dépenses IT ;
Définir et faire évoluer les KPI et outils de pilotage afin d'améliorer la visibilité sur la performance et les projections financières ;
Assurer le suivi des flux et conventions intragroupe : management fees, royalties et autres opérations intragroupes ;
Veiller aux enjeux comptables, fiscaux et de consolidation propres à la holding, en lien avec les fonctions expertes du Groupe et les partenaires externes ;
Interagir avec les fonctions Finance et les différentes entités du Groupe afin de collecter, fiabiliser mais également challenger les informations financières
Coordonner les échanges avec les partenaires externes de la holding, principalement les auditeurs et la fiduciaire.
Ces responsabilités reflètent le périmètre très transverse du poste, entre contrôle financier, enjeux de holding, relations intragroupe et coordination avec les différentes fonctions financières.


MAIS SURTOUT…

Nous recherchons un(e) Finance Business Partner.

Quelqu'un qui ne s'arrête pas au constat d'un écart, mais cherche à comprendre pourquoi il existe, ce qu'il signifie et quelles pourraient en être les conséquences.

Vous devrez être capable d'aller chercher l'information auprès des équipes, de questionner les hypothèses, de challenger un budget ou une dépense et d'identifier suffisamment tôt les risques et les dérives.

Votre objectif : apporter au management une lecture claire, argumentée et prospective de la performance financière, permettant de prendre les bonnes décisions au bon moment.

Vous disposez d'une expérience confirmée en Financial Controlling, Business Controlling, FP&A ou Finance Business Partnering, idéalement acquise dans un groupe international ou un environnement multi-entités.
Vous possédez une solide culture financière et maîtrisez suffisamment les fondamentaux comptables pour appréhender les problématiques d'une holding et dialoguer efficacement avec les fonctions Accounting, Treasury, Controlling et Consolidation. Des connaissances en IFRS sont un réel atout.
Mais votre différence se fera surtout dans votre capacité à aller au-delà des chiffres.

Vous aimez comprendre ce qui se cache derrière un résultat, investiguer un écart, interroger les bons interlocuteurs et transformer vos analyses en recommandations concrètes et exploitables.
Vous savez également challenger avec tact mais avec conviction. Votre aisance relationnelle vous permet d'interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés et de défendre vos analyses de manière factuelle.
Autonome et pragmatique, vous combinez rigueur financière, esprit critique, capacité d'anticipation et force de proposition.
Une expérience dans le pilotage de budgets IT ou de structures de coûts technologiques significatives constituera un véritable atout.
Enfin, vous êtes parfaitement à l'aise pour évoluer en français et en anglais dans un environnement professionnel international.

title: Research Data Specialist (m/f)
description:
Description:


Your role

As a Research Data Specialist, you will support researchers in managing data across the research lifecycle. You will implement FAIR-compliant RDM strategies and collaborate with data and library specialists across faculties, working at the intersection of research and infrastructure in a diverse, forward-looking environment.


Key responsibilities:

• Contribute to the design and implementation of guidelines and procedures for adequate data lifecycle management, standards, documentation, and information security
• Assist with managing data submissions, e.g. sequencing, clinical assay and survey data, handling data access requests and support in downstream processes, while ensuring appropriate documentation and metadata standards
• Facilitate data preservation, archiving and sharing
• Contribute to specific project deliverables as required
• Contribute to the development of innovative discipline-specific services and tools relevant to research data
• Contribute to the development of training materials on relevant topics, including Data Management and Reproducibility
• Contribute to projects, project deliverables, scientific publications, and community work in the field of Data Stewardship
• Contribute to the development and improvement of procedures/practices, as well as novel IT solutions as required by advancements in the field
• Collaborate with IT, Library and Research Support teams to promote coordinated data management services


Your profile:

• Demonstrable experience of collaborative research, research data management and data quality control
• Demonstrable computer programming skills are essential, with good knowledge of CLI and Python/R
• Proven experience using REDCap for the design, management, and export of study data
• Good knowledge of research practice, as well as a broad understanding of how research operates, and how data and software underpin reproducible research
• Knowledge of metadata standards and ontologies relevant to the fields of  life sciences, medicine and health is considered an asset
• Experience with biomedical and health data is considered an asset, including data derived from electronic health records, patient-generated data, clinical, omics, imaging data

We offer:

Main tasks: literature review; design of field experiments and monitoring protocols across multiple urban sites; support and supervision of fieldwork; data analysis and interpretation; stakeholder engagement in the Living Lab; and scientific publications and project deliverables.
• The establishment of a cross-border network of ‘Lighthouses' of phytomanagement for soil remediation, biodiversity and the regenerative economy in the Greater Region (Interreg project Light4Green),
• Scientific and regulatory support, e.g. via bibliography and the preparation of a review article, on nature-based remediation solutions for Persistent organic pollutants (POPs) contamination (Interreg project Naturem),
• The set-up of a laboratory for testing and evaluating soil remediation technologies (especially bioremediation and phytoremediation),
• Support the definition, submission and implementation of research and collaborative project proposals of the group, and participate to the network of LIST's different activities around soil protection.

Reporting to the Head of Banking, you will be responsible for managing and growing a hybrid client portfolio covering:
• GRM-covered relationships (supporting and, where applicable, co-managing selected strategic relationships in partnership with the Global Relationship Manager), and
• GNB – Global Network Banking (Luxembourg and Continental Europe booking needs), including onboarding and ongoing relationship management.


You will focus on delivering sustainable revenue growth through the sale of transactional banking products booked in Luxembourg and Continental Europe, notably Cash Management (GPS) and Securities Services (SSv), as well as identifying opportunities across Global Markets (GM), Credit & Lending, and Asset Management.


In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Manage and grow revenues from the assigned hybrid portfolio (GRM-supported and GNB inbound corporate clients), including identifying cross-sell opportunities and supporting new client acquisition where relevant.
• Act as a key point of contact for day-to-day relationship coverage for designated clients, ensuring a consistent client experience across GRM, GNB and product partners.
• Support Global Relationship Manager (GRM) on selected strategic relationships by coordinating local execution in Luxembourg/Continental Europe (e.g., product delivery, pipeline tracking, client service issues, and internal stakeholder alignment).
• Cover GNB inbound corporate relationships end-to-end, including client engagement, solutioning, and coordination of onboarding and account maintenance activities.
• Take ownership of onboarding, KYC/CDD, periodic reviews and renewals, working closely with internal teams to ensure timely completion and high-quality submissions.
• Support credit-related activities (where applicable) and regularly monitor the portfolio and generate quality assets by utilising appropriate risk management tools, ensuring alignment with HSBC's risk appetite and pricing appropriately for risk.


You should apply if you have:

• Relevant experience in a client-facing relationship management role, ideally with exposure to global coverage models (e.g., GRM/local coverage) and international stakeholders.
• Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, including economic, cultural, procedural and regulatory issues.
• Ability to interact with Corporate and Institutional customers; product knowledge of credit – experience of writing draft credit applications and performing credit analysis is an advantage.
• Solid knowledge of onboarding, KYC and CDD processes, with a track record of driving timely completion across multiple stakeholders.
• Good knowledge of transaction banking products, primarily Cash Management and Payment Solutions (GPS), Securities Services (SSv) and Global Markets (GM) products.
• Strong IT skills to produce quality presentations and other material for client meetings/pitches (Excel, PowerPoint etc.) and strong written and spoken communication skills in English - knowledge of French or German is not mandatory but can be an asset.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.


What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is EUR 87,200 – 120,000.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. description:
HR Business Partner (M/W)

Rockids, a network of nurseries operated by the La Maison Bleue Group, supports children and their families every day through a caring, innovative educational approach focused on children's development. Rockids is a recognized leader in the early childhood sector and operates 24 small-scale centers across Luxembourg, where quality of care, educational excellence, and staff well-being are at the heart of every project.
Joining Rockids means becoming part of a leading international group in the early childhood sector while working within a local, close-knit organization.

As an HR Business Partner, you will help shape the company's HR practices, support managers in their day-to-day challenges, and foster a high-performing work environment that promotes employee development.

Your primary mission will be to support the company's growth by implementing and continuously improving the HR processes that underpin its development.

As a true partner to senior management and teams, you will work across a broad range of responsibilities, including recruitment, HR development, HR administration, project management, and employee relations.

Your Role and Responsibilities

Recruitment and Onboarding

You will be responsible for the full recruitment process, from identifying staffing needs to onboarding new employees.
In this role, you will:

• Analyze hiring needs with facility directors and managers, taking into account staffing levels, operational requirements, and regulatory staff-to-resident ratios.
• Define candidate profiles and draft job descriptions and job postings.
• Post job openings and develop new recruitment channels.
• Proactively propose initiatives to strengthen the Group's attractiveness and employer brand.
• Conduct telephone pre-screenings for key roles across our facilities, including educational assistants, care assistants, educators, and facility managers.
• Conduct interviews and support managers throughout the recruitment process.
• Take a direct role in critical or sensitive hires and support less experienced managers in conducting interviews.
• Support newly appointed department heads as they develop their recruitment skills.
• Manage the administrative follow-up of applications.
• Coordinate the onboarding of new employees and monitor their probationary periods.

Supporting Managers and Teams

As a partner to managers and teams, you will support them in addressing their day-to-day HR challenges.

In particular, you will:

• Provide HR oversight and support to teams.
• Monitor and address absenteeism and turnover.
• Advise managers on disciplinary matters.
• Support skills development and employee development initiatives.
• Support the implementation of HR policies and procedures.
• Provide managers with practical HR advice tailored to operational realities and the specific needs of each location.

HR Administration

Working closely with our third-party service providers and internal teams, you will ensure the reliability and smooth execution of HR administrative processes.

Specifically, you will be responsible for:

• Managing payroll processes, including preparing and submitting payroll data and generating monthly reports.
• Preparing employment contracts and contract amendments.
• Managing and maintaining the HRIS.
• Monitoring administrative procedures related to medical examinations and other regulatory requirements.
• Coordinating end-of-contract procedures.
• Maintaining relationships with our payroll service provider, government authorities, and other HR service providers.

HR Management and Reporting

Specifically, you will be responsible for:

• Maintaining HR dashboards and ensuring the accuracy and reliability of HR data, including turnover and absenteeism figures.
• Analyzing key HR metrics related to absenteeism, turnover, recruitment, and payroll costs.
• Identifying trends and areas of concern and proposing appropriate corrective actions.
• Preparing HR reports and presentations for senior management.
• Developing new HR metrics and reporting tools based on the Group's needs.

HR Projects

You will play an active role in shaping and developing the Group's HR strategy and policies.

In particular, you will:

• Contribute to defining and implementing the HR strategy.
• Structure and continuously improve HR processes, particularly in the areas of recruitment and onboarding.
• Oversee the onboarding process for new employees.
• Implement and monitor training and skills development programs.
• Participate in interview campaigns and performance review processes.
• Contribute to the development of the employer brand and internal communications.
• Conduct employee engagement and satisfaction surveys, analyze the results, and propose action plans.
• Participate in discussions regarding salary structures and compensation, in collaboration with senior management.
• Support the implementation of new HR tools and processes.
• Proactively suggest initiatives to improve the employee experience.

Compliance and HR Monitoring

You will ensure compliance with the legal and regulatory framework applicable to the company and will:
• Monitor developments in employment law and HR regulations.
• Collaborate with our law firm and external partners on matters requiring specific expertise.
• Support management in handling sensitive individual employee situations.

We are looking for an HR professional with at least 3 years of experience in a generalist HR role or as an HR Business Partner, ideally in a multi-site environment.
You have a solid understanding of HR practices and are comfortable working across the key areas of the HR function.

Qualifications and Skills

• Your ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
• Your attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
• Your analytical and problem-solving abilities, as well as your ability to synthesize information.
• Your excellent interpersonal skills and ability to build trusting relationships with managers and colleagues.
• Your pragmatic, solution-oriented approach.

title: Research Scientist in Economics of Sustainability (m/f)
description:
Description:


Language: English (UK)
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Luxembourg Centre for Socio-Environmental Systems
Job Number: UOL08508
Contract Type: Permanent
Expected Start Date: 01/11/2026

Job Level: level 1
Functions: Researcher
Role Type: Cluster
Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist


Your role:

The successful candidate will establish internationally visible research at the interface of economics, sustainability science and global environmental change, developing new quantitative approaches to understand and steer transformations across food, land, water and natural-resource systems.
The candidate's research will combine economic theory, fine-scale spatial data, empirical evidence and computational modelling to explain trade-offs, synergies and spillovers that remain hidden in single-scale analyses. Relevant research may address at least three of the following fields: agricultural production, labor markets, natural-resource scarcity, food security, climate change, technological change, impacts of demographic transition, social cohesion, resilience of supply chains, environmental policy, and the distributional consequences of sustainability transformations.
A key ambition is to move beyond diagnosing unsustainable trajectories towards designing effective and equitable transformation pathways, exploring how policy, innovation and global interconnectedness can reconcile environmental sustainability with food security, livelihoods and economic development.


Your profile:

The successful candidate holds a strong academic background in economics, agricultural or environmental economics, together with an internationally recognized research record. They have demonstrated expertise in economic theory and quantitative modelling, complemented by experience with spatially explicit data, empirical estimation, computational methods or other approaches capable of linking processes across scales.
Additionally, they can translate theoretical concepts into transparent, empirically grounded models and integrate economic analysis with insights and data from other disciplines. Experience in interdisciplinary research on food, land, water, climate, natural resources or related sustainability challenges can be proven by documented participation within interdisciplinary networks and projects.
The successful candidate is an intellectually independent researcher with the ambition to build a collaborative, interdisciplinary research team, attract competitive research funding, develop innovative methodological approaches and contribute to policy-relevant sustainability science. A commitment to open, reproducible research, excellent communication across disciplinary boundaries, and the ability to engage effectively with policy and practice are essential.


The ideal candidate will have:

• A PhD in a relevant field and a minimum of 4 years Postdoc experience demonstrating ability to independently develop a research agenda
• A strong capability to think out of the box and shape their research around the challenges posed by interdisciplinary questions
• A strong record of research excellence, evidenced by impactful publications and success in securing external research funding
• Willingness to contribute to teaching programmes at the undergraduate and graduate levels in areas related to environmental change and socio-environmental systems


Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired for this position must have an excellent command of English. The University encourages its staff to learn additional languages and provides access to language courses to this end.


We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance


How to apply:

Applications should contain:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable


All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.


General Information:

• Reference: UOL08508 (to be mentioned in all correspondence)
• Publication date: -
• Contract Type: Permanent
• Working Hours:  
• Location: Belval Campus
• Planned starting date: 01/11/2026


Gender equality:

In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, diversity and a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of everybody is respected. The University is committed to achieving gender parity among its academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.
