title: Senior Logistics Engineer
description:
At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective grocery system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and everyone’s opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistical problems, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact. Read on to find out what part you could play in our story.

Our world-class logistics and tech solutions allow us to reduce food waste, save time and money, and ease the mental and physical load for people who want more space for life.

Lastly we are entering the space of becoming a logistics systems provider to serve other online grocery players meaning we are commercializing our hardware blueprint, our proprietary smart software and our ways of working into Oda systems - our new brand and business area!

We’re looking for a Senior Logistics Engineer to join Oda!

As our new Senior Logistics Engineer, you will take ownership of core physical process flows, optimize layout solutions, and lead physical installation projects from concept to commissioning. You will play a vital role in ensuring that our technical and physical solutions optimize unit economics, maximize throughput, and eliminate waste across our operations.

What you’ll be doing

    

Process Ownership & Optimization: Design, implement, and continuously improve physical process flows, layout solutions, process dependencies, and supporting systems to maximize throughput and operational efficiency.

    

Lead Installation Projects: Drive and manage physical installation projects for equipment, hardware, and infrastructure from initial concept through to commissioning.

    

Cost Control & Insights: Analyze cost drivers within the process flow and ensure all technical and physical solutions directly optimize unit economics and bottom-line results.

    

Lean Application: Apply Lean manufacturing principles to eliminate waste, enhance safety, and foster a continuous improvement culture.

    

Operational Collaboration: Work closely with on-site operational teams to ensure drawings and technical designs function seamlessly in daily operations and execute smooth handovers.

    

Flexibility: Step up and contribute to responsibilities beyond the core job description when the team or business needs it.

To thrive in this role, You are analytical and strategic with a sharp eye for cost drivers and unit economics. You excel at switching abstraction levels effortlessly, combining a precise attention to detail with the strategic bird’s-eye view. As a highly structured project manager, you have the drive to push process improvements and complex physical implementations forward.

You are communicative and highly collaborative, capable of building strong bridges between on-site operations, software developers, designers, data analysts, and product managers. Above all, you are self-driven, confident in taking full ownership of entire processes, and act in alignment with our shared behaviors and values.

What you’ll need to succeed

Education: Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Process Engineering, or an equivalent relevant field.

Operational Experience: 5–10 years of hands-on experience within Lean manufacturing, industrial production, or logistics environments.

Project Management: Proven track record of successfully leading complex, physical installation projects from concept to completion (delivered on time and within budget).

Technical Competence: A solid understanding of modern software development methodologies.

Business Acumen: Strong financial and operational understanding of cost drivers and how process design impacts the bottom line.

Language: Fluent in spoken and written English.

What would be nice to have

    

Experience scaling logistics or fulfillment center infrastructure in rapid-growth environments.

    

You value innovation and enjoy working in an AI-integrated environment where we constantly iterate on what’s possible.

What we offer

    

A chance to make a real impact at a company with products and services people actually love.

    

Join a team that shoots high, supports each other, and genuinely has each other’s backs.

    

Solve problems and spark ideas together across teams-the best solutions can come from anyone.

    

Fewer emails, fewer boring meetings, more getting things done. We use Slack to keep everyone in the loop.

    

A bright, modern office right in the heart of our Larsboda fulfillment center, with a free gym and delicious, affordable lunches cooked by our very own chefs 💪🧑‍🍳

    

A unique chance to help shape the grocery store of the future-and be part of a company that’s here to stay.

Practical Information

    

Application deadline: 08.11.26

    

Percentage: 100%

    

Location: Tøyen, Oslo OR Larsboda, Sverige

    

Background check: required prior to hire

We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

title: ELA Teacher (100%), Bladins International School of Malmö
description:
At Bladins International School of Malmö (BISM), we are looking for an enthusiastic and committed English Language Acquisition (ELA) Teacher to join our Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP), starting in January 2027.

If you are a dedicated teacher who enjoys supporting students in developing their English language skills, building positive relationships and working in an international environment, we would love to hear from you.

About Bladins International School of Malmö

Bladins International School of Malmö (BISM) is an IB Continuum School located in central Malmö. We offer the IB Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP) to approximately 370 students representing a wide range of nationalities and cultures. We are proud to be part of a global network of IB World Schools.

As part of Bladins Foundation, a non-profit educational organisation with a long tradition of academic excellence, we are committed to providing a supportive, internationally minded learning environment where students are encouraged to become knowledgeable, caring and responsible global citizens.

The Role

As an ELA Teacher across our PYP and MYP, you will plan, teach and assess English language acquisition, supporting students with varying levels of English proficiency in developing the language skills needed to participate fully in their learning and school community.

You will work closely with classroom teachers, subject teachers and other colleagues across the school to provide engaging, inclusive and high-quality language learning experiences for our students.

Key responsibilities include:

    

Planning and delivering engaging and differentiated English language acquisition lessons for students in PYP and MYP

    

Assessing students' English language proficiency, monitoring progress and adapting instruction to meet individual learning needs

    

Supporting students in developing their listening, speaking, reading and writing skills

    

Providing targeted language support to students with different linguistic backgrounds and levels of English proficiency

    

Collaborating with classroom and subject teachers to support language development across the curriculum

    

Creating a safe, inclusive and motivating learning environment that values multilingualism and cultural diversity

    

Building positive and professional relationships with students, colleagues and families

    

Contributing actively to the wider school community and school development

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for a qualified and committed teacher who is passionate about language acquisition, inclusive education and student development.

You are:

    

A qualified teacher, preferably with qualifications in English language teaching, English as an Additional Language (EAL), English as a Second Language (ESL) or a related field

    

Experienced in teaching English language learners with varying levels of language proficiency

    

Skilled at planning differentiated instruction and adapting teaching to meet individual learning needs

    

Passionate about creating engaging and meaningful language learning experiences

    

Skilled at building positive relationships with students

    

Collaborative and comfortable working as part of an international team

    

Committed to inclusive education and supporting multilingual learners

    

Organised, flexible and able to take responsibility for planning, teaching and assessment

    

Committed to continuous professional growth

Previous experience of teaching within the International Baccalaureate (IB), particularly the PYP and/or MYP, is an advantage. Experience of supporting English language acquisition across different age groups is also highly valued.

Since English is the working language of the school, you must be able to communicate professionally in English, both verbally and in writing.

Why Join BISM?

At BISM, you will join a welcoming international community where people genuinely care about students, colleagues and learning.

We offer:

    

An international and multicultural working environment

    

Opportunities for professional development and growth

    

Dedicated and supportive colleagues

    

The opportunity to work within an IB learning environment

    

The chance to make a positive impact on students' learning and development

Employment Information

Position: English Language Acquisition (ELA) Teacher Employment type: Permanent employment (6-month probation period) Working hours: Full-time (100%) Start date: January 2027

Application

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The application deadline is 1 November 2026.

For more information about the position, please contact:

Kumari Nevill, Primary School Principal Kumari.nevill@bladins.se

We look forward to welcoming a new colleague who shares our commitment to high-quality education, collaboration and student success.

title: SSAB - Cybersecurity Architect
description:
Full-time permanent role based in Stockholm or Helsinki leading SSAB's cybersecurity architecture and ensuring Secure-by-Design principles are embedded across cloud, applications, infrastructure, OT environments, and strategic transformation programs.

Becoming part of the SSAB family means joining a journey. A journey that we believe is essential for the sustainability of this planet. Steel has been one of the most important materials for developing our society and it will continue to be so. In the roofs over our heads, in the bridges connecting our cities and in the cars of tomorrow. At SSAB we are proud of our history and leadership in high-strength steel. But we are also aware that the production of steel is one of the largest emitters of greenhouse gases in the world. That has to change. That is why we have developed the world’s ﬁrst fossil free steel production and has committed to becoming largely fossil-free. As part of SSAB you will be instrumental in realizing this goal and push for the green transformation of the whole steel industry.

We are looking for an experienced Cybersecurity Architect to help shape and secure SSAB's digital future. In this strategic role, you will define and evolve our cybersecurity architecture, standards, and security requirements working closely with technology teams, suppliers, and supporting our key transformation initiatives and projects.

Your mission is to ensure cybersecurity is built into solutions from the start, enabling secure cloud adoption, business transformation, OT modernization, and responsible use of emerging technologies.

This role combines long-term architectural leadership with hands-on design reviews, threat modelling, and security guidance. You will help teams across all our divisions make better security decisions, reduce technical security debt, and establish a scalable security architecture that supports SSAB's business objectives.

This role reports to our Group CISO, Markus Lalla and can be based in Stockholm or Helsinki.

Main Responsibilities

    Define and maintain SSAB's cybersecurity architecture strategy and target-state
    Establish security standards, reference architectures, and ensure Secure-by-Design principles are embedded into all business transformation programs and technology initiatives
    Review and provide guidance on cloud, application, identity, network, infrastructure, and OT architectures
    Drive cyersecurity architecture assessments, threat modelling, and design reviews
    Identify architectural cybersecurity gaps and advice teams in remediating technical debt and vulnerabilities
    Develop cybersecurity requirements for secure software development and DevSecOps practices
    Support Zero Trust, identity governance, cloud security, and emerging technology initiatives
    Collaborate with suppliers, architects, and engineering teams to ensure effective implementation of security controls across the organization



About You

    You have extensive experience (typically 10+ years) in cybersecurity architecture, cloud security, infrastructure architecture, or software/security engineering
    You have proven experience designing enterprise security architecture in complex organizations and hands-on implementation skills integrating cybersecurity systems such as vulnerability scanning tools or a SOAR platform, as an example
    You have strong expertise in Azure and hybrid-cloud security architecture where Azure Solutions Architect Expert or equivalent cloud architecture certification is seen as an advantage
    You have wide experience with application security, identity and access management, network security, and infrastructure security
    You have good understanding of AI and ML tools and their applications in security solutions
    You are experienced in performing architecture reviews, threat modelling, and security risk assessments
    You hold certifications such as CISSP, GICSP or those within SABSA and TOGAF. The knowledge base of the IEC62443 umbrella is highly appreciated in order to efficiently operate in industrial manufacturing and supplier ecosystems.
    You can translate technical security requirements into clear and actionable guidance for architects, developers, and project teams, while building strong stakeholder relationships that drive adoption of cybersecurity practices
    You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. Proficiency in one or more Nordic languages is considered an advantage



Recruitment Process

    Apply
    Digital Interview
    Meet the Hiring Manager
    Case Assignment
    Meet the Team and a few key stakeholders
    Pre-Offer Checks (including health check for Finland based candidates)
    Sign!



Got Questions? Please Contact:

Julia Källmar, Group Talent Acquisition Partner, julia.kallmar@ssab.com

We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

Please submit your application in English. We look forward to speaking to you!

SSAB is a Nordic and US-based steel company that builds a stronger, lighter and more sustainable world through value added steel products and services. Working with our partners, SSAB has developed SSAB Fossil-free™ steel and plans to reinvent the value chain from the mine to the end customer, largely eliminating carbon dioxide emissions from our own operations. SSAB Zero™, a largely carbon emission-free steel based on recycled steel, further strengthens SSAB’s leadership position and our comprehensive, sustainable offering independent of the raw material. SSAB has employees in over 50 countries and production facilities in Sweden, Finland and the US. SSAB is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm and has a secondary listing on Nasdaq Helsinki. Join us on our journey! www.ssab.com, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X and YouTube.

title: Site Manager till FirstOffice Stockholm
description:

Konceptet bygger på att det ska vara enkelt att flytta in och enkelt att vara kund – kontor, service och gemensamma ytor samlas i en flexibel helhetslösning där företagen kan fokusera på sin egen verksamhet.

Läs mer om FirstOffice här: FirstOffice

Om rollen

Som Site Manager ansvarar du för flera av FirstOffice enheter i Stockholm. Rollen är bred, självständig och affärsnära, där du är naturlig del av den dagliga verksamheten och har regelbunden kontakt med kunder och medlemmar. Du arbetar med allt från visningar, uthyrning och inflyttningar till att lösa praktiska frågor och säkerställa att service och drift håller en hög nivå.

Teamet du ingår i utgår från Kista och där finns även FirstOffice tjänstebilar. Du kommer att ha fasta dagar då du jobbar från kontoret i Kista och övriga dagar utgår du från de FirstOffice-enheter du ansvarar för.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden

I rollen ansvarar du för att skapa en välfungerande vardag för våra kunder och samtidigt driva affären framåt. Du arbetar både operativt och relationsskapande, med tydligt fokus på service, uthyrning och resultat.

Du kommer bland annat att:

    

Driva och utveckla dina enheter mot uppsatta mål inom uthyrning, kundnöjdhet och resultat

    

Bearbeta leads, genomföra visningar och driva uthyrningsprocessen från första kontakt till tecknat avtal

    

Bygga och utveckla långsiktiga relationer med både befintliga och potentiella kunder

    

Säkerställa en hög servicenivå och en välfungerande daglig drift på enheterna

    

Arbeta aktivt med nätverkande, kundaktiviteter och lokal marknadsbearbetning

    

Ansvara för budget, resultatuppföljning samt planering och utveckling av dina enheter

    

Samarbeta nära med övriga Site Managers, Service Managers och andra funktioner inom FirstOffice och Corem

Vi söker

Vi söker dig som trivs i en bred och operativ roll där du är nära både verksamheten och kunderna. Du har ett naturligt affärsdriv, tycker om att bygga relationer och ser möjligheter i det dagliga kundmötet. title: Marketing Coordinator Miele Professional Sverige
description:
Are you a hands-on marketing professional who enjoys turning ideas into action? Would you like to take ownership of local marketing activities while being part of a global premium brand?

At Miele Professional, we are looking for a proactive and digitally skilled Marketing Coordinator to join our B2B team in Solna. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys a varied role, combining digital marketing, campaign execution, content creation and close collaboration with sales and international marketing teams.

Your role

As Marketing Coordinator for Sweden, you will be responsible for coordinating and implementing local marketing activities within our HCS and LMD customer segments. You will play a key role in bringing regional and international marketing strategies to life in the Swedish market, ensuring that campaigns, product launches and communication activities are relevant, engaging and effectively executed.

This is a hands-on role with considerable independence, where you will work closely with the Swedish sales and service teams while collaborating with regional marketing colleagues and other stakeholders across our international organisation.

What you will be doing

Bringing marketing plans to life

You will translate regional marketing strategies and corporate objectives into effective local activities for the Swedish market. This includes coordinating product launches, promotions and marketing campaigns, ensuring that international initiatives are successfully adapted and implemented locally.

Working closely with the Regional Marketing Directors you will provide local market insights and input regarding products, consumables, digital services and pricing.

Driving digital marketing and customer engagement

A key part of your role will be to attract new customers, strengthen brand awareness and support customer retention, both directly and through our partners. You will coordinate and execute lead generation initiatives and digital marketing activities, ensuring that Miele Professional remains visible and relevant across digital channels.

You will also create, adapt and enrich local marketing content, including articles, customer success stories and reference cases for online and offline communication. Ensuring the quality and relevance of our Swedish marketing materials will be another important responsibility.

Supporting sales and strengthening Mieles premium positioning

You will work closely with our Swedish sales and service teams to ensure that marketing activities support commercial priorities and customer needs.

This includes developing and providing relevant sales and marketing materials, as well as planning and coordinating local events, trade fairs and training activities in line with corporate.

Managing project, budgets and stakeholders

You will coordinate the local marketing plan and budget, ensuring that activities are delivered on time, within budget and to a high standard.

As part of an international matrix organisation, you will collaborate with a broad network of stakeholders, including the Regional Management Team, sales and service teams, business partners, marketing colleagues across North West Europe and external marketing agencies.

Who are you?

We believe you are an experienced and hands-on marketing professional who enjoys taking ownership and making things happen. You have a strong understanding of B2B marketing and know how to turn marketing strategies into practical activities that generate results. You are equally comfortable coordinating a digital campaign, adapting content for a local audience, supporting a product launch or collaborating with sales colleagues on lead generation initiatives.

You thrive in an international environment, enjoy working with different stakeholders and are confident managing several projects simultaneously. Most importantly, you are someone who takes initiative, identifies opportunities and drives activities forward independently, while knowing when to involve and collaborate with others.

Your background

We are looking for someone with:

· A bachelor's or master's degree in marketing or a related field.

· Relevant marketing experience, with a strong operational and hands-on focus.

· Experience coordinating and implementing local marketing activities in line with regional or international strategies.

· Proven digital marketing experience, including areas such as performance marketing, SEO, social media and AI-supported marketing tools.

· Excellent Swedish communication and strong communication skills in English.

· Experience working in an international matrix organisation and managing cross-functional projects is an advantage.

What we offer

At Miele Professional, you will have the opportunity to work with a well-established global premium brand in a role that combines local ownership with international collaboration.

You will be part of a professional and supportive environment where your initiative, expertise and ability to deliver results can make a real difference.

Practical information

Location: Solna, Sweden

Employment: Full-time, temporary position covering parental leave

Period: Ideally November 2026 – February 2028

Ready to make an impact?

We look forward to receiving your application and learning more about how you could contribute to Miele Professional's continued growth in Sweden.

title: Product Analyst – Data & Risk 100%
description:
Location: Stockholm, Sweden (Onsite)

We are seeking four detail-oriented and analytical Product Analysts to support our Data & Risk product family on an extendable 12-month contract basis.

This is a flexible, hands-on role spanning two closely connected areas of work:

1. Product analysis, quality and validation for Data Enrichment products; and
2. Data labeling and AI/model quality validation for Machine Learning capabilities.

The Product Analysts will move between these areas as business priorities require. They will help ensure that merchant and transaction data is accurately classified, product outputs meet expected quality standards, customer and operational feedback is translated into actionable insight, and product teams can make confident, data-informed decisions.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys structured problem-solving, analysing data and system behaviour, identifying quality issues, and working closely with product, engineering, data science, and operations stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

Product Analysis and Quality Support

* Support the Merchant Information product team in analysing product performance, quality signals, customer feedback, and operational data.
* Query, structure, and analyse data to identify patterns, recurring issues, inconsistencies, and opportunities for product improvement.
* Create clear visualisations, reports, and summaries that help stakeholders understand performance, quality, progress, and priority areas.
* Support product discovery and delivery by clarifying requirements, documenting expected behaviour, and translating feedback into structured findings.
* Assist with testing, validation, and quality assurance activities, including validating product behaviour during releases, migrations, and changes to data-processing logic.
* Investigate discrepancies between expected and actual product outputs and work with relevant teams to define and track resolution actions.
* Maintain lightweight documentation of findings, quality assessments, test outcomes, decisions, and follow-up actions.

Data Labeling and AI Quality Validation

* Label and classify transaction and merchant data used to train and improve machine learning and AI models.
* Review and quality assure labeled datasets to ensure accuracy, consistency, completeness, and adherence to defined guidelines.
* Validate AI-generated labels and model outputs, identifying misclassifications, edge cases, data-quality issues, and improvement opportunities.
* Analyse model and classification performance using appropriate measures, including precision, recall, accuracy, F1 score, and confusion matrices.
* Support validation activities for machine learning models and AI-assisted workflows, including models hosted on platforms such as Google Vertex AI.
* Work with Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers to improve labeling guidelines, training-data quality, validation processes, and model performance.
* Contribute to the evolution of internal tools, quality frameworks, validation processes, and operating practices as labeling workflows become increasingly automated.


Required Skills and Experience

* 1–3 years of relevant experience in a product analyst, data analyst, data quality, QA, product operations, data labeling, or similar role in a technology-driven environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail and consistency.
* Comfortable working with data using tools such as SQL, spreadsheets, dashboards, or similar analytical tooling.
* Experience working with large datasets, data-quality processes, testing, validation, or business-rule assessment.
* Ability to investigate issues end-to-end, identify patterns and root causes, and communicate findings clearly.
* Understanding of core machine-learning concepts and workflows, including the importance of high-quality training data and model validation.
* Familiarity with classification problems and/or data annotation, labeling, or taxonomy-based workflows.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and to manage changing priorities.


Preferred Skills and Experience

* Experience analysing transaction data, merchant data, categorisation systems, or other financial-data classification problems.
* Experience with data labeling, annotation, model validation, or AI-assisted labeling workflows.
* Familiarity with model-evaluation concepts and metrics, including precision, recall, F1 score, accuracy, and confusion matrices.
* Experience supporting AI, machine-learning, MLOps, or data-platform environments.
* Familiarity with Google Vertex AI or comparable machine-learning platforms.
* Experience using SQL to investigate data issues and support product or quality analysis.
* Experience with test planning, regression testing, migration validation, or release-quality activities.
* Experience turning customer feedback or operational issues into structured analysis and product recommendations.

What You Will Deliver

During the engagement, Product Analysts will help the team to:

* Improve the accuracy, consistency, and coverage of merchant and transaction categorisation data.
* Establish reliable quality checks for labeled data, AI-generated outputs, and product behaviour.
* Identify and document product, data, and model-quality issues with clear supporting evidence.
* Provide actionable analysis that helps product, engineering, and data-science teams prioritise improvements.
* Support confident releases and migrations through structured testing and validation.
* Strengthen documentation, reporting, and quality-management practices across Data Enrichment and machine learning models.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for people who are:

* Highly detail-oriented, methodical, and quality-focused.
* Curious about how data, products, and AI systems work.
* Comfortable switching between operational execution and analytical problem-solving.
* Proactive in identifying issues and following them through to resolution.
* Able to work independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
* Comfortable operating in an evolving environment where priorities may shift between product analysis, testing, data validation, and labeling work.

Why This Engagement

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of product quality, financial data, machine learning, and AI operations. You will contribute directly to improving the data and product experiences that power our data products while gaining practical exposure to modern data and AI validation workflows.

title: Compliance Officer - AML & Sanctions to TFS Group Compliance Function
description:
Compliance Officer – AML & Sanctions to TFS Group Compliance Function



Role Summary

We are looking for a senior Compliance Officer – AML and Sanctions to join our Compliance Function at TFS Head Office. The role is part of the broader Anti-Financial Crime Compliance function, with a special focus on Anti-Money Laundering, Counter-Terrorist Financing and Sanctions.

The position reports to the Chief Compliance Officer and is functionally led the AFC Compliance Officer. Within this framework, you will have a high degree of autonomy and responsibility for providing regulatory expertise, risk assessment, compliance monitoring, advisory work and stakeholder management, with the opportunity to influence and strengthen how AML and Sanctions requirements are implemented across the organization.

You will work across a complex international environment, supporting not only TFS and its entities in multiple jurisdictions, but also offer the same AML support to our sister company Scania Group and its head office compliance function. We work in a collaborative environment also with other brands of the TRATON Group including MAN, International Motors and Volkswagen Truck & Bus.

The position is based in Stockholm/ Södertälje, with access to offices in both locations, with international exposure and some travel expected.  



Job Responsibilities

AML and Sanctions Adisory and Oversight  

Provide independent second-line advice and oversight on AML, CTF and Sanctions risks and regulatory requirements across the organization in TFS and Scania on AML. Assess the adequacy and effectiveness of relevant policies, processes and internal controls and provide expert compliance advice to business and senior stakeholders on complex AML and Sanctions matters.

Risk Assessments and Incident Oversight – Conduct and contribute to AML and Sanctions risk assessments, compliance monitoring and thematic reviews across regions and entities. Assess emerging financial-crime risks and control effectiveness, and provide recommendations and appropriate escalation of maternal issues, incidents and remediation activities.

Regulatory Framework Development - Contribute to the maintenance and continuous development of the AML and Sanctions compliance framework, including policies, standard, procedures and guidance. Provide specialist regulatory interpretation and translate regulatory developments into practical compliance requirements and recommendations. Support the effective implementation of AML and Sanctions requirements across relevant parts of the organisation.

Reporting & Advisory – Provide analysis and reporting on AML and Sanctions compliance, key risks, emerging issues and regulatory developments to relevant forums. Deliver forward-looking advice and recommendations to support informed decision-making and effective compliance oversight.

Stakeholder Engagement, Training & Collaboration - Build strong working relationships across Compliance, Risk, Legal and the business, including regional and entity level teams. Provide specialist guidance and support to colleagues on AML and Sanctions matters. Contribute to the development and delivery of AML and Sanctions training and awareness initiatives, and collaborate with stakeholders across TFS, Scania and the wider TRATON Group on relevant compliance activities and Group-wide initiatives.



Who You Are

You hold a Master’s degree and bring 7-10+ years of relevant experience from regulated environments, preferably within financial services, banking, insurance or similarly complex international structures.

You have deep expertise in:

    Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing
    Sanctions compliance and sanctions risk management
    AML and sanctions risk assessment
    Compliance monitoring and second line oversight
    Financial crime risks, typologies and emerging threats
    Regulatory interpretation and implementation
    Compliance frameworks, policies, and controls
    Working across complex international organizations

You have solid experience in AML regulated environments such as financial and banking services, captive finance or an internationally regulated financial institutions.

You are familiar with EU and Swedish AML and Sanctions requirements and have an understanding of international regulatory frameworks, including relevant UK and US requirements.

This Is Us

You will join a highly experienced and international GRC and Compliance Team at a time of continued development and increasing regulatory complexity. Our organization operates globally, supporting sustainable transportation through responsible financial services and you will have the ability to support and work with other colleagues in the compliance functions at both TFS and Scania as well as the respective global networks and business stakeholders.

The home office is based in Södertälje, with access to a group-wide hub in central Stockholm. We offer flexible working arrangements adapted to business needs and role requirements, including international collaboration and some travel.

TRATON Financial Services Offers

We believe great work starts with feeling supported, both professionally and personally. That’s why we offer a broad range of employee benefits designed to promote wellbeing, flexibility, and a healthy work-life balance. Employees can enjoy flexible working hours and a workplace that supports both collaboration and flexibility. With office Hubs in Södertälje and Stockholm, you will have the best preconditions to pick the best workplace for your activities.

We provide a yearly wellness contribution and you can train at our health center Gröndal in Södertälje, and you will access to occupational health services with doctors, nurses, and ergonomists. Mental health is important to us, therefore we also offer confidential staff support services for guidance related to personal challenges.

More info provided on the website - please follow the link provided.

Application

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-25. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check is required for this role.

We look forward to your application!

Your work will strengthen data integrity, streamline engineering workflows, and enable effective cross-functional collaboration throughout the product lifecycle. You bring extensive experience in product data management, strong leadership capabilities in a technical environment, and a proven ability to manage complex engineering data structures.

What You Need to Make a Difference

    Strategic Data Governance & Framework Establishment

    Define, implement, and maintain the product data governance strategy, standards, and policies for the Medium Gas Turbines business area.
    Establish data quality metrics, ownership models, and compliance frameworks to ensure product data integrity across the entire lifecycle.
    Align product data governance initiatives with broader organizational digital transformation roadmaps and corporate standards.

    Tools, Processes & Lifecycle Management

    Lead the consolidation, optimization, and governance of product data tools, PLM systems, and associated engineering workflows to improve data quality, efficiency, and lifecycle traceability.
    Collaborate with engineering, IT, and operations to streamline data exchange, system integration, and configuration management processes.
    Establish and maintain standards for configuration control and product structure definition across relevant technical teams.

    Leadership & Capability Building

    Build, lead, and develop the newly formed Product Data Governance department, managing capacity planning and competency development.
    Promote data-driven ways of working across the Product Lifecycle organization and sister business units by establishing clear ownership, shared standards, and effective collaboration.
    Manage departmental budget, resource allocation, and stakeholder communications up to senior leadership levels.



Education

    Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, computer science, information management, or a related technical field.
    At least eight years of experience in product data management, product lifecycle management, or data governance within a complex engineering or manufacturing environment.
    Proven track record of leadership, team building, and managing organizational change in a multinational setup.

Skills

    Data Governance & Management: Strong expertise in Product Data Management (PDM), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), data quality and integrity, configuration management, and Master Data Management (MDM).
    Leadership & Strategy: Proven ability to translate product data strategy into clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and sustainable ways of working, combined with strong capabilities in team leadership and development, strategic planning, stakeholder management, change management, and resource and capacity planning.
    Technical & Domain Knowledge: Strong knowledge of engineering data systems, gas turbine product structures, and process optimization, combined with excellent communication skills in Swedish and English and the ability to explain complex product data topics to both technical and senior leadership audiences.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. title: Structural Analysis Engineer  Advanced CAE  Husqvarna Group
description:
Help shape robust, high-performing products through advanced structural analysis. As a Structural Analysis Engineer in our Advanced CAE team, you will turn simulations into clear engineering decisions—from early concepts to product verification.

The team is an experienced specialist team within R&D in Huskvarna and work closely with design engineers, test engineers, project teams, and other experts across Husqvarna Group. The role gives you broad exposure to the product-development process and the opportunity to influence both product design and the way we use simulation.

Role Description

In this role you will plan, perform, and evaluate structural analyses throughout the product-development process. Your work will support concept selection, design improvements, verification, and root-cause investigations. The analyses may include linear and nonlinear structural behavior, durability, dynamics, and impact, depending on product and project needs.

As a Structural Analysis Engineer, you will take technical ownership of your analyses: defining the question, selecting an appropriate method, assessing model quality and assumptions, interpreting results, and communicating conclusions and recommendations. Collaboration with physical testing and design functions to build confidence in the results is another part of this role, as is contributing to improved methods, automation, guidelines, and good CAE practices across the organisation.

Your profile

We are looking for someone who combines sound engineering judgement with curiosity and a practical approach to problem-solving. You are comfortable working independently, while actively seeking input and sharing knowledge with others. The ability to explain complex analysis results in a way that helps colleagues and project teams making well-founded decisions is also an important trait.

You structure your work, take responsibility for quality and delivery, and can balance several assignments in a project-driven environment. Just as importantly, you are motivated by learning—deepening your expertise, exploring new methods, and contributing to the development of the team.

What you bring

    A Master’s degree, or equivalent competence, in mechanical engineering, engineering physics, or a related field with a focus on structural mechanics
    Relevant professional experience in structural analysis or CAE, including finite element analysis
    The ability to define analysis tasks, assess assumptions and model quality, interpret results, and provide actionable engineering recommendations
    The ability to communicate technical content clearly in reports, presentations, and engineering discussions
    Very good spoken and written English
    Swedish-language skills, or a willingness to develop them

It is an advantage if you also have experience in one or more of the following areas:

    Pre- and post-processing in ANSA and META
    Solvers or multibody tools such as LS-DYNA, Nastran, or Adams
    Nonlinear analysis, dynamics, impact, fatigue, or correlation between simulation and physical testing
    Python scripting, workflow automation, and AI-assisted software development
    Exploring or implementing AI and agent-based solutions for simulation workflows, engineering decision support, knowledge reuse, or quality assurance
    Working in a Linux environment

Location

Huskvarna. This role requires you to work on site at our Huskvarna office at least four days per week. We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This approach helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Your application

Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. For more questions regarding the position please contact:

Hiring Manager: Per Carlén, per.carlen@husqvarnagroup.com. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

Processing of personal data

When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice.

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.

Our culture is built on three core themes:

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

title: Rekrytering Servicechef
description:
Finnvedsbostäder AB är ett allmännyttigt bostadsbolag som ska bidra till en fungerande bostadsmarknad. Finnvedbostäder ägs av Värnamo kommun med det huvudsakliga ändamålet att främja bostadsförsörjningen i kommunen, och är idag en verksamhet som ska bedrivas enligt affärsmässiga principer. I uppdraget ligger också att ha en strategiskt hållbar förvaltning och fastighetsutveckling för attraktiva boenden – både idag och imorgon. Vi kan idag stolt summera ett fastighetsbestånd på över 3 000 bostäder och lokaler.

Servicechef till Finnvedsbostäder i Värnamo

Vill du vara med och skapa attraktiva, hållbara och välskötta boendemiljöer?

På Finnvedsbostäder tror vi att ett attraktivt bostadsområde handlar om mer än byggnader. Det handlar om gröna och välskötta utemiljöer, trygga och inbjudande mötesplatser och ett långsiktigt arbete för hållbarhet och trivsel.

Nu söker vi en servicechef som vill leda och utveckla arbetet med våra utemiljöer och serviceområden. Vi söker dig som kombinerar ett genuint intresse för människor med ett engagemang för utemiljö, hållbarhetsfrågor och utveckling av attraktiva bostadsområden.

Om rollen

Som servicechef har du det övergripande ansvaret för bolagets grönytor, sophantering, löpande drift och felavhjälpande underhåll inom ansvarsområdet.

Tillsammans med dina medarbetare arbetar du för att våra bostadsområden ska vara välskötta, trivsamma och attraktiva för våra hyresgäster.

Du leder en grupp på 14 medarbetare och är en synlig och närvarande ledare i verksamheten. Du finns nära det dagliga arbetet, skapar engagemang och delaktighet samt arbetar aktivt för att utveckla både verksamheten och medarbetarna.

Vi söker dig som ser möjligheter före problem och som drivs av att arbeta förebyggande och långsiktigt snarare än att enbart lösa uppkomna situationer. Du har förmågan att skapa en kultur där medarbetarna arbetar proaktivt, tar ansvar och känner stolthet över resultatet.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden

    Leda, coacha och utveckla medarbetarna i den dagliga verksamheten.
    Planera och prioritera arbetet för att skapa attraktiva, välvårdade och trygga bostadsområden.
    Driva utvecklingen av våra utemiljöer med fokus på trivsel, kvalitet och hållbarhet.
    Arbeta aktivt med frågor kopplade till biologisk mångfald, hållbar förvaltning och nya miljökrav.
    Ansvara för bolagets källsorterings- och miljöstationer och utveckla arbetet kring hållbar resurshantering.
    Planera och följa upp verksamhetens budget, mål och resultat.
    Säkerställa att verksamheten använder maskiner, fordon och utrustning på ett effektivt och säkert sätt.
    Bidra till utveckling av arbetssätt som stärker både service, kvalitet och arbetsmiljö.
    Samverka med områdeschefer och övriga funktioner för att skapa bästa möjliga boendemiljö för våra hyresgäster.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som är en trygg, engagerad och handlingskraftig ledare. Du trivs ute i verksamheten, bygger starka relationer och motiverar andra att utvecklas och ta ansvar.

Du har ett genuint intresse för utemiljöer, trädgård, skötsel och utveckling av gröna miljöer. Du ser värdet i välplanerade och välskötta bostadsområden och förstår hur de bidrar till både trivsel, trygghet och hållbarhet.

Som person är du initiativrik och lösningsorienterad. Du arbetar strukturerat och långsiktigt och har förmågan att omsätta idéer till konkreta förbättringar i vardagen.

Vi ser gärna att du har

    Flera års erfarenhet av ledarskap med personalansvar.
    Erfarenhet av att leda operativ verksamhet inom utemiljö, park, grönyteskötsel, fastighetsservice eller liknande område.
    Erfarenhet av budget- och resultatansvar.
    Intresse för trädgård, anläggning, hållbarhetsfrågor och utveckling av boendemiljöer.
    Förmåga att planera, organisera och följa upp verksamhet på ett strukturerat sätt.
    Kunskap om eller intresse för biologisk mångfald, hållbar förvaltning och cirkulärt tänkande.
    B-körkort.

Därför ska du välja Finnvedsbostäder

Här får du möjlighet att påverka hur framtidens boendemiljöer ska utvecklas i Värnamo kommun. Du blir en viktig del av arbetet med att skapa attraktiva, hållbara och välskötta bostadsområden där människor trivs, känner trygghet och vill bo kvar länge.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

I denna rekrytering samarbetar Finnvedsbostäder (https://www.finnvedsbostader.se/)med Fasticon. Du söker tjänsten via annonsen. För att säkerställa att dina personuppgifter hanteras i enlighet med GDPR tar Fasticon inte emot ansökningar via e-post. Vi arbetar utifrån en kompetensbaserad rekryteringsprocess med fokus på att rekrytera rätt kompetens utifrån verksamhetens behov.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Jenny Tell på jenny.tell@Fasticon.se (mailto:jenny.tell@Fasticon.se)

Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Så länge annonsen är publicerad tar vi emot ansökningar. Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess använder vi oss av tester samt att en anställning hos Finnvedsbostäder föregås alltid av en bakgrundskontroll och drogtest.

Om Fasticon

Fasticon är marknadsledande specialister på kompetensförsörjning inom fastighetsrelaterade kompetenser. Vi kombinerar skarp expertis med en djup förståelse för ledarskapsutmaningar och hjälper organisationer att hitta rätt kompetens för långsiktig framgång.

Våra kunder finns över hela Sverige och vi utgår från Stockholm, Göteborg och Malmö.

Läs mer på www.fasticon.se (http://www.fasticon.se/) och sök lediga tjänster på www.fasticon.se/lediga-jobb (http://www.fasticon.se/lediga-jobb).

Automation and Electrical Systems Engineer
==========================================

**About us**

Windworks develops actively controlled vertical\-axis wind turbines for clean, local and affordable energy production. We pioneered an advanced technology control system for wind turbine blades, using sensors, control software and proprietary actuation technology to dramatically increase our machine performances .

Our turbines are designed for on\-site power generation in commercial, industrial and community applications, especially where conventional wind turbines are difficult to deploy.

Based in the Lausanne area, Windworks combines aerodynamic research, experimental testing, mechanical design, electronics, control and field validation to bring a new generation of wind turbines to market.



**Role description**

You will participate to the definition, integration and validation of the turbine’s electrical architecture, contributing directly to a technology that must perform reliably over time in harsh conditions. This role offers a high level of ownership and impact, with the opportunity to shape key parts of the system architecture and see your work move quickly from concept to testing and deployment.

You will collaborate closely with a small multidisciplinary team, iterate rapidly, and contribute to making a technically ambitious product reliable and scalable.



**Main responsibilities**

The applicant will have about 5 years of experience in electrical architecture, automation systems (PLC\-based, including industrial communication protocols), motor sizing and selection, generator sizing and integration, the dimensioning of components and integrated circuits (custom or off\-the\-shelf), along with a solid understanding of signal acquisition and processing.



**1\. Electrical Architecture**

* Design, prototype, and validate the overall electrical system comprising sensors, motors, generators, drivers, AC/AC and AC/DC converters, inverters, rectifiers
* Grounding / earth connection experience
* Surge / lightning protection


**2\. Automation \& Communication Systems:**

* Implement PLC\-based automation (e.g., Beckhoff, Siemens etc.) and EtherCAT architectures.
* Integrate sensors and actuators via CAN, Modbus, EtherCAT, etc.
* Develop telemetry, data acquisition, and remote monitoring.


**3\. Motor Dimensioning, Selection \& Control:**

* Dimension and select motors for blade actuation and auxiliary systems based on torque, speed, duty cycle, environmental constraints and lifetime.
* Define drive architecture and requirements of power stage.
* Implement and validate motor control strategies (position, speed, torque control).
* Ensure compatibility with mechanical loads, power electronics, and safety constraints.


**4\. Safety, Standards \& Documentation:**

* Implement electrical safety systems.
* Ensure compliance with International Electrotechnical Commission standards (e.g., IEC 61400\).
* Ensure compliance with CE requirements
* Produce structured technical documentation.


**5\. Grid Integration:**

* Manage grid connection, anti\-islanding, synchronization, relays, and protection.
* Size HV/MV cables and design electrical cabinets.


**6\. Generator Selection \& Control:**

* Dimension and select the generator technology based on power rating, speed range, efficiency, and grid requirements.
* Define electrical interface and integration with rectifier/inverter stages.
* Implement and validate generator\-side control strategies (MPPT, torque control, speed regulation, power optimization).




**Nice to have**

**1\. Experience with outdoor equipment**, industrial machinery or safety\-critical systems.

**2\. Experience with energy systems** (wind power, hydro power, …)

**3\. PCB Design** (schematic and layout to bring\-up and EMC considerations)

**4\. Firmware Development** (drivers, communication protocols)



**Your profile**

* About 5 years of experience in electrical engineering, power electronics or industrial automation.
* Comfortable working autonomously in a small engineering team.
* Team player
* Experience working on systems exposed to real\-world constraints (e.g. noise, EMC, environmental conditions, reliability, safety).
* Comfortable managing engineering partners and technical procurement activities, including identifying and selecting suppliers, defining technical specifications, reviewing datasheets and validation documents, coordinating technical exchanges, and supporting supplier qualification.
* Produce structured technical documentation
* Elaborate systematic testing and verification
* Clear and pro\-active communication within the team; provide structured reporting on progress and issues, expresses technical needs early.
* Well\-organized with strong planning skills, able to define clear steps, anticipate resource.




Details

* Starting date: Immediate
* Location: Renens, VD, Switzeland

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Schinznach: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Entzugsstation

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Schinznach

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Schinznach liegt im Kanton Aargau und besticht durch eine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung mit direktem Zugang zur Hauptverkehrsachse. Sie profitieren von der Nähe zu Zürich und Basel sowie der guten Zuganbindung. Die Region bietet Ihnen attraktive Arbeitsplätze in einem wirtschaftlich dynamischen Gebiet, kombiniert mit hoher Lebensqualität und den Vorzügen des ländlichen Raums.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Schinznach aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Entzugsstation

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Schinznach verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Schinznach im Kanton Aargau verzeichnet eine hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachfrauen und Pflegefachmännern auf Entzugsstationen, da spezialisierte Fachkräfte in diesem Bereich knapp sind. Sie profitieren als Kandidat von ausgezeichneten Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt und können gezielt eine Position im 80-100%-Pensum finden, die Ihren Anforderungen entspricht. iPersonal unterstützt Sie durch ihre Expertise und etablierten Kontakte zu Gesundheitsinstitutionen in der Region und erleichtert Ihnen den Einstieg durch umfassende Beratung und maßgeschneiderte Vermittlung.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Schinznach

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Schinznach

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Übrigens: Laufend weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie jederzeit auf med-ipersonal.ch.

Sachbearbeiter:in Lohn \& Personal 50\-60%, remote
==================================================

MILA ist der externe Finance \& Operations Partner für Schweizer KMU. Digital, effizient und immer auf Augenhöhe. Unsere Kundinnen und Kunden schaffen, wir haben den Rest. Beim Lohn soll dieser Rest bald bei dir liegen.

Du übernimmst eigene Lohnmandate für KMU, von der Lohnverarbeitung bis zur Personaladministration. Kein Konzern, keine Stempeluhr, kein Papierstapel.



Was du bei uns machst
---------------------

* Du verarbeitest die monatlichen Löhne deiner Mandanten, inklusive Quellensteuer.
* Du meldest Ein\- und Austritte, Mutterschaft, EO, Unfall und Krankheit an AHV, BVG, UVG, KTG und Familienausgleichskasse. Fristgerecht, ohne dass jemand nachfassen muss.
* Du erstellst Lohnausweise und erledigst die Jahresabschlüsse der Sozialversicherungen.
* Du führst die Personaladministration deiner Mandanten: Verträge nach Vorlage, Arbeitsbestätigungen, Ein\- und Austritte.
* Du bist die erste Ansprechperson deiner Mandanten für alles rund um Lohn. Auf Augenhöhe.
* Du baust unser Payroll\-Angebot mit auf und automatisierst, was sich automatisieren lässt.
* Du bist Teil unseres Finance \& Operations Teams und packst auch in der Buchhaltung und bei weiteren Treuhandaufgaben mit an.




Was du mitbringst
-----------------

* Du hast eine kaufmännische Grundbildung und eine Weiterbildung als Sachbearbeiter:in Lohnadministration oder Personalwesen. Ein Fachausweis ist ein Plus.
* Du hast bereits Erfahrung in der Lohnverarbeitung, idealerweise in einer Treuhand.
* Du bist in der Buchhaltung sattelfest.
* Sozialversicherungen und Quellensteuer bringen dich nicht aus der Ruhe.
* Du arbeitest gerne digital. bexio kennst du schon oder lernst es schnell.
* Du arbeitest selbstständig und verlässlich, auch wenn niemand neben dir sitzt.
* Du schreibst klar und hast Freude am Kontakt mit Kundinnen und Kunden.




Wie wir arbeiten
----------------

* **Remote:** Du arbeitest dort, wo du am besten arbeitest.
* **New Work:** Du teilst deine Zeit selbst ein. Was zählt, sind Ergebnisse und Fristen, nicht Präsenz.
* **50 bis 60%:** so, wie es zu deinem Leben passt.
* **Gestaltungsraum:** Du baust unser Payroll\-Angebot aktiv mit.
* **Kurze Wege:** ein kleines Team, schnelle Entscheide.
* **Digital statt Papier:** Bei uns gibt es kein Schwarzes Loch zwischen Lohnlauf und Lohnausweis.
* **5 Wochen Ferien:** Zeit zum Abschalten.
* **Workation:** Du kannst auch mal von unterwegs aus arbeiten.

uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze, warum du zu uns passt, direkt über den Bewerbungsbutton. Fragen zur Stelle beantwortet dir gerne direkt.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Bezugspflege 80-100% für die Region Hinwil gesucht
description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Hinwil sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Bezugspflege.

### Auf einen Blick: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für die Region Hinwil

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Bezugspflege

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Hinwil

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Hinwil liegt im Zürcher Oberland und überzeugt Sie als Arbeitsort durch seine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung mit direkter S-Bahn-Verbindung nach Zürich. Die Region bietet Ihnen ein attraktives Umfeld mit guter Infrastruktur, zahlreichen Arbeitsplätzen und einer hohen Lebensqualität. Die Nähe zur Natur sowie die Kombination aus urbanem Angebot und ländlichem Charakter machen Hinwil zu einem beliebten Arbeitsstandort für Pendler und ansässige Unternehmen.

### Diese Tätigkeiten erwarten Sie in Hinwil

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihre Stärken für diese Stelle

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Bezugspflege

Sie arbeiten in einem betreuten Wohnumfeld: Alltag gestalten, begleiten, fördern. Hier zählt die Beziehung ebenso wie die Pflege, denn Lebensqualität entsteht aus beidem. Ein Umfeld für Menschen, die gerne ganzheitlich arbeiten.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Bezugspflege in Hinwil verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Hinwil im Kanton Zürich verzeichnet eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage nach qualifizierten Pflegefachfrauen und Pflegefachmännern mit Diplom HF/FH, insbesondere für Positionen in der Bezugspflege mit 80-100% Pensum. Aufgrund des Fachkräftemangels bieten sich Ihnen hervorragende Chancen, schnell eine attraktive Stelle zu finden und dabei von einem stabilen Arbeitsmarkt zu profitieren. Als spezialisierter Personalvermittler kennt iPersonal die lokalen Anforderungen und Arbeitgeber in der Region und unterstützt Sie durch gezielte Vermittlung sowie individuelle Beratung beim nahtlosen Berufseinstieg. So reduzieren Sie Ihre Suchzeit erheblich und finden rasch eine Position, die Ihren Vorstellungen entspricht.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Hinwil

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Bezugspflege in Hinwil

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Gut zu wissen: Viele weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie rund um die Uhr auf med-ipersonal.ch.

description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Berikon sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Leitung Tageszentrum.

### Auf einen Blick: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für die Region Berikon

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Leitung Tageszentrum

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Berikon

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Berikon liegt im Kanton Aargau und bietet Ihnen eine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung mit direktem Zugang zur Autobahn sowie zu Bahn- und Buslinien. Die Region punktet mit ihrer Nähe zu Zürich und Baden, wodurch Sie flexibel zwischen Stadt und Agglomeration pendeln können. Die attraktive Umgebung mit grünen Flächen und guter Infrastruktur macht Berikon zu einem geschätzten Arbeitsort für Unternehmen und Fachkräfte.

### Diese Tätigkeiten erwarten Sie in Berikon

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihre Stärken für diese Stelle

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Leitung Tageszentrum

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Leitung Tageszentrum in Berikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Berikon im Kanton Aargau verzeichnet eine hohe Nachfrage nach erfahrenen Pflegefachpersonen mit Leitungskompetenzen in Tageszentren, da der demografische Wandel den Personalbedarf kontinuierlich steigert. Sie haben als Dipl. title: Chef de projet technique
description:

![Alpenda]( )

**Qui sommes\-nous ?**

Alpenda est une Entreprise Totale et Générale dont le siège social est à Tolochenaz (VD). L’entreprise compte plus 200 collaborateurs et cumule 80 ans d’expérience en Suisse romande et dans le canton de Berne. Spécialisée dans la conception et la réalisation de logements et d’ouvrages fonctionnels (bureaux, manufactures, centres commerciaux, hôtels, hôpitaux..) Alpenda possède également une expertise reconnue dans la rénovation, l’assainissement et la transformation de bâtiments existants, ainsi que dans la réalisation de projets de prestige. Soucieuse de l’éthique, de l’environnement et de la qualité de vie, Alpenda s’engage à concevoir et construire des ouvrages performants, durables et respectueux des femmes et des hommes qui y vivent. Alpenda est la filiale suisse du Groupe DEMATHIEU BARD.

Chef de projet technique H/F

**Vos responsabilités et missions :**

* Vous pilotez une équipe complète de spécialistes pour établir l’offre la plus pertinente et attractive.
* Vous animez les échanges avec les partenaires externes (mandataires, fournisseurs, prestataires).
* Vous êtes le relais entre la direction technique et l’équipe commerciale.
* Vous participez pleinement à la recherche d’optimisations techniques et économiques.
* Vous êtes le garant de la conformité de l’étude, en contrôlant le respect des normes et des exigences du cahier des charges, en collaboration avec l’équipe de spécialistes.
* Vous présentez le travail de votre équipe à la direction de l’entreprise, détaillant les hypothèses, les idées et les éléments de contrôle des estimations.
* Avec votre équipe Direction Technique et en lien avec l’équipe commerciale, vous rédigez toute la partie technique et financière de l’offre finale remise.
* Vous participez pleinement aux oraux de présentation de votre offre en assurant la présentation des aspects techniques et en répondant aux questions sur ces sujets.
* Vous assurez le suivi jusqu’à une potentielle adjudication, participez à l’élaboration du contrat et transférer le dossier à l’équipe Travaux




**Votre environnement de travail :**

La direction technique et achats d’Alpenda est un véritable pilier de notre entreprise. Composée d’une trentaine d'experts, d'ingénieurs et de chefs de projets hautement qualifiés, elle est garante de notre savoir\-faire et incarne notre engagement envers l'innovation et la durabilité.

En tant que Chef\-fe de projet technique, vous aurez pour mission de garantir l’excellence technique, la cohérence globale et la maîtrise des choix constructifs sur l’ensemble des projets menés en entreprise totale. Référent technique interne, vous soutenez les équipes Études, anticipez les risques, validez les solutions techniques et assurez le respect des standards élevés d’Alpenda.




**Pourquoi pas vous ?**

* Vous êtes diplômé d'un Bachelor en économie de la construction, d’un diplôme d’ingénieur EPF/ETH/HES ou d'un titre jugé équivalent et possédez une première expérience réussie en tant qu’ingénieur étude ?
* Vous êtes un généraliste de la construction et êtes capable d'aborder n'importe quelle problématique technique du bâtiment ?
* Vous êtes organisé, rapide et flexible, à l’écoute des innovations techniques ?
* Vous avez une bonne gestion du stress, et une culture du résultat ?
* L’esprit d’équipe est une de vos principales qualités et vous êtes un coach naturel ?
* Vous parlez couramment français, des connaissances de l’anglais et/ou de l’allemand un atout ?
* Vos connaissances des modes constructifs ainsi que des prix de construction en Suisse sont un atout prépondérant ?




Vous avez envie de relever de nouveaux défis ? Nos équipes n’attendent plus que vous !

Conseils aux candidats
----------------------

Pour maximiser vos chances de succès :

* Soyez curieux,
* N’hésitez pas à consulter les profils LinkedIn de vos futurs interlocuteurs.
* Illustrez votre candidature en mettant en avant vos réalisations par des exemples concrets.
* Exprimez votre personnalité, votre adaptabilité, votre esprit innovant et vos idées audacieuses.
* Partagez votre passion pour le bâtiment !
* DEMATHIEU BARD recherche des personnes qui osent sortir de leur zone de confort. A vous de construire votre avenir !




Process de recrutement
----------------------
> À réception de votre candidature, notre service recrutement l’étudiera dans les meilleurs délais. Déroulement :

* Un premier échange avec le Chargé de recrutement ou Responsable Ressources Humaines en charge du périmètre concerné par cette annonce.
* Rencontres avec un ou plusieurs opérationnels dont votre futur responsable hiérarchique, nous permettant de nous projeter ensemble et de confirmer une potentielle collaboration.
* Intention d’engagement.







**Ce que nous vous proposons :**

* Un environnement de travail diversifié et stimulant où chaque collaborateur peut s’épanouir professionnellement.
* Des conditions attractives comprenant un système de rémunération compétitif ainsi que des avantages sociaux intéressants.
* Un investissement dans le développement professionnel de nos collaborateurs par des formations de base et continues.
* Des espaces de travail modernes, dynamiques et inspirants, que ce soit dans nos bureaux ou sur nos chantiers.
* Des moments conviviaux, journées d’entreprise pour renforcer le partage et la cohésion entre les équipes.
* Une expérience à l’international \#Suisse


N'hésitez plus, rejoignez\-nous !
