description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Gipf-Oberfrick sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Suchtbehandlung.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Gipf-Oberfrick – die Eckdaten Ihrer Stelle

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Suchtbehandlung

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Gipf-Oberfrick

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Gipf-Oberfrick liegt im Frickthal im Aargau und besticht durch seine idyllische Lage in der Nähe der Jura-Landschaft. Die Region ist über die Bahnlinie Basel-Olten sowie regionale Busverbindungen gut erreichbar und ermöglicht Sie eine schnelle Anbindung an umliegende Wirtschaftszentren. Als Arbeitsort bietet die Region attraktive Voraussetzungen mit kleineren Betrieben, ruhigem Umfeld und guter Work-Life-Balance dank der Nähe zu Natur und Erholung.

### Das packen Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Suchtbehandlung in Gipf-Oberfrick an

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Rüstzeug für den erfolgreichen Einstieg

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Suchtbehandlung

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Suchtbehandlung in Gipf-Oberfrick verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

In der Region Gipf-Oberfrick besteht eine konstant hohe Nachfrage nach qualifizierten Pflegefachkräften mit Suchtbehandlungsspezialisierung, da Fachkräfte in diesem Bereich knapp sind. Sie haben ausgezeichnete Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt, insbesondere bei einer flexiblen Stundengestaltung zwischen 80-100%. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler durch umfassende Branchenkenntnisse, passgenaue Stellenangebote und eine reibungslose Vermittlung in etablierte Facheinrichtungen der Region.

Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

title: Principal Data Architect
description:
Founded in Switzerland in 1968, Zühlke is owned by its partners and located across Europe and Asia. We are a global transformation partner, with engineering and innovation in our DNA. We're trusted to help clients envision and build their businesses for the future – to run smarter today while adapting for tomorrow’s markets, customers, and communities. Our multidisciplinary teams specialise in tech strategy and business innovation, digital solutions and applications, and device and systems engineering. We excel in complex, regulated spaces including health and finance, connecting strategy, tech implementation, and operational services to help clients become more effective, resilient businesses.

If you share our values and want to do the best work, for the right reasons, we can offer you the chance to do it on a global scale and play a real role in shaping our exciting journey.

**Role**

As a Principal Data Architect, you will provide strategic guidance and long\-term vision across data and AI, working closely with our clients to solve complex data challenges, from platform modernisation and governance to real\-time architectures and AI operationalization. You will design and deliver data architectures and strategies that are fit for purpose, balancing technical rigour with business value, while bringing the curiosity and conviction to challenge conventional thinking and push the boundaries of what data and AI can do for our clients.

**How you’ll make impact**

* **Trusted Advisor:** You guide our clients towards successful solutions to their data challenges. You'll lead design sessions, architecture reviews, proof\-of\-concept projects and evaluation of new data technologies and vendors.

* **Architecture \& Implementation:** You design sophisticated architectures for data and AI projects, implementing them together with your team while inspiring your stakeholders.

* **AI Operationalization:** You take data and AI projects from prototype to production readiness, with a strong focus on traceability, transparency, and reproducibility as foundations for governed and compliant AI.
* **Thought Leadership \& Consulting:** You promote understanding of AI and data technologies, share your knowledge both internally and externally, and invest in growing the talent around you.


**What’s important to us**

* You bring deep expertise in AI and data solutions, along with a nuanced understanding of their possibilities and limitations.

You make confident decisions and can clearly explain your reasoning, balancing technical rigour with pragmatism to keep delivery on track.
* Excellent communication skills on management level as well as with technical experts in both German and English are essential.
* You hold a technical degree in Computer Science, or a comparable field.

description: Swiss Federal Institute for Forest, Snow and Landscape Research WSL The Swiss Federal Institute for Forest, Snow and Landscape Research WSL is part of the ETH Domain. Approximately 600 people work on the sustainable use and protection of the environment and on the handling of natural hazards. The Research Unit Forest and Soil Ecology assesses the impact of climate change and management on forests and their soils. The group Critical Zone dynamics is offering a \*\*two\\-year position\*\* as Technician in Biogeosciences 50% (f/m/d) You will work within the recently funded SNSF project FIRE ("Fire Impacts on the Response of terrestrial Ecosystems"). This project investigates how wildfires affect carbon cycling and transit times at the landscape scale, particularly in the deeper unsaturated zone and in groundwater, and over longer periods of time. You will be part of an interdisciplinary team of collaborators based in Switzerland and the USA, and support the team in conducting geochemical analysis (particularly radiocarbon) on environmental samples from recently burned landscapes in the USA. Your main tasks will involve preparation of a range of sample types (gaseous, aqueous, and solid) for stable carbon isotope and radiocarbon analysis. This will be done in collaboration with our partners at the Laboratory for Ion Beam Physics at ETH Zurich, where you will also frequently work. Processing of samples for other types of analysis, , major ion concentrations, general chemistry, will also be part of your duties. You will support and train a PhD candidate and guests from our partner universities in the USA in laboratory procedures. Moreover, you will also assist the team with administrative and logistical duties, , the shipping of samples and materials to and from field sites in the USA. You preferably hold a Master's degree in environmental or earth sciences or related disciplines, and have demonstrated experience with mass spectrometric methods for geochemical analysis and/or radiocarbon methods. You are familiar with laboratory work, enjoy contributing to methodological advancements, and are interested in interdisciplinary and international research. - Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. description:
Ref 2585257 \| Date: 14 Oct 2026

![API  ]( )

Pourquoi choisir API ?







API, avec plus de 30 ans d'expérience, est une entreprise familiale, reconnue pour sa réelle expertise IT ; transformation digitale, service de support, Cloud...



Nous avons su nous nous entourer des meilleurs experts afin de répondre au mieux aux besoins spécifiques de nos clients.







En optant pour API, vous choisissez une entreprise à taille humaine bénéficiant d'un solide savoir\-faire en IT.



Nous sommes fiers de notre culture d’entreprise unique car nous offrons des opportunités de développement professionnel, avec des programmes de formation continue, d'évolution de carrière ainsi qu’un suivi rigoureux.







Nous mettons l’humain au cœur de nos activités : après tout, nos ordinateurs peuvent résoudre des problèmes, mais ils ne savent toujours pas faire un bon café !





**Technicien Support IT N1**

Aujourd'hui nous recherchons un Technicien Support N1 pour rejoindre l'équipe ServiceDesk de notre client à Lausanne.







Il s'agit d'un poste avec durée de plus de 4 ans, avec un démarrage au 1er mars 2027\.







Votre rôle:



* Accueillir, réceptionner et qualifier les sollicitations des utilisateurs via les différents canaux : téléphone, portail self\-service, e\-mail et guichet d'accueil physique.
* Créer, catégoriser, documenter et prioriser l'ensemble des tickets d'incidents et de demandes de service dans l'outil de gestion (Jira Service Management).
* Réaliser le diagnostic de premier niveau et assurer la résolution autonome des incidents et demandes relevant de votre périmètre d'intervention (objectif de First Level Resolution élevé).
* Prendre en charge les demandes de service courantes : réinitialisation de mots de passe, déblocage de comptes, attributions de droits d'accès et assistance bureautique.
* Gérer le matériel informatique du parc : préparation et attribution des PC de pool, remise d'équipements en stock, assistance sur la téléphonie et gestion des cartes SIM.
* Assurer le support de base sur les terminaux mobiles et tablettes métier (environnement Android).
* Traiter les incidents de sécurité de premier niveau : qualification des alertes antivirus et traitement des signalements de phishing (Hoxhunt).
* Escalader et transférer les tickets non résolus vers les équipes d'expertise de niveau 2/3 en fournissant l'ensemble des éléments d'analyse nécessaires.
* Rédiger et maintenir à jour la documentation opérationnelle (fiches de procédures internes et guides d'utilisation à destination des collaborateurs).
* Respecter rigoureusement les engagements de niveaux de service (SLA) et contribuer à la satisfaction globale des utilisateurs finaux.






Le profil recherché:



* Formation initiale en informatique (CFC informatique, titre équivalent ou expérience avérée en centre de services / support utilisateurs).
* Expérience probante sur un poste similaire de technicien support de niveau 1 ou Service Desk en environnement d'entreprise.
* Solides compétences techniques sur les environnements Windows (postes de travail, Active Directory) et la suite bureautique Microsoft 365 / Teams.
* Bonnes notions d'assistance sur les terminaux mobiles Android et smartphones d'entreprise.
* Connaissance pratique de base de SAP GUI (navigation et transactions standards).
* Maîtrise opérationnelle d'un outil de gestion de tickets (idéalement Jira Service Management) et sensibilisation aux bonnes pratiques ITIL.
* Excellent sens du service, écoute active, diplomatie et aisance relationnelle pour la tenue du guichet d'accueil physique.
* Rigueur méthodologique, esprit de synthèse, réactivité et capacité d'adaptation au sein d'une équipe sur site.






Les étapes du processus de recrutement chez API :



* Engageons la conversation ! Pour commencer, nous souhaitons découvrir qui vous êtes : votre parcours, vos intérêts et vos aspirations. Cette première prise de contact nous permettra de mieux vous connaître.
* Ensuite, approfondissons ! Vous aurez l’occasion de rencontrer nos Business Managers qui vous parleront de la vie de consultant chez API. Ce sera le moment idéal pour découvrir les projets qui retiennent votre attention en fonction de vos ambitions !
* Concrétisons ! Une fois l’adéquation entre vos ambitions, vos compétences et le projet établie, l’aventure ensemble peut commencer !

### Kurz zusammengefasst: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Brugg

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** KJP Akutstation

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Brugg liegt im Nordwesten des Kantons Aargau an der Aare und bietet Sie als Arbeitnehmender eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung über die Bahnlinie Basel-Zürich sowie die Autobahn A3. Die historische Altstadt mit ihren charaktervollen Gassen schafft eine angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre, während die Nähe zu Zürich und Basel Sie beruflich mobil hält. Die Region besticht durch ihre Infrastruktur, das kulturelle Angebot und die landschaftliche Attraktivität am Jura-Rand.

### Ihr Aufgabengebiet als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH KJP Akutstation in Brugg

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das setzen wir für diese Stelle voraus

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: KJP Akutstation

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH KJP Akutstation in Brugg verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. **Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

Ja, selbstverständlich – denn im persönlichen Gespräch nennen wir Ihnen die Institution gerne. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Automation and Electrical Systems Engineer
==========================================

**About us**

Windworks develops actively controlled vertical\-axis wind turbines for clean, local and affordable energy production. We pioneered an advanced technology control system for wind turbine blades, using sensors, control software and proprietary actuation technology to dramatically increase our machine performances .

Our turbines are designed for on\-site power generation in commercial, industrial and community applications, especially where conventional wind turbines are difficult to deploy.

Based in the Lausanne area, Windworks combines aerodynamic research, experimental testing, mechanical design, electronics, control and field validation to bring a new generation of wind turbines to market.



**Role description**

You will participate to the definition, integration and validation of the turbine’s electrical architecture, contributing directly to a technology that must perform reliably over time in harsh conditions. This role offers a high level of ownership and impact, with the opportunity to shape key parts of the system architecture and see your work move quickly from concept to testing and deployment.

You will collaborate closely with a small multidisciplinary team, iterate rapidly, and contribute to making a technically ambitious product reliable and scalable.



**Main responsibilities**

The applicant will have about 5 years of experience in electrical architecture, automation systems (PLC\-based, including industrial communication protocols), motor sizing and selection, generator sizing and integration, the dimensioning of components and integrated circuits (custom or off\-the\-shelf), along with a solid understanding of signal acquisition and processing.



**1\. Electrical Architecture**

* Design, prototype, and validate the overall electrical system comprising sensors, motors, generators, drivers, AC/AC and AC/DC converters, inverters, rectifiers
* Grounding / earth connection experience
* Surge / lightning protection


**2\. Automation \& Communication Systems:**

* Implement PLC\-based automation (e.g., Beckhoff, Siemens etc.) and EtherCAT architectures.
* Integrate sensors and actuators via CAN, Modbus, EtherCAT, etc.
* Develop telemetry, data acquisition, and remote monitoring.


**3\. Motor Dimensioning, Selection \& Control:**

* Dimension and select motors for blade actuation and auxiliary systems based on torque, speed, duty cycle, environmental constraints and lifetime.
* Define drive architecture and requirements of power stage.
* Implement and validate motor control strategies (position, speed, torque control).
* Ensure compatibility with mechanical loads, power electronics, and safety constraints.


**4\. Safety, Standards \& Documentation:**

* Implement electrical safety systems.
* Ensure compliance with International Electrotechnical Commission standards (e.g., IEC 61400\).
* Ensure compliance with CE requirements
* Produce structured technical documentation.


**5\. Grid Integration:**

* Manage grid connection, anti\-islanding, synchronization, relays, and protection.
* Size HV/MV cables and design electrical cabinets.


**6\. Generator Selection \& Control:**

* Dimension and select the generator technology based on power rating, speed range, efficiency, and grid requirements.
* Define electrical interface and integration with rectifier/inverter stages.
* Implement and validate generator\-side control strategies (MPPT, torque control, speed regulation, power optimization).




**Nice to have**

**1\. Experience with outdoor equipment**, industrial machinery or safety\-critical systems.

**2\. Experience with energy systems** (wind power, hydro power, …)

**3\. PCB Design** (schematic and layout to bring\-up and EMC considerations)

**4\. Firmware Development** (drivers, communication protocols)



**Your profile**

* About 5 years of experience in electrical engineering, power electronics or industrial automation.
* Comfortable working autonomously in a small engineering team.
* Team player
* Experience working on systems exposed to real\-world constraints (e.g. noise, EMC, environmental conditions, reliability, safety).
* Comfortable managing engineering partners and technical procurement activities, including identifying and selecting suppliers, defining technical specifications, reviewing datasheets and validation documents, coordinating technical exchanges, and supporting supplier qualification.
* Produce structured technical documentation
* Elaborate systematic testing and verification
* Clear and pro\-active communication within the team; provide structured reporting on progress and issues, expresses technical needs early.
* Well\-organized with strong planning skills, able to define clear steps, anticipate resource.




Details

* Starting date: Immediate
* Location: Renens, VD, Switzeland

E2E CSV/C\&Q Lead
=================

Location: Basel, Switzerland (project scope includes Portsmouth, UK) Start Date: 1 November 2026 Contract Duration: Until 31 October 2027 Lead end\-to\-end computerised system validation and qualification for an innovative manufacturing data pl

E2E CSV/C\&Q Lead
=================

### description:

We are seeking an experienced E2E CSV/C\&Q Lead to take ownership of the end\-to\-end validation and qualification strategy for a strategic Operations Data Hub (ODH) programme.

The position covers integrated manufacturing systems, IT/OT interfaces, infrastructure, semantic data models, data products and operational applications. You will collaborate with Engineering, Automation, Quality, IT/OT and business stakeholders to ensure that solutions meet regulatory, quality and data integrity requirements.

Your key responsibilities will include:

* Define, implement and maintain an integrated, risk\-based Computerised System Validation (CSV) and Commissioning \& Qualification (C\&Q) strategy.
* Establish validation boundaries, intended use, GxP classifications and appropriate controls across the manufacturing data platform.
* Develop modular qualification frameworks, documentation standards and reusable validation approaches for future implementations.
* Coordinate end\-to\-end validation execution, including requirements traceability, testing, documentation and release readiness.
* Define validation approaches for operational applications supporting batch traceability, process monitoring and customer data sharing.
* Evaluate data integrity, data lineage, interoperability and auditability across integrated manufacturing systems.
* Ensure alignment with ALCOA\+ principles and relevant GMP requirements.
* Prepare and coordinate validation documentation for independent Quality review and approval.
* Define supplier assurance strategies, including the use of vendor testing and previously qualified components.
* Ensure that validated\-state maintenance requirements are incorporated into operational support processes.
* Develop qualification templates, implementation prerequisites and resource, cost and timeline estimates for future site rollouts.
* Facilitate cross\-functional risk assessments, manage validation dependencies and escalate programme\-level compliance risks.
* Support release readiness assessments and coordinate with business and Quality stakeholders throughout implementation.


### About the customer:

Our client is an internationally established organisation within the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sector, specialising in complex, highly regulated manufacturing operations. As part of its digital transformation initiatives, the organisation is implementing advanced manufacturing data solutions to improve connectivity, traceability and operational efficiency across production environments.

### Requirements:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Automation, Computer Science, IT, Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Quality Management or a related discipline.
* Proven experience leading end\-to\-end CSV/C\&Q activities for integrated IT/OT systems, manufacturing data platforms or regulated operational applications.
* Strong understanding of GMP, CSV/CSA, Commissioning \& Qualification and risk\-based validation methodologies.
* Practical experience managing change control, deviations, CAPA and maintenance of the validated state.
* Solid expertise in validation documentation, requirements traceability, testing strategies and supplier assurance.
* Strong understanding of data integrity principles, including ALCOA\+.
* Knowledge of manufacturing automation environments, MES, historians, system interfaces, infrastructure and data transformations.
* Experience collaborating with Quality, Engineering, Automation, IT/OT and external suppliers.
* Ability to develop pragmatic, risk\-based validation strategies while maintaining regulatory compliance.
* Strong coordination, communication, stakeholder management and problem\-solving skills.
* Business\-fluent English.
Nice to Have

* Previous validation leadership experience within pharmaceutical or biotechnology manufacturing.
* Experience with enterprise\-wide manufacturing data integration or digitalisation initiatives.
* Familiarity with ISA\-95 architecture and complex manufacturing data flows.
* Experience developing reusable qualification frameworks for multi\-site deployments.
* Exposure to validation of data platforms, semantic data models and manufacturing analytics applications.

--------------------

* Concept and ideate: Develop creative ideas and visual approaches that translate brand strategies and communication objectives into engaging digital content.

* Design across digital touchpoints: Create digital banners, sponsored brand displays, social and e\-commerce assets, rich content, and other digital campaign materials.

* Deliver with executional excellence: Manage multiple projects and deadlines, maintain organized working files, and ensure assets meet creative, technical, and platform requirements.
* Improve creative workflows: Use templates, reusable assets, and efficient production techniques to increase speed without compromising craft.
* Stay creatively current: Explore emerging motion styles, digital formats, tools, and platform behaviors to continuously improve the relevance and impact of the work.

Profil recherché
-----------------

* A degree in graphic design, motion design, animation, visual communication, or a related field.
* 3\-5 years of relevant experience in digital design and motion graphics, ideally within an agency, in\-house brand team, or creative production studio.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating concept development, exceptional visual craft, motion design, video editing, and execution across multiple digital formats.
* Experience translating brand guidelines and campaign assets into digital\-first creative.
* Hands\-on experience producing short\-form video, adapting TVCs, and delivering assets for paid media, social, and e\-commerce environments.

**Creative and technical skills**

* Strong foundations in typography, composition, color, layout, and visual hierarchy, with exceptional attention to detail.
* A strong understanding of motion principles, including timing, pacing, easing, transitions, and visual storytelling.
* Ability to take a project from brief and concept through storyboards, style frames, animation, editing, and final delivery.
* Strong video\-editing skills, including cutdowns, sound synchronization, basic audio cleanup, and color correction.
* Understanding of platform\-specific requirements, including aspect ratios, safe zones, file sizes, codecs, compression, and export settings.
* Ability to design for mobile\-first viewing, sound\-off consumption, legibility, and accessibility.

**Tools**

* Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects for motion graphics, animation, and compositing.
* Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro for video editing and campaign cutdowns.
* Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop for asset creation, image editing, and digital design.
* Familiarity with Adobe Media Encoder and efficient rendering, versioning, and delivery workflows.
* Strong proficiency in diverse AI tools.
* Preferred but not mandatory familiarity with HTML5 banner production or rich\-media tools such as Google Web Designer.
* Preferred but not mandatory basic 3D design and animation skills using Cinema 4D or Blender.

**Ways of working**

* Creative curiosity paired with a hands\-on, solution\-oriented approach.
* Ability to explain creative choices clearly and respond constructively to feedback.
* Strong collaboration skills and confidence working with both design and non\-design stakeholders.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills, with the agility to handle shifting priorities.
* Ownership of quality from initial concept through final export, balancing speed with meticulous execution.

description:

**Lead Chemical Process R\&D Scientist**

**Background:**

In this function you will lead chemical process R\&D activities to deliver safe, scalable, efficient and sustainable processes as well as drug substance material for projects in clinical development, with a focus on late stage development, leveraging internal and external CDMO capabilities.

**Tasks \& Responsibilities:**

OT Integration Delivery Lead
============================

### description:

We are looking for an experienced OT Integration Delivery Lead to oversee the delivery of operational technology integrations and plant\-side applications as part of a strategic Operations Data Hub (ODH) programme.

In this role, you will lead a dedicated technical workstream, collaborating with automation teams, IT stakeholders, engineering partners and external vendors to deliver secure, scalable and maintainable manufacturing integrations.

Your key responsibilities will include:

* Lead the design, configuration, development, testing and deployment of OT integrations across DeltaV, Syncade MES, PI Historian and laboratory systems.
* Configure and develop integration services using Ignition, HiveMQ, MQTT, industrial gateways and connectors.
* Define interface specifications, message structures, data mappings and transformations for manufacturing information, including batch, equipment, material and quality data.
* Coordinate the delivery of plant\-side operational applications and visualisation solutions.
* Collaborate with architecture, semantic modelling and source\-system teams to ensure consistent and traceable manufacturing data integration.
* Assess existing OT connectivity, integration capabilities and technical constraints across manufacturing systems.
* Develop reusable integration blueprints, engineering standards and implementation patterns for future deployments.
* Apply secure development, version control, testing, release management and monitoring practices appropriate for regulated OT environments.
* Prepare technical specifications and test evidence, supporting CSV/C\&Q activities, hypercare and operational handover.
* Manage technical delivery against agreed project scope, timelines, resources, quality standards and budgets.
* Coordinate external technology providers, system integrators and equipment vendors, ensuring delivery quality and technical compliance.


### About the customer:

Location: Basel, Switzerland (project scope includes Portsmouth, UK) Contract Duration: Until 31 October 2027

One\-Liner

Lead OT integration delivery for a large\-scale manufacturing data platform, connecting automation systems with secure, scalable data solutions.

### Requirements:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Control Systems, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* Proven experience delivering production\-grade OT integrations in industrial or manufacturing environments.
* Hands\-on experience with Ignition, MQTT, HiveMQ, industrial gateways and message brokers.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing automation systems, including DCS, MES, historians and industrial data platforms.
* Knowledge of ISA\-88, ISA\-95, OT/IT architecture and manufacturing data contextualisation.
* Experience designing APIs, industrial connectors, data interfaces, message models and reusable integration architectures.
* Familiarity with secure deployments, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, version control and change management.
* Understanding of GMP, CSV/CSA and data integrity requirements in regulated environments.
* Proven ability to coordinate technical teams, vendors and external integration partners.
* Strong troubleshooting, stakeholder management and technical delivery skills.

Nice to have:

* Previous experience delivering OT integration programmes within pharmaceutical or biotechnology manufacturing.

Mission de 2 mois \- Analyste KYC / AML – Revues périodiques High Risk \& Medium Risk
========================================================================================

**Objectif de la mission**

Renforcer l’équipe chargée des revues périodiques des clients classés à risque élevé et moyen. Assurer la mise à jour des dossiers, documenter les analyses et préparer les recommandations pour validation, conformément aux procédures internes et au cadre réglementaire suisse applicable.

**Responsabilités principales**

* Réaliser les revues KYC du portefeuille attribué et suivre les échéances prévues en novembre et décembre.
* Vérifier l’identité des clients, les ayants droit économiques, les structures de détention et la validité des pièces justificatives.
* Actualiser le profil client : activité professionnelle, situation patrimoniale, origine de la fortune (*Source of Wealth*) et origine des fonds (*Source of Funds*).
* Examiner la cohérence des transactions avec le profil et l’activité attendue du client.
* Effectuer ou actualiser les contrôles relatifs aux personnes politiquement exposées (PEP), aux sanctions et aux informations défavorables, puis analyser les résultats pertinents.
* Réévaluer la classification du risque et documenter toute proposition de modification.
* Obtenir les informations manquantes auprès des gestionnaires de relation et assurer le suivi des demandes.
* Rédiger une conclusion motivée et soumettre les dossiers aux instances de validation compétentes.
* Escalader les anomalies et les situations sensibles à Compliance selon les procédures internes.


**Approche selon le niveau de risque**

* **High Risk :** conduire une analyse approfondie des facteurs de risque, de l’origine de la fortune et des fonds, des structures complexes et des opérations inhabituelles ; documenter les clarifications complémentaires et préparer les validations requises.
* **Medium Risk :** réaliser une revue proportionnée aux risques identifiés, actualiser les informations et justificatifs, et signaler tout élément justifiant un examen renforcé ou une reclassification.


**Profil recherché**

* Expérience confirmée en KYC, AML ou revues périodiques, idéalement en banque privée suisse.
* Bonne connaissance du cadre suisse de lutte contre le blanchiment d’argent et des obligations de diligence bancaire.
* Capacité à analyser des patrimoines internationaux et des structures de détention complexes.
* Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles, rigueur et jugement analytique.
* Autonomie, respect de la confidentialité et aptitude à travailler dans des délais courts.
* çais et anglais professionnels

Embedded Software Engineer
==========================

**Role Overview**
-----------------

As Embedded Software Engineer you write the software that runs the bike: The firmware of its control units and the embedded Linux platform behind its connected features.

You have the opportunity to take a product through its entire life, from the very first power\-on on the lab
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

bench, through test rides on the bike, to the production line and beyond.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------



**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Embedded Software for the Bike**
----------------------------------

* Turn system requirements into embedded software designs and help build a robust architecture across the bike’s control units
* Implement system\-level functions in C/C\+\+
* Build the foundations of a connected, always\-online bike: Low\-power modes and wake\-up, secure over\-the\-air updates, Bluetooth links to phone and more


**Bring\-up, Integration \& Debugging**
---------------------------------------

* Bring up new boards and component from first power\-on in the lab to the complete bike
* Integrate supplier systems such as drive unit, battery and others over CAN and validate their interfaces
* Track down faults across software, electronics and wiring




**Quality \& Testing**
----------------------

* Keep the codebase maintainable through reviews, refactoring, unit tests and documentation
* Automate firmware integration tests on test benches and hardware\-in\-the\-loop setups
* Support validation, EMC and homologation testing


**Path to Production**
----------------------

* Develop test scripts, end\-of\-line tests and flashing for series production
* Support our manufacturing partner during production ramp\-up


**Working Across Teams**
------------------------

* Work hand in hand with hardware, system engineering, app and backend teams
* Collaborate with development partners and suppliers


**Profile \& Experience**

**Qualification**
-----------------

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering or similar
* At least five years of hands\-on embedded development in C/C\+\+, ideally in automotive, e\-mobility or other series\-produced products


**Experience**
--------------

* Experience building distributed systems with multiple microcontrollers and low power designs
* Solid knowledge of embedded Linux and of real\-time operating systems such as Zephyr
* Comfortable at the lab bench, whether reading schematics, debugging with an oscilloscope and logic analyzer, or picking up the soldering iron
* A plus: CAN, Bluetooth, Wi\-Fi, cellular and GNSS, secure boot, bootloader


**Mindset**

* Takes initiative and drives topics to a solution
* Enjoys working in interdisciplinary teams
* Thrives in fast\-moving, early\-stage product development
* Enjoys finding root causes in complex interdisciplinary systems




**What Makes This Role Unique**

Central role connecting quality, testing, and engineering across the entire product.

Opportunity to shape quality, validation, and problem\-solving processes from the ground up.

Broad exposure across mechanical, electrical, software, connectivity and system integration – rather than ownership of a single component.

High impact on product reliability, compliance, and launch readiness.

A hands\-on role where you will work directly with prototypes and real product issues, not just manage processes from a distance.

**What We Offer**

* The opportunity to shape a pioneering premium e\-bike brand from the ground up.
* Collaboration with world\-class innovators, engineers, designers, and partners.
* Competitive compensation package, including performance\-based incentives, value sharing
* A culture built on passion, performance, and innovation
* Opportunity to build something truly new in mobility
* Join a highly ambitious international team
* Modern working location in Bern

title: Member of Technical Staff - Data Research Engineer
description:
Overview
We are seeking a Data Research Engineer to join our AI team, where we are building the next generation of foundation models across different modalities: text, image, video, audio. If you are passionate about exploring, designing, and building high-quality datasets to drive frontier AI models, this role is for you.

At Microsoft AI, data is at the heart of innovation—and in this role, you will collaborate closely with other colleagues to curate, analyse, and evaluate diverse data sources critical to model development. You’ll lead efforts in developing novel data collection strategies, improving dataset quality, understanding data-driven model behaviours, and aligning datasets with ethical and societal values.

This is a cross-disciplinary, high-impact role ideal for engineers who want to push the boundaries of what AI can learn from data.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
Create high-quality datasets for training and evaluation; run experiments on new datasets (data ablations) to assess their impact and determine the most effective data
Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines for data ingestion, pre-processing, filtering, and annotation
Analyse real-world multimodal datasets to assess quality, diversity, relevance, and identify areas for improvement
Build tools and workflows for dataset auditing, visualization, and versioning
Collaborate with Safety, Ethics, and Governance teams to ensure datasets meet standards for quality, privacy, and responsible AI practices


Qualifications
Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in AI, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, or a related technical field.
Proficiency in Python.
Experience with distributed data-processing frameworks such as Spark, Ray and workflow-orchestration tools such as Airflow.
Experience with processing datasets at many petabyte scale and with trillion rows.
Experience building datasets for training foundation models, including language or multimodal models.
Strong experience in data analysis, data engineering, or both.
Ability to communicate technical findings clearly and effectively to research, engineering, and product teams.
Experience evaluating dataset quality and measuring the impact of data through controlled model-training experiments.

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
Experience working with large-scale, real-world datasets that are unstructured or semi-structured
Experience evaluating dataset quality and measuring the impact of data through controlled model-training experiments.
Experience with multimodal data, such as image, video, or audio data.

**Responsable de secteur Parascolaire à 90%**

Face au défi d’une augmentation croissante du nombre d’enfants au parascolaire et la construction de nouvelles écoles dans le Canton de Genève, le Groupement intercommunal pour l’animation parascolaire doit recruter davantage pour réaliser sa mission et répondre aux besoins de l’ensemble des familles genevoises.



Sa mission est d’accueillir les élèves du degré primaire durant la pause de midi et en fin d’après\-midi en assumant un devoir de développement éducatif complémentaire à celles de la famille, de l’école et des activités périscolaires.

**Votre rôle principal sera de piloter et de coordonner un secteur parascolaire en supervisant l’ensemble des activités organisationnelles, managériales et opérationnelles. Vous serez le moteur d’un environnement collaboratif, centré sur l’innovation et l’amélioration continue des prestations.**



Management d’équipes : Encadrer, évaluer et soutenir une équipe de 20 à 40 collaborateurs répartis sur différents lieux en garantissant une présence de proximité et une dynamique d’équipe harmonieuse.



Qualité des prestations : Garantir un haut niveau de qualité dans les prestations socio\-éducatives, en identifiant et en veillant à déployer les bonnes pratiques institutionnelles.



Projets : Piloter des projets à fort impacts sur le terrain, en lien avec les objectifs organisationnels.



Présence terrain : Assurer une présence active et régulière sur les différents sites de votre secteur, nécessitant une organisation rigoureuse et un moyen de mobilité adéquat.



Développement des compétences : Effectuer un suivi et des bilans réguliers avec les collaborateurs, encourager et promouvoir des formations (individuelles et/ou collectives) pour favoriser la montée en compétence des équipes et intégrer de nouvelles approches pédagogiques.



Coordination et collaboration : Jouer un rôle clé dans la coordination entre les équipes, la Direction et les partenaires.



**Votre profil**



* Diplôme de niveau HES ou titre jugé équivalent.
* Formation certifiante en management d’équipe, un atout.
* Leadership collaboratif et bienveillant avec une capacité à fédérer les équipes.
* Maîtrise des relations interpersonnelles : écoute active, communication adaptée, négociation.
* Adaptabilité, gestion du stress et capacité à évoluer dans un environnement dynamique.
* Expérience : Plusieurs années d’expérience réussie dans la gestion d’équipes socio\-éducatives ou dans le domaine éducatif/parascolaire.
* Bonne connaissance du tissu scolaire et socio\-éducatif genevois, un atout significatif.
* Maîtrise avancée des outils bureautiques (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint).

Rejoindre le GIAP, c’est?:



* Intégrer une organisation engagée dans le bien\-être des enfants et l’innovation pédagogique.
* Bénéficier d’un environnement qui valorise la formation continue et l’épanouissement professionnel.

Automation and Electrical Systems Engineer
==========================================

**About us**

Windworks develops actively controlled vertical\-axis wind turbines for clean, local and affordable energy production. We pioneered an advanced technology control system for wind turbine blades, using sensors, control software and proprietary actuation technology to dramatically increase our machine performances .

Our turbines are designed for on\-site power generation in commercial, industrial and community applications, especially where conventional wind turbines are difficult to deploy.

Based in the Lausanne area, Windworks combines aerodynamic research, experimental testing, mechanical design, electronics, control and field validation to bring a new generation of wind turbines to market.



**Role description**

You will participate to the definition, integration and validation of the turbine’s electrical architecture, contributing directly to a technology that must perform reliably over time in harsh conditions. This role offers a high level of ownership and impact, with the opportunity to shape key parts of the system architecture and see your work move quickly from concept to testing and deployment.

You will collaborate closely with a small multidisciplinary team, iterate rapidly, and contribute to making a technically ambitious product reliable and scalable.



**Main responsibilities**

The applicant will have about 5 years of experience in electrical architecture, automation systems (PLC\-based, including industrial communication protocols), motor sizing and selection, generator sizing and integration, the dimensioning of components and integrated circuits (custom or off\-the\-shelf), along with a solid understanding of signal acquisition and processing.



**1\. Electrical Architecture**

* Design, prototype, and validate the overall electrical system comprising sensors, motors, generators, drivers, AC/AC and AC/DC converters, inverters, rectifiers
* Grounding / earth connection experience
* Surge / lightning protection


**2\. Automation \& Communication Systems:**

* Implement PLC\-based automation (e.g., Beckhoff, Siemens etc.) and EtherCAT architectures.
* Integrate sensors and actuators via CAN, Modbus, EtherCAT, etc.
* Develop telemetry, data acquisition, and remote monitoring.


**3\. Motor Dimensioning, Selection \& Control:**

* Dimension and select motors for blade actuation and auxiliary systems based on torque, speed, duty cycle, environmental constraints and lifetime.
* Define drive architecture and requirements of power stage.
* Implement and validate motor control strategies (position, speed, torque control).
* Ensure compatibility with mechanical loads, power electronics, and safety constraints.


**4\. Safety, Standards \& Documentation:**

* Implement electrical safety systems.
* Ensure compliance with International Electrotechnical Commission standards (e.g., IEC 61400\).
* Ensure compliance with CE requirements
* Produce structured technical documentation.


**5\. Grid Integration:**

* Manage grid connection, anti\-islanding, synchronization, relays, and protection.
* Size HV/MV cables and design electrical cabinets.


**6\. Generator Selection \& Control:**

* Dimension and select the generator technology based on power rating, speed range, efficiency, and grid requirements.
* Define electrical interface and integration with rectifier/inverter stages.
* Implement and validate generator\-side control strategies (MPPT, torque control, speed regulation, power optimization).




**Nice to have**

**1\. Experience with outdoor equipment**, industrial machinery or safety\-critical systems.

**2\. Experience with energy systems** (wind power, hydro power, …)

**3\. PCB Design** (schematic and layout to bring\-up and EMC considerations)

**4\. Firmware Development** (drivers, communication protocols)



**Your profile**

* About 5 years of experience in electrical engineering, power electronics or industrial automation.
* Comfortable working autonomously in a small engineering team.
* Team player
* Experience working on systems exposed to real\-world constraints (e.g. noise, EMC, environmental conditions, reliability, safety).
* Comfortable managing engineering partners and technical procurement activities, including identifying and selecting suppliers, defining technical specifications, reviewing datasheets and validation documents, coordinating technical exchanges, and supporting supplier qualification.
* Produce structured technical documentation
* Elaborate systematic testing and verification
* Clear and pro\-active communication within the team; provide structured reporting on progress and issues, expresses technical needs early.
* Well\-organized with strong planning skills, able to define clear steps, anticipate resource.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Schinznach: das Wichtigste in Kürze

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Schinznach aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Entzugsstation

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Schinznach verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Schinznach im Kanton Aargau verzeichnet eine hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachfrauen und Pflegefachmännern auf Entzugsstationen, da spezialisierte Fachkräfte in diesem Bereich knapp sind. Sie profitieren als Kandidat von ausgezeichneten Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt und können gezielt eine Position im 80-100%-Pensum finden, die Ihren Anforderungen entspricht. iPersonal unterstützt Sie durch ihre Expertise und etablierten Kontakte zu Gesundheitsinstitutionen in der Region und erleichtert Ihnen den Einstieg durch umfassende Beratung und maßgeschneiderte Vermittlung.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Schinznach

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Schinznach

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**

Automation and Electrical Systems Engineer
==========================================

**About us**

Windworks develops actively controlled vertical\-axis wind turbines for clean, local and affordable energy production. We pioneered an advanced technology control system for wind turbine blades, using sensors, control software and proprietary actuation technology to dramatically increase our machine performances .

Our turbines are designed for on\-site power generation in commercial, industrial and community applications, especially where conventional wind turbines are difficult to deploy.

Based in the Lausanne area, Windworks combines aerodynamic research, experimental testing, mechanical design, electronics, control and field validation to bring a new generation of wind turbines to market.



**Role description**

You will participate to the definition, integration and validation of the turbine’s electrical architecture, contributing directly to a technology that must perform reliably over time in harsh conditions. This role offers a high level of ownership and impact, with the opportunity to shape key parts of the system architecture and see your work move quickly from concept to testing and deployment.

You will collaborate closely with a small multidisciplinary team, iterate rapidly, and contribute to making a technically ambitious product reliable and scalable.



**Main responsibilities**

The applicant will have about 5 years of experience in electrical architecture, automation systems (PLC\-based, including industrial communication protocols), motor sizing and selection, generator sizing and integration, the dimensioning of components and integrated circuits (custom or off\-the\-shelf), along with a solid understanding of signal acquisition and processing.



**1\. Electrical Architecture**

* Design, prototype, and validate the overall electrical system comprising sensors, motors, generators, drivers, AC/AC and AC/DC converters, inverters, rectifiers
* Grounding / earth connection experience
* Surge / lightning protection


**2\. Automation \& Communication Systems:**

* Implement PLC\-based automation (e.g., Beckhoff, Siemens etc.) and EtherCAT architectures.
* Integrate sensors and actuators via CAN, Modbus, EtherCAT, etc.
* Develop telemetry, data acquisition, and remote monitoring.


**3\. Motor Dimensioning, Selection \& Control:**

* Dimension and select motors for blade actuation and auxiliary systems based on torque, speed, duty cycle, environmental constraints and lifetime.
* Define drive architecture and requirements of power stage.
* Implement and validate motor control strategies (position, speed, torque control).
* Ensure compatibility with mechanical loads, power electronics, and safety constraints.


**4\. Safety, Standards \& Documentation:**

* Implement electrical safety systems.
* Ensure compliance with International Electrotechnical Commission standards (e.g., IEC 61400\).
* Ensure compliance with CE requirements
* Produce structured technical documentation.


**5\. Grid Integration:**

* Manage grid connection, anti\-islanding, synchronization, relays, and protection.
* Size HV/MV cables and design electrical cabinets.


**6\. Generator Selection \& Control:**

* Dimension and select the generator technology based on power rating, speed range, efficiency, and grid requirements.
* Define electrical interface and integration with rectifier/inverter stages.
* Implement and validate generator\-side control strategies (MPPT, torque control, speed regulation, power optimization).




**Nice to have**

**1\. Experience with outdoor equipment**, industrial machinery or safety\-critical systems.

**2\. Experience with energy systems** (wind power, hydro power, …)

**3\. PCB Design** (schematic and layout to bring\-up and EMC considerations)

**4\. Firmware Development** (drivers, communication protocols)



**Your profile**

* About 5 years of experience in electrical engineering, power electronics or industrial automation.
* Comfortable working autonomously in a small engineering team.
* Team player
* Experience working on systems exposed to real\-world constraints (e.g. noise, EMC, environmental conditions, reliability, safety).
* Comfortable managing engineering partners and technical procurement activities, including identifying and selecting suppliers, defining technical specifications, reviewing datasheets and validation documents, coordinating technical exchanges, and supporting supplier qualification.
* Produce structured technical documentation
* Elaborate systematic testing and verification
* Clear and pro\-active communication within the team; provide structured reporting on progress and issues, expresses technical needs early.
* Well\-organized with strong planning skills, able to define clear steps, anticipate resource.




Details

* Starting date: Immediate
* Location: Renens, VD, Switzeland

title: Senior IT Systems & Network Administrator
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced, hands\-on IT professional to take operational ownership of the school's day\-to\-day IT environment.

This is a senior, campus\- based technical position combining systems administration, enterprise networking and high\-quality user support.

The successful candidate will independently diagnose and resolve complex incidents, maintain the reliability of core IT services and anticipate issues before they disrupt teaching and learning.

They will serve as a key on\-site IT contact for staff and work closely with Regional and Global IT teams, following Group technical standards, security policies and change\-management procedures.

The role requires sound technical judgement, clear communication and the ability to plan, prioritise and

deliver work with limited day\-to\-day supervision. It is a hands\-on position rather than a people\-management role.

Key Responsibilities

**Campus IT Operations \& Technical Ownership**

* Take day\-to\-day ownership of campus IT operations, from incident triage and diagnosis through resolution, documentation and follow\-up.
* Independently prioritise support requests and operational tasks, with particular urgency for incidents affecting lessons, examinations and essential school services.
* Proactively monitor recurring issues, service health and technology risks; recommend and implement practical improvements within delegated authority.
* Act as the senior on\-site technical contact, coordinating with school stakeholders, IT colleagues and external suppliers; escalate significant incidents with clear technical evidence and business impact.


**Systems, Microsoft 365 \& Identity Management**

* Administer Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID, including users, groups, licences, role\-appropriate access permissions, authentication and account lifecycle processes.
* Operate and troubleshoot Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams and SharePoint Online, including mailboxes, collaboration services and access\-related incidents.
* Support secure identity practices, including MFA, access controls and the implementation of centrally defined security policies.
* Investigate service degradation, authentication failures and device\-to\-cloud integration issues, identifying root causes and implementing controlled fixes.


**Endpoint \& Device Management**

* Administer Windows endpoints through Microsoft Intune, including enrolment, device configuration, application deployment, policy application and troubleshooting.
* Support Apple Macs and iPads through Jamf and maintain compliant, reliable device configurations in accordance with Group standards.
* Manage provisioning, deployment, replacement, patching and end\-of\-life processes for staff and shared school devices.


**Networking \& Infrastructure**

* Provide hands\-on operation and advanced troubleshooting of the campus wired and wireless network, including switches, access points, network connectivity and related services.
* Use Cisco Meraki management and diagnostic tools, where authorised, to investigate client connectivity, switch ports, Wi\-Fi performance and infrastructure alerts.
* Diagnose issues involving TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, switching, routing fundamentals, wireless authentication and Internet connectivity; distinguish endpoint, local\-network and upstream service faults.
* Carry out approved network changes, equipment replacements and site deployments in coordination with Regional or Global IT; maintain accurate configurations and documentation.
* Work with connectivity and network service providers to restore service and prevent repeat incidents.


**User Support \& Classroom Technology**

* Provide second\-line and senior escalation support for complex Windows, Microsoft 365, endpoint, classroom AV/interactive display and peripheral issues, while remaining responsive to urgent day\-to\-day support needs.
* Help teachers and staff use school technology effectively; communicate incident status and practical workarounds in accessible, non\-technical language.
* Support PaperCut MF / Find\-Me printing and cloud telephony, coordinating specialist suppliers where required.


**Security, Documentation \& Projects**

* Maintain IT asset records, operational procedures, technical documentation and useful knowledge\-base articles.
* Contribute to refresh programmes, upgrades, onboarding/offboarding and continuous improvement projects, managing assigned on\-site activities autonomously.
* Apply information\-security, privacy and safeguarding requirements; identify and promptly escalate security incidents or risks in line with established procedures.

As Cloud Operations Lead you own the daily operation of our cloud platform: availability, incident response, monitoring, backup and recovery, and the infrastructure underneath. The service desk is part of your team, so you also own what customers experience every time they contact us. You lead a team of four to six people, and you are the person the business relies on when something has to keep running.

Xelon is building a new platform over the coming years. VMware carries the production estate through that transition and stays in place for at least the next two years, alongside other hypervisors. You run that environment, you keep it stable and auditable, and you make sure the transition never happens at the expense of the customers on it.

Platform strategy, target architecture and the technology roadmap sit with the Head of Platform \& Technology. You are a close partner in those decisions and you own their operational reality.

* **Availability and customer satisfaction.** You hit the agreed availability targets and hold them, and customers experience both the platform and the service desk as dependable, with incidents resolved quickly and communicated clearly.

**Responsibilities**

Keep availability, performance and capacity ahead of demand as the customer base grows. Own hardware lifecycle, capacity planning and datacenter operations together with our partners.
* **Networking, storage and datacenter:** Own the operational side of network and storage: segmentation, routing, firewalling, DNS, load balancing, and the storage layer underneath the platform. Raise the level of networking knowledge and practice across the team.

Turn recurring tickets into fixes together with the engineering side of the team, rather than absorbing them as routine.

* **Compliance and audit readiness:** Keep operations aligned with ISO 27001, ISAE and Swiss data sovereignty requirements. Work with Dev\- and SecOps on hardening, patch compliance and audit evidence. Maintain operational documentation that holds up in an audit.
* **Budget, vendors and procurement:** Co\-own the operational CAPEX and OPEX budget with the Head of Platform \& Technology. Manage vendor relationships, licenses and procurement for the operations estate.


Requirements
------------

**Who You Are**

We are looking for an operations leader, not an architect. Technical depth matters, and so does the ability to run a team through a platform transition without dropping the service underneath it.

* You keep the service running while the ground moves. A platform transition does not become the customer's problem.
* You lead through presence and clarity, not authority. Your team knows what good looks like.
* You are calm in an incident and precise afterwards. The postmortem produces a fix, not a narrative.
* You treat the service desk as part of the product, not as a queue to be absorbed.

**Must Haves**

**Nice to Haves**

* Monitoring and logging at scale, e.g. Prometheus, Grafana or a similar stack.

Benefits

Senior Account Manager
======================

Welcome to **Xelon** – where technology meets innovation and customer centricity.

As we continue to expand, we are looking for a motivated and customer\-focused

**Senior Account Manager (100%)**

to join our team. In this role, you will be the key link between our customers and our technical teams, ensuring long\-term partnerships and outstanding customer satisfaction.

At **Xelon**, we deliver secure, scalable, and automated Swiss cloud infrastructure for the next generation of digital services. From **IaaS** to **SaaS**, our platform powers workloads in regulated industries like **technology**, **finance, insurance, and public services**. Our solutions \- **Xelon Cloud**, **Xelon Secure\+** and **Xelon HQ** combine reliability, automation, sovereignty, and simplicity in one are on a mission to become the **\#1 Swiss Cloud Enabler**, and we are growing a team of people who want to shape the future of cloud infrastructure and software operations.

Tasks
-----

**Your role and your responsibilities**

The Senior Account Manager role is responsible for the acquisition of new customers, as well as growth, retention, and strategic development of existing/assigned customer accounts while ensuring a seamless and value\-driven customer experience. Specifically, you will:

* Identify and acquire new customers through outbound and inbound sales activities in close collaboration with our Business Development Representative and the marketing team;
* Manage and grow a portfolio of existing customer accounts (MSPs, ITSPs, large SMBs);
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries and requests;
* Build strong, long\-term relationships with key stakeholders on the customer side;
* Identify upselling and cross\-selling opportunities to maximize customer lifetime value;
* Own the sales cycle for new customers, from first contact to closing and onboarding;
* Coordinate with internal teams (platform, product, business operations, finance) to deliver solutions;
* Support the onboarding of new customers and ensure smooth implementation;
* Monitor account performance and provide regular reporting and insights;
* Proactively identify risks and resolve issues to maintain high customer satisfaction.


Requirements
------------

The ideal candidate will tick all the following boxes.

**Must\-haves**

* **Relevant work experience:** You have least three years of experience in account management, sales, business development, or customer success in technology company focusing on IT infrastructure \- ideally mid\-market.
* **Technical affinity and know\-how:** You have a solid understanding of the building blocks of IT infrastructure and the cloud. You are familiar with terms such as IaaS, PaaS, public and private cloud, VMs, backup, storage, containers and related topics.
* **Drive \& Ownership:** You are a self\-starter who likes to take matters into your own hand, take responsibility, and persistently work toward results.
* **Matching education:** Bachelor’s degree (or comparable) in Information Systems, Business, Marketing, or a related field.
* **(Swiss) \& English:** You speak both and English fluently and you are able to communicate confidently and flawlessly in both – in spoken and in written form. Additionally, you are able to effortlessly follow a conversation in Swiss .
* **Customer Focus:** You keep the customer's interests in sight at all times. Going the extra\-mile for your customers comes naturally to you.
* **Collaborative Team Player:** You thrive in cross\-functional environments, working seamlessly with internal and external stakeholders to drive business outcomes.
* **CRM Pro:** You are experience in working with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot).
* **Results orientated mindset:** Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.


**Nice\-to\-haves**

* **Entrepreneurial Spirit:** You are characterized by a self\-motivated drive to explore new opportunities, a willingness to take initiative as well as to seek and provide solutions and a strong commitment to contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.
*  **Management Ambition:** The ambition to develop into a sales management role is seen as a plus. If all goes according to plan, Xelon just might offer you that opportunity once the time is right.
* **Swiss and other additional Languages:** Any language additional to the required ones is considered a plus; Swiss is an asset in this role.
* **HubSpot**: Any previous hands\-on experience and/or certification for HubSpot is valuable for this role.
* **AI\-mindset**: Curiosity and openness towards AI\-supported workflows, along with a solid understanding of current AI developments and tools, and a willingness to leverage them to improve efficiency and outcomes.
* **A feel for processes:** You contribute ideas on how we can further optimize our sales and marketing processes.


Benefits
--------

* **Rewarding compensation:** Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives tied to growth and sales success.
* **Creative freedom:** The opportunity to make a decisive contribution to the growth of a well\-established tech scale\-up.
* **Flexible working hours \& remote options:** Work when and where you are most productive.
* **Innovative environment:** Experience the dynamics of a tech scale\-up with a strong existing customer base. Modern tools and technologies support your work.
*  **, dynamic team:** Together we achieve our goals and celebrate our successes.


**Join our mission**

Do you feel like you are the person that would complete our team? Are you ready for a new challenge? Then apply now!

We look forward to hearing from you

OBJECTIVES / PURPOSE
Provides enterprise-level governance, portfolio and operational leadership for medical grants, medical education grants and sponsorships within Global Medical.

ACCOUNTABILITIES
